arabic: هذه قصة جميلة عن عائلة صغيرة.
english: This is a beautiful story about a small family.
transliteration: Hadhihi qissatun jamilatun 'an 'a'ilatin saghirah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: في بيت كبير، كانت تسكن ليلى وأخوها علي.
english: In a big house, Layla and her brother Ali lived.
transliteration: Fi baytin kabeerin, kanat taskunu Layla wa akhooha Ali.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: بيتهم كان واسعًا وبه حديقة خضراء.
english: Their house was spacious and had a green garden.
transliteration: Baytuhum kana wasi'an wa bihi hadiqatun khadra'.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: الشمس كانت مشرقة جدًا في الصباح.
english: The sun was very bright in the morning.
transliteration: Ash-shamsu kanat mushriqatan jiddan fi as-sabah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: ليلى استيقظت مبكرًا وشكرت ربها.
english: Layla woke up early and thanked her Lord.
transliteration: Layla istayqadhat mubakkiran wa shakarat rabbaha.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: علي الصغير يحب اللعب في الحديقة.
english: Little Ali loves to play in the garden.
transliteration: Ali as-saghiru yuhibbu al-la'ba fi al-hadiqah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هي شربت حليبها الطازج.
english: She drank her fresh milk.
transliteration: Hiya sharibat haleebaha at-tazaj.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هو أكل خبزه مع الجبن.
english: He ate his bread with cheese.
transliteration: Huwa akala khubzahu ma'a al-jubn.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: أمهم كانت تعد الفطور لهم كل يوم.
english: Their mother used to prepare breakfast for them every day.
transliteration: Ummuhum kanat tu'iddu al-futura lahum kulla yawm.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: أبوهم كان يذهب إلى عمله باكرًا.
english: Their father used to go to his work early.
transliteration: Abuhum kana yadhhabu ila 'amalihi bakiran.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: ليلى وعلي يحبان ألعابهم الكثيرة.
english: Layla and Ali love their many toys.
transliteration: Layla wa Ali yuhibbanu al'aabahum al-katheerah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: اليوم، هما يريدان لعب كرة القدم.
english: Today, they want to play football.
transliteration: Al-yawm, huma yuridaani la'b kurat al-qadam.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: لكن أين هي كرتهم؟
english: But where is their ball?
transliteration: Lakin ayna hiya kuratuhum?
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: ليلى بحثت تحت الطاولة.
english: Layla searched under the table.
transliteration: Layla bahathat tahta at-tawilah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: علي نظر خلف الباب.
english: Ali looked behind the door.
transliteration: Ali nazara khalfa al-bab.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: يا أمي، هل رأيت كرتنا الحمراء؟ سألت ليلى.
english: Oh mother, have you seen our red ball? Layla asked.
transliteration: Ya ummi, hal ra'ayt kuratana al-hamra'? Sa'alat Layla.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: الأم ابتسمت وقالت: كرتكم عند الشجرة الكبيرة.
english: The mother smiled and said: Your ball is near the big tree.
transliteration: Al-ummu ibtasamat wa qalat: Kuratukum 'inda ash-shajarah al-kabeerah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: ليلى وعلي ذهبا بسرعة إلى الحديقة.
english: Layla and Ali went quickly to the garden.
transliteration: Layla wa Ali dhahaba bi-sur'atin ila al-hadiqah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: رأوا أزهارًا جميلة بألوان مختلفة.
english: They saw beautiful flowers of different colors.
transliteration: Ra'aw azhaaran jameelah bi-alwanin mukhtalifah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: الأشجار كانت خضراء وثمارها صغيرة.
english: The trees were green and their fruits were small.
transliteration: Al-ashjaru kanat khadra' wa thimaruha saghirah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: سمعوا أصوات عصافير صغيرة.
english: They heard the sounds of small birds.
transliteration: Sami'u aswata 'asaafeera saghirah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هذه زهورك المفضلة يا أمي! قالت ليلى.
english: These are your favorite flowers, mother! Layla said.
transliteration: Hadhihi zuhuuruki al-mufaddalah ya ummi! Qalat Layla.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: علي وجد كرته الحمراء أخيرًا.
english: Ali found his red ball at last.
transliteration: Ali wajada kuratahu al-hamra'a akheeran.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هما صرخوا بسعادة: وجدناها!
english: They shouted happily: We found it!
transliteration: Huma sarakha bi-sa'adah: Wajadnaha!
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: بدأوا يلعبون الكرة معًا.
english: They began to play the ball together.
transliteration: Bada'u yal'aboon al-kurah ma'an.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: ليلى كانت ترمي الكرة وعلي يركض.
english: Layla was throwing the ball and Ali was running.
transliteration: Layla kanat tarmi al-kurah wa Ali yarkud.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: لعبوا تحت الشمس الدافئة لوقت طويل.
english: They played under the warm sun for a long time.
transliteration: La'iboo tahta ash-shams ad-daafi'ah li-waqtin taweel.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: بعد قليل، سمعوا صوت سيارة أبيهم.
english: After a little while, they heard the sound of their father's car.
transliteration: Ba'da qaleel, sami'u sawta sayyarati abeehim.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: الأب جاء بابتسامة كبيرة.
english: The father came with a big smile.
transliteration: Al-abu ja'a bi-ibtisamatin kabeerah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هو حمل أكياسًا فيها طعام شهي.
english: He carried bags containing delicious food.
transliteration: Huwa hamala akyaasan feeha ta'amun shahiyy.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: أهلاً يا أطفالي الأعزاء! قال الأب.
english: Welcome, my dear children! the father said.
transliteration: Ahlan ya atfaali al-a'izza'! Qala al-abu.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: كلهم جلسوا على الطاولة لتناول العشاء.
english: All of them sat at the table to eat dinner.
transliteration: Kulluhum jalasoo 'ala at-tawilah li-tanawul al-'asha'.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: كانت وجبة لذيذة ومليئة بالفرح.
english: It was a delicious meal full of joy.
transliteration: Kanat wajbatun ladheedhah wa malee'ah bi-al-farah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: العائلة الصغيرة تحب وقتها معًا.
english: The small family loves their time together.
transliteration: Al-'a'ilatu as-saghirah tuhibbu waqtaha ma'an.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: هذا يوم جميل لعائلتهم السعيدة.
english: This is a beautiful day for their happy family.
transliteration: Hadha yawmun jameel li-'a'ilatihim as-sa'eedah.
storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

arabic: زَيْدٌ وَأَصْدِقَاؤُهُ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي الْحَيِّ الْجَمِيلِ.
english: Zaid and his friends play in the beautiful neighborhood.
transliteration: Zaidun wa asdiqaauhu yalabuuna fi al-hayyi al-jamiili.
storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

arabic: هُمْ حَمَلُوا طَعَامَهُمْ إِلَى جِيرَانِهِمُ الْكِرَامِ.
english: They carried their food to their generous neighbors.
transliteration: Hum hamaluu taaamahum ila jiraanihimu al-kiraami.
storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

arabic: شَكَرَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ الْأَوْلَادَ الصِّغَارَ عَلَى هَدَايَاهُمْ.
english: The men and women thanked the young boys for their gifts.
transliteration: Shakara al-rijaalu wa al-nisaau al-awlaada al-sighaara ala hadayaahum.
storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

arabic: نَحْنُ نُسَاعِدُ بَعْضَنَا لِأَنَّنَا جُزْءٌ مِنْ هَذَا الْمُجْتَمَعِ.
english: We help each other because we are part of this community.
transliteration: Nahnu nusaaidu badanaa liannanaa juzun min haadha al-mujtamai.
storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

arabic: كَانَتِ الصَّدَاقَةُ قَوِيَّةً بَيْنَ السُّكَّانِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ.
english: The friendship was strong among the residents in the city.
transliteration: Kaanat al-sadaaqatu qawiyyatan bayna al-sukkani fi al-madiinati.
storyTitle: The Good Friends in the Neighborhood

arabic: عائلتي تاكل اليوم في البيت
english: My family eats today in the house
transliteration: Ailati takulu alyawm fi albayt

arabic: اخوتي هم مدرسون مجتهدون في العمل
english: My brothers are hardworking teachers at work
transliteration: Ikhwati hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon fi alamal

arabic: اخواتي طالبات مجتهدات في المدرسة
english: My sisters are hardworking students in the school
transliteration: Akhawati talibaat mujtahidat fi almadrasa

arabic: نحن ناكل الخبز امام البيت
english: We eat the bread in front of the house
transliteration: Nahnu nakulu alkhubz amama albayt

arabic: نحن كتبنا الواجب قبل الاكل
english: We wrote the homework before eating
transliteration: Nahnu katabna alwajib qabla alakl

arabic: نحن سنسافر الى الشمال والجنوب في الصيف
english: We will travel to the north and the south in the summer
transliteration: Nahnu sanusafir ila al shamal wal janub fi al sayf

arabic: هي اشترت قميص لونه زهري للرحلة الطويلة
english: She bought a pink shirt for the long trip
transliteration: Hiya ishtarat qamis lawnuhu zahri lil rihla al tawila

arabic: انا اشاهد الدب الاسود الكبير في خريطة الرحلة
english: I am watching the big black bear on the trip map
transliteration: Ana ushahid al dub al aswad al kabir fi kharitat al rihla

arabic: هم تعلموا الوان جديدة لملابس السفر
english: They learned new colors for travel clothes
transliteration: Hum taallamu alwan jadida li malabis al safar

arabic: لكن النمر حيوان قوي جدا ينام في سيارتي
english: But the tiger is a very strong animal sleeping in my car
transliteration: Lakin al namir hayawan qawi jiddan yanam fi sayyarati

arabic: اتصلت بصديقي في المساء
english: I called my friend in the evening.
transliteration: Ittasaltu bisadeeqi fi almasa

arabic: قلت له نحن كتبنا الواجب
english: I said to him we wrote the homework.
transliteration: Qultu lahu nahnu katabna alwajib

arabic: الرجل قال هم مدرسون مجتهدون
english: The man said they are hardworking teachers.
transliteration: Alrajul qaala hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon

arabic: انا عرفت ان الصوت غريب
english: I knew that the voice was strange.
transliteration: Ana araftu anna alsawt ghareeb

arabic: هذا ليس هاتف صديقي
english: This is not my friend's phone.
transliteration: Hadha laysa hatif sadeeqi

arabic: انا العب مباراة كرة قدم في المدرسة
english: I play a football match in the school.
transliteration: Ana alabu mubarat kurat qadam fi al madrasa.

arabic: قبل المباراة نحن كتبنا الواجب
english: Before the match we wrote the homework.
transliteration: Qabla al mubara nahnu katabna al wajib.

arabic: حضر مدرسون و طالبات الى الملعب
english: Teachers and female students came to the stadium.
transliteration: Hadara mudarrisoon wa talibaat ila al malab.

arabic: هم مدرسون مجتهدون و يحبون الرياضة
english: They are hardworking teachers and they love sports.
transliteration: Hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon wa yuhibboona al riyada.

arabic: هذه سيارات جميلة تقف امام الملعب
english: These are beautiful cars standing in front of the stadium.
transliteration: Hadhihi sayyaraat jameela taqifu amama al malab.

arabic: نحن كتبنا الواجب ثم ذهبنا الى المطبخ
english: We wrote the homework then we went to the kitchen.
transliteration: Nahnu katabna al-wajib thumma dhahabna ila al-matbakh

arabic: نحن سعداء جدا لاننا نطبخ طعاما جديدا
english: We are very happy because we are cooking new food.
transliteration: Nahnu suadaa jiddan liannana natbukh taaman jadeedan

arabic: نحن قرانا ثلاثة كتب عن الطبخ اليوم
english: We read three books about cooking today.
transliteration: Nahnu qarana thalathat kutub an al-tabkh al-yawm

arabic: شعرنا بخوف قليل لكن الطعام كان ممتازا
english: We felt a little fear but the food was excellent.
transliteration: Shaarna bikhawf qaleel lakin al-taam kana mumtaazan

arabic: هم مدرسون مجتهدون واكلوا طعامنا بكل سرور
english: They are hardworking teachers and they ate our food with all joy.
transliteration: Hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon wa akalu taamana bikull suroor

arabic: ذهبت الى السوق الكبير لاشتري ملابس جديدة للصيف
english: I went to the large market to buy new clothes for the summer.
transliteration: dhahabtu ila al suq al kabir li ashtari malabis jadida lil sayf

arabic: كانت المتاجر مليئة بالالوان الزاهية والاقمشة الناعمة الجميلة
english: The shops were full of bright colors and beautiful soft fabrics.
transliteration: kanat al matajir maliia bil alwan al zahiya wal aqmisha al naima al jamila

arabic: لمست قميصا قطنيا ازرق وكانت رائحته نظيفة ومنعشة
english: I touched a blue cotton shirt and its smell was clean and fresh.
transliteration: lamastu qamisan qutniyan azraq wa kanat raihatuhu nadhifa wa munisha

arabic: جربت ايضا بنطلونا اسود في غرفة القياس وكان مريحا جدا
english: I also tried on black trousers in the fitting room and they were very comfortable.
transliteration: jarrabtu aydan bantalonan aswad fi ghurfat al qiyas wa kana murihan jiddan

arabic: دفعت الباب الزجاجي الثقيل وخرجت بسعادة مع الاكياس الجديدة
english: I pushed the heavy glass door and left happily with the new bags.
transliteration: dafatu al bab al zujaji al thaqil wa kharajtu bi saada maa al akyas al jadida

arabic: بدات مباراة كرة القدم في الملعب الكبير
english: The football match started in the big stadium.
transliteration: badat mubarat kurat alqadam fi almalab alkabir

arabic: ركض اللاعب الشهير بسرعة نحو المرمى
english: The famous player ran quickly toward the goal.
transliteration: rakada allaib ashshahir bisura nahwa almarma

arabic: فجاة انزلق وسقط على العشب الاخضر
english: Suddenly he slipped and fell on the green grass.
transliteration: fajaatan inzalaqa wasaqata ala alushb alakhdar

arabic: اصطدمت الكرة براسه ودخلت الشبكة
english: The ball hit his head and entered the net.
transliteration: istadamat alkura birasihi wadakhalat ashshabaka

arabic: ضحك الجمهور لانه سجل هدفا بالصدفة
english: The crowd laughed because he scored a goal by accident.
transliteration: dahiqa aljumhur liannahu sajjala hadafan bissudfa

arabic: هذه سيارات جميلة امام المدرسة
english: These are beautiful cars in front of the school.
transliteration: Hadhihi sayyaraat jameela amama al-madrasa

arabic: هم مدرسون مجتهدون في الصف الكبير
english: They are hardworking teachers in the big classroom.
transliteration: Hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon fi al-saff al-kabeer

arabic: هو كتب الدرس على السبورة البيضاء
english: He wrote the lesson on the white board.
transliteration: Huwa kataba al-dars ala al-sabboura al-baydaa

arabic: نحن كتبنا الواجب في ثلاثة كتب
english: We wrote the homework in three books.
transliteration: Nahnu katabna al-wajib fi thalathat kutub

arabic: هناك طالبات سعيدات في الصباح
english: There are happy female students in the morning.
transliteration: Hunaka talibaat saeedat fi al-sabah

arabic: الولد امام البيت
english: The boy is in front of the house.
transliteration: alwalad amam albayt

arabic: الباب مغلق ولا يجد المفتاح
english: The door is locked and he does not find the key.
transliteration: albab mughlaq wala yajid almuftah

arabic: يشعر الولد بالحزن ويبكي
english: The boy feels sadness and cries.
transliteration: yashur alwalad bialhuzn wayabki

arabic: يصل الاب ويفتح الباب
english: The father arrives and opens the door.
transliteration: yasil alab wayaftah albab

arabic: الولد سعيد الان ويدخل البيت
english: The boy is happy now and enters the house.
transliteration: alwalad said alaan wayadkhul albayt

arabic: سارة تخطط لزفاف كبير
english: Sarah plans for a big wedding.
transliteration: Sara tukhattitu lizafaf kabir

arabic: الام تريد حفلة كبيرة جدا
english: The mother wants a very big party.
transliteration: Alumm turid hafla kabira jiddan

arabic: سارة تريد حفلة صغيرة وهادئة
english: Sarah wants a small and quiet party.
transliteration: Sara turid hafla saghira wahadia

arabic: الجد يحب الاغاني القديمة والتقليدية
english: The grandfather likes old and traditional songs.
transliteration: Aljadd yuhibb alaghani alqadima waltaqlidiyya

arabic: لكن سارة تفضل الموسيقى الجديدة
english: But Sarah prefers new music.
transliteration: Lakin Sara tufaddil almusiqa aljadida

arabic: يجلس الولد مع جده في حديقه
english: The boy sits with his grandfather in a garden.
transliteration: yajlis al walad ma jaddih fi hadiqa

arabic: الجد يشرب القهوه العربيه على طاوله
english: The grandfather drinks Arabic coffee at a table.
transliteration: al jadd yashrab al qahwa al arabiyya ala tawila

arabic: يمسك الولد كتاب و قلم
english: The boy holds a book and a pen.
transliteration: yamsik al walad kitab wa qalam

arabic: الولد يسال عن شمس و قمر
english: The boy asks about a sun and a moon.
transliteration: al walad yasal an shams wa qamar

arabic: الجد يبتسم و يكلم الولد
english: The grandfather smiles and speaks to the boy.
transliteration: al jadd yabtasim wa yukallim al walad

arabic: اجلس على طاولة صغيرة في المقهى
english: I sit at a small table in the cafe
transliteration: ajlis ala tawila saghira fi al maqha

arabic: اشرب قهوة سوداء حارة
english: I drink hot black coffee
transliteration: ashrab qahwa sawda harra

arabic: استمع الى موسيقى هادئة
english: I listen to quiet music
transliteration: astami ila musiqa hadia

arabic: انظر الى الناس في الشارع
english: I look at the people in the street
transliteration: anthur ila al nas fi al shari

arabic: انتظر صديقي اليوم
english: I wait for my friend today
transliteration: antathir sadiqi al yawm

arabic: يعمل الرجل الكبير في المكتب
english: The old man works in the office.
transliteration: yaamal arrajul alkabeer fi almaktab

arabic: هو يكتب الرسالة على الورق
english: He writes the letter on paper.
transliteration: huwa yaktub arrasaala ala alwaraq

arabic: يعمل الشاب في نفس المكتب
english: The young man works in the same office.
transliteration: yaamal ashshaab fi nafs almaktab

arabic: هو يشاهد الصور على الهاتف
english: He watches the pictures on the phone.
transliteration: huwa yushaahid assuwar ala alhaatif

arabic: هم يشربون القهوة معا في الصباح
english: They drink coffee together in the morning.
transliteration: hum yashraboon alqahwa maan fi assabaah

arabic: في المساء امشي في السوق الجميل واشم رائحة القهوة
english: In the evening I walk in the beautiful market and smell the coffee.
transliteration: fi al-masa amshi fi as-suq al-jamil wa-ashummu raihat al-qahwa.

arabic: فجاة ارى صديقي القديم احمد قرب الباب الكبير
english: Suddenly I see my old friend Ahmad near the big door.
transliteration: faja'a ara sadiqi al-qadim Ahmad qurba al-bab al-kabir.

arabic: ابتسم واقول مساء الخير كيف حالك
english: I smile and say good evening how are you.
transliteration: abtasimu wa-aqulu masa al-khayr kayfa haluka.

arabic: يضحك احمد بصوت عال ويقول مساء النور انا بخير
english: Ahmad laughs loudly and says good evening I am fine.
transliteration: yadhaku Ahmad bisawt aalin wa-yaqulu masa an-nur ana bi-khayr.

arabic: نشرب الشاي الحار معا ونتكلم بسعادة تحت النجوم
english: We drink hot tea together and talk happily under the stars.
transliteration: nashrabu ash-shay al-harr maan wa-natakallamu bisaada tahta an-nujum.

arabic: وصل طارق الى الملعب
english: Tariq arrived at the stadium
transliteration: Wasala Tariq ila al-malab

arabic: قال طارق السلام عليكم مساء الخير
english: Tariq said peace be upon you good evening
transliteration: Qala Tariq as-salamu alaykum masa al-khayr

arabic: قال عمر وعليكم السلام مساء النور
english: Omar said and peace be upon you good evening
transliteration: Qala Omar wa alaykum as-salam masa an-nur

arabic: لعب الفريق مباراة كرة القدم
english: The team played the football match
transliteration: Laba al-fariq mubarat kurat al-qadam

arabic: فاز فريق طارق في اللعبة
english: Tariq's team won the game
transliteration: Faza fariq Tariq fi al-luba

arabic: ضاع خالد في شوارع المدينة الواسعة وبحث عن شخص ليساعده
english: Khalid got lost in the wide city streets and looked for someone to help him.
transliteration: daa khalid fi shawaari al madina al wasia wa bahatha an shakhs liyusaidahu

arabic: راى خالد شرطيا وقال له مساء الخير كيف حالك
english: Khalid saw a policeman and said to him good evening how are you.
transliteration: raa khalid shurtiyan wa qala lahu masa al khayr kayfa haluka

arabic: اجاب الشرطي مساء النور انا بخير ما اسمك
english: The policeman answered good evening I am fine what is your name.
transliteration: ajaba ash shurti masa an nur ana bi khayr ma ismuka

arabic: قال خالد اسمي خالد واين الطريق الى الفندق من فضلك
english: Khalid said my name is Khalid and where is the way to the hotel please.
transliteration: qala khalid ismi khalid wa ayna at tariq ila al funduq min fadlik

arabic: ابتسم الشرطي واشار بيده الى الشارع القريب ليصله بامان
english: The policeman smiled and pointed with his hand to the nearby street to reach it safely.
transliteration: ibtasama ash shurti wa ashara biyadihi ila ash shari al qarib liyasulahu bi aman

arabic: ذهبت إلى المقهى كعادتي فسمعت صوتا مألوفا يقول السلام عليكم صباح الخير
english: I went to the cafe as usual and heard a familiar voice saying hello good morning
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila al maqha ka adati fa samitu sawtan malufan yaqul as salamu alaykum sabah al khayr
storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

arabic: التفت مبتسما وأجبته وعليكم السلام صباح النور كيف حالك يا صديقي
english: I turned smiling and answered him and peace be upon you good morning how are you my friend
transliteration: Iltafattu mubtasiman wa ajabtuhu wa alaykum as salam sabah an nur kayfa haluka ya sadiqi
storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

arabic: عانقني بشوق وقال أنا بخير شكرا وأعمل حاليا في شركة قريبة
english: He hugged me with longing and said I am fine thank you and I currently work in a nearby company
transliteration: Anaqani bi shawq wa qala ana bi khayr shukran wa amalu haliyan fi sharika qariba
storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

arabic: شربنا القهوة معا وتحدثنا عن تفاصيل حياتنا اليومية بعد كل هذه السنوات
english: We drank coffee together and talked about the details of our daily lives after all these years
transliteration: Sharibna al qahwa maan wa tahaddathna an tafasil hayatina al yawmiyya bada kulla hadhihi as sanawat
storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

arabic: ودعنا بعضنا البعض ثم توجهت إلى مكتبي لبدء يوم عملي بنشاط
english: We said goodbye to each other then I headed to my office to start my workday with energy
transliteration: Wadaana badana al bad thumma tawajjahtu ila maktabi li bad yawm amali bi nashat
storyTitle: A Surprise Meeting at the Cafe

arabic: يذهب خالد الى السوق في المساء
english: Khalid goes to the market in the evening.
transliteration: Yadhhabu khalid ila as suq fi al masa

arabic: يقابل البائع ويقول مساء الخير
english: He meets the seller and says good evening.
transliteration: Yuqabilu al bai wa yaqulu masa al khayr

arabic: يرد البائع مساء النور كيف حالك
english: The seller replies good evening how are you.
transliteration: Yaruddu al bai masa an nur kayfa haluka

arabic: يجيب خالد انا بخير شكرا
english: Khalid answers I am fine thank you.
transliteration: Yujibu khalid ana bi khayr shukran

arabic: يشتري خالد التفاح ويذهب الى البيت
english: Khalid buys apples and goes to the house.
transliteration: Yashtari khalid al tuffah wa yadhhabu ila al bayt

arabic: احمد طالب جديد في المدرسة
english: Ahmad is a new student in the school.
transliteration: ahmad talib jadid fi almadrasa

arabic: يدخل المعلم الفصل في الصباح
english: The teacher enters the classroom in the morning.
transliteration: yadkhul almualim alfasl fi alsabah

arabic: يدرس احمد مع المعلم
english: Ahmad studies with the teacher.
transliteration: yadrus ahmad maa almualim

arabic: ياكل الطالب طعام الغداء
english: The student eats food for lunch.
transliteration: yakul altalib taam alghada

arabic: هو ياكل طماطم و جزر
english: He eats tomato and carrot.
transliteration: huwa yakul tamatim wa jazar

arabic: مساء الخير كيف حالك
english: Good evening how are you
transliteration: Masa al khayr kayfa haluka

arabic: انا بخير شكرا نحن نجهز لحفلة الزفاف
english: I am fine thank you we are preparing for the wedding party
transliteration: Ana bi khayr shukran nahnu nujahhiz li haflat az zafaf

arabic: انا ازور السوق كل صباح واشتري الورد
english: I visit the market every morning and buy flowers
transliteration: Ana azur as suq kulla sabah wa ashtari al ward

arabic: اختي تطبخ طعام الحفلة كل مساء
english: My sister cooks the party food every evening
transliteration: Ukhti tatbukh taam al hafla kulla masa

arabic: العمل كثير ولكن العائلة سعيدة جدا
english: The work is a lot but the family is very happy
transliteration: Al amal kathir wa lakin al aila saida jiddan

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد اخي واقضي وقتا مع عائلتي
english: Today is my brother's birthday and I spend time with my family.
transliteration: Alyawm eed meelad akhee wa aqdhee waqtan maa aailatee

arabic: هذه عائلتي ونحن نحتفل معا في البيت
english: This is my family and we celebrate together in the house.
transliteration: Hadhihi aailatee wa nahnu nahtafulu maan fee albayt

arabic: تطبخ امي وليمة كبيرة من الطعام العربي اللذيذ
english: My mother cooks a big feast of delicious Arabic food.
transliteration: Tatbukhu ummee waleematon kabeeraton min attaaam alarabee alladheeth

arabic: يقدم ابي هدية جميلة لاخي بعد تناول العشاء
english: My father presents a beautiful gift to my brother after eating dinner.
transliteration: Yuqaddimu abee hadiyyatan jameelatan liakhee bada tanaawul alashaa

arabic: هو يقضي وقتا سعيدا معنا ويتناول الحلوى
english: He spends a happy time with us and eats sweets.
transliteration: Huwa yaqdhee waqtan saeedan maana wa yatanaawalu alhalwa

arabic: اجلس في المقهى واقول مساء الخير للرجل
english: I sit in the cafe and say good evening to the man.
transliteration: ajlisu fi al-maqha wa-aqulu masa al-khayr lil-rajul.

arabic: يقول الرجل مساء النور كيف حالك
english: The man says good evening how are you.
transliteration: yaqulu al-rajul masa an-nur kayfa haluka.

arabic: اقول انا بخير شكرا وما اسمك
english: I say I am fine thank you and what is your name.
transliteration: aqulu ana bi-khayr shukran wa-ma ismuka.

arabic: يقول الرجل انا النادل واسمي طارق
english: The man says I am the waiter and my name is Tariq.
transliteration: yaqulu al-rajul ana al-nadil wa-ismi Tariq.

arabic: طارق يجلس على الطاولة وياكل طعامي
english: Tariq sits on the table and eats my food.
transliteration: Tariq yajlisu ala al-tawila wa-yakulu taami.

arabic: اقترب الطفل الفضولي من الرجل المتعب وقال السلام عليكم صباح الخير
english: The curious child approached the tired man and said hello good morning
transliteration: iqtarab al tifl al fuduli min al rajul al mutab wa qal al salam alaykum sabah al khayr

arabic: ابتسم الرجل بلطف رغم تعبه واجاب صباح النور
english: The man smiled gently despite his fatigue and answered good morning
transliteration: ibtasam al rajul bi lutf raghma taabih wa ajab sabah al nur

arabic: استمر الطفل في الكلام وقال كيف حالك وما اسمك
english: The child continued talking and said how are you and what is your name
transliteration: istamar al tifl fi al kalam wa qal kayfa haluk wa ma ismuk

arabic: شعر الرجل بالارهاق من الاسئلة المستمرة لكنه تنهد وقال انا بخير
english: The man felt exhausted from the continuous questions but he sighed and said I am fine
transliteration: shaar al rajul bi al irhaq min al asila al mustamira lakinnahu tanahhad wa qal ana bi khayr

arabic: ركضت الام مسرعة لتبعد طفلها وتعتذر عن فضوله الكبير
english: The mother ran quickly to pull her child away and apologize for his great curiosity
transliteration: rakadat al umm musria li tubid tiflaha wa taatazhir an fudulih al kabir

arabic: تعيش أمينة في منزل متنوع مع عائلتها المضيفة الأم المسيحية ماري والابن الملحد جون.
english: Amina lives in a diverse house with her host family, the Christian mother Mary and the atheist son John.
transliteration: Taeish amina fi manzil mutanawwi maa ailatiha almudifa alum almasihiya mari walibn almulhid jun.

arabic: أنا أزورهم كثيرا وألاحظ دائما الانسجام الجميل بينهم.
english: I visit them often and I always notice the beautiful harmony between them.
transliteration: Ana azuruhum kathiran waulahidh daiman alinsijam aljamil baynahum.

arabic: في الصباح تصلي أمينة صلاة الفجر بينما تقرأ ماري كتابها المقدس.
english: In the morning, Amina prays the dawn prayer while Mary reads her holy book.
transliteration: Fi alsabah tusalli amina salat alfajr baynama taqra mari kitabaha almuqaddas.

arabic: يشرب جون عادة قهوته ويقرأ المقالات العلمية بهدوء.
english: John usually drinks his coffee and reads the scientific articles quietly.
transliteration: Yashrabu jun adatan qahwatahu wayaqra almaqalat alilmiya bihudu.

arabic: البارحة اجتمعنا حول طاولة الطعام لنتناول العشاء معا.
english: Yesterday we gathered around the food table to eat dinner together.
transliteration: Albariha ijtamana hawla tawilat altaam linatanawal alasha maan.

arabic: طبخت ماري وجبة لذيذة واحترمت قيود أمينة الغذائية.
english: Mary cooked a delicious meal and she respected Amina's dietary restrictions.
transliteration: Tabakhat mari wajba ladhidha wahtaramat quyud amina alghidhaiya.

arabic: ابتسمت أمينة وقالت شكرا لك على الطعام الحلال.
english: Amina smiled and said, thank you for the halal food.
transliteration: Ibtasamat amina waqalat shukran liki ala altaam alhalal.

arabic: سألها جون عن قواعد الصيام خلال شهر رمضان.
english: John asked her about the rules of fasting during the month of Ramadan.
transliteration: Saalaha jun an qawaid alsiyam khilal shahr ramadan.

arabic: أجابت أمينة سوف تفهم تقاليدنا عندما تصوم معنا يوما.
english: Amina answered, you will understand our traditions when you fast with us for a day.
transliteration: Ajabat amina sawfa tafham taqalidana indama tasum maana yawman.

arabic: المعتقدات المختلفة لا تفرق هذه العائلة المحبة أبدا.
english: The different beliefs do not divide this loving family at all.
transliteration: Almutaqadat almukhtalifa la tufarriq hadhihi alaila almuhibba abadan.

arabic: هم يحتفلون بالأعياد معا ويتبادلون الهدايا والذكريات السعيدة.
english: They celebrate the holidays together and exchange gifts and happy memories.
transliteration: Hum yahtafulun bilaayad maan wayatabadalun alhadaya waladhikrayat alsaeida.

arabic: في الشهر الماضي اشترت العائلة سجادة صلاة جميلة لأمينة.
english: In the past month, the family bought a beautiful prayer rug for Amina.
transliteration: Fi alshahr almadi ishtarat alaila sajjadat salat jamila liamina.

arabic: نحن نتعلم من حياتهم اليومية أن الاحترام المتبادل يبني العلاقات.
english: We learn from their daily lives that mutual respect builds relationships.
transliteration: Nahnu nataallam min hayatihim alyawmiya anna alihtiram almutabadil yabni alalaqat.

arabic: سألت أمينة عن مشاعرها وعبرت عن سعادتها العميقة.
english: I asked Amina about her feelings and she expressed her deep happiness.
transliteration: Saaltu amina an mashairiha waabbarat an saadatiha alameqa.

arabic: يمكنك أن ترى الحب والتسامح في منزلهم المشترك.
english: You can see the love and the tolerance in their shared house.
transliteration: Yumkinuka an tara alhub waltasamuh fi manzilihim almushtarak.

arabic: تجتمع العائلة حول المائدة الكبيرة وتملا رائحة الطعام اللذيذ المكان
english: The family gathers around the large table and the smell of delicious food fills the place.
transliteration: Tajtamiu al aila hawla al maida al kabira wa tamla raihat at taam al ladhidh al makan

arabic: هم يتبادلون القصص والضحكات في حالة من الانسجام التام
english: They exchange stories and laughs in a state of complete harmony.
transliteration: Hum yatabadalun al qisas wa ad dahikat fi halat min al insijam at tam

arabic: ياكل الجميع بدون قيود وينسون قواعد العمل الصارمة
english: Everyone eats without restrictions and they forget the strict rules of work.
transliteration: Yaakulu al jami bidun quyud wa yansawna qawaid al amal as sarima

arabic: تسال الام ابنتها هل قضيت وقتا جميلا مع عائلتك
english: The mother asks her daughter have you spent a nice time with your family.
transliteration: Tasalu al umm ibnataha hal qadayti waqtan jamilan maa aailatiki

arabic: تظهر هذه الوجبة الدافئة التسامح والمعتقدات الجميلة في بيتنا
english: This warm meal shows tolerance and beautiful beliefs in our home.
transliteration: Tuzhiru hadhihi al wajba ad dafia at tasamuh wa al muataqadat al jamila fi baytina

arabic: عذراً يا أستاذ سالم، هل قلتَ للتو إننا سنجري المحادثة في منزلك، بينما اتفقنا على اللقاء هنا في مقهى الأندلس بشارع المتنبي؟
english: Excuse me, Mr. Salem, did you just say that we will conduct the conversation in your home, while we agreed to meet here at Al Andalus Cafe on Al Mutanabbi Street?
transliteration: 'Udhran ya ustaadh Salim, hal qulta lit-tawwi innana sanujree al-muhadathah fee manzilika, baynama ittafaqna 'ala al-liqaa' huna fee maqha Al-Andalus bi-shari' Al-Mutanabbi?
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: أهلاً دكتورة فاطمة، يبدو أن هناك سوء فهم؛ إذ قصدتُ أنني أُحب قضاء الوقت في المنزل، غير أنني مستعد لإجراء المقابلة الصحفية هنا الآن.
english: Welcome Dr. Fatima, it seems there is a misunderstanding; as I meant that I love spending time at home, however I am ready to conduct the journalistic interview here now.
transliteration: Ahlan daktoorah Fatima, yabdoo anna hunaka soo' fahm; idh qasadtu annanee uhibbu qadaa' al-waqt fee al-manzil, ghayra annanee musta'idd li-ijraa' al-muqabalah as-suhufiyyah huna al-aan.
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: فهمتُكَ الآن يا سالم، هل طلبتَ لنا قهوة عربية بالهيل قبل أن نبدأ، أم أطلبها أنا مع بعض التمر؟
english: I understand you now, Salem, did you order us Arabic coffee with cardamom before we begin, or should I order it with some dates?
transliteration: Fahimtuka al-aan ya Salim, hal talabta lana qahwah 'arabiyyah bil-hayl qabla an nabda', am atlubuha ana ma'a ba'd at-tamr?
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: لقد طلبتُ القهوة ودفعْتُ خمسين درهماً، لكنني أبحث عن الموقع الدقيق لمهرجان التسامح الذي تحتفلون به غداً.
english: I have ordered the coffee and paid fifty dirhams, but I am looking for the exact location of the Tolerance Festival that you all celebrate tomorrow.
transliteration: Laqad talabtu al-qahwah wa dafa'tu khamseen dirhaman, lakinnanee abhathu 'an al-mawqi' ad-daqeeq li-mahrajan at-tasamuh alladhee tahtafiloon bihi ghadan.
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: أليس المهرجان في ساحة الجامعة الرئيسية، حيث نجتمع دائماً لتبادل الأحاديث الثقافية المشتركة؟
english: Isn't the festival in the main university square, where we always gather to exchange shared cultural conversations?
transliteration: Alaysa al-mahrajan fee sahat al-jami'ah ar-ra'eesiyyah, haythu najtami'u da'iman li-tabadul al-ahadeeth ath-thaqafiyyah al-mushtarakah?
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: أجاب المصدر الحكومي بأن الموقع قد تغير بسبب قواعد الأمان الجديدة، وهذا ما أثار قلقي كصحفي يبحث عن الدقة.
english: The government source answered that the location has changed due to the new safety rules, and this is what raised my concern as a journalist searching for accuracy.
transliteration: Ajaba al-masdar al-hukoomee bi-anna al-mawqi' qad taghayyara bi-sabab qawa'id al-aman al-jadeedah, wa hadha ma athara qalaqee ka-suhufee yabhathu 'an ad-diqqah.
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: يا للعجب، لم أسمع بهذه القيود من قبل، فهل يجب علينا تغيير خطتنا وتأجيل زيارة المعرض؟
english: Oh my surprise, I have not heard of these restrictions before, so must we change our plan and postpone visiting the exhibition?
transliteration: Ya lal-'ajab, lam asma' bi-hadhihi al-quyood min qabl, fa-hal yajibu 'alayna taghyeer khuttatina wa ta'jeel ziyarat al-ma'rid?
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: لا داعي للتأجيل، فقد تواصلتُ مع المنظمين وأكدوا لي أن الاحتفال سيكون في القاعة الكبرى، وهو مكان مريح جداً.
english: There is no need for postponement, as I have communicated with the organizers and they assured me that the celebration will be in the grand hall, and it is a very comfortable place.
transliteration: La da'ee lit-ta'jeel, fa-qad tawasaltu ma'a al-munazzimeen wa akkadoo lee anna al-ihtifal sayakoon fee al-qa'ah al-kubra, wa huwa makan mureeh jiddan.
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: هذا رائع، إذاً سنقضي وقتاً جميلاً في المهرجان، وبعدها سأعود لأقضي وقتاً مع عائلتي.
english: That is wonderful, then we will spend a beautiful time at the festival, and afterwards I will return to spend time with my family.
transliteration: Hadha ra'i', idhan sanaqdee waqtan jameelan fee al-mahrajan, wa ba'daha sa-a'oodu li-aqdee waqtan ma'a 'a'ilatee.
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: بالتأكيد، فوجود الانسجام بين العمل والحياة الشخصية أمر ضروري، أليس كذلك؟
english: Absolutely, for the existence of harmony between work and personal life is a necessary matter, is it not?
transliteration: Bit-ta'keed, fa-wujood al-insijam bayna al-'amal wa al-hayah ash-shakhsiyyah amr darooree, alaysa kadhalik?
storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

arabic: اذهب الى السوق مع عائلتي لشراء ملابس
english: I go to the market with my family to buy clothes.
transliteration: adhhab ila alsouq ma'a aa'ilatee lishiraa malaabis

arabic: هذه عائلتي وعندنا وقت طويل
english: This is my family and we have a lot of time.
transliteration: hadhihi aa'ilatee wa'indana waqt taweel

arabic: يشتري ابي ثوب ابيض تقليدي
english: My father buys a traditional white thobe.
transliteration: yashtaree abee thawb abyad taqleedee

arabic: نشرب شاي ساخن مع البائع
english: We drink hot tea with the seller.
transliteration: nashrab shaay saakhin ma'a albaa'i'

arabic: نحن سعداء بالملابس الجديدة
english: We are happy with the new clothes.
transliteration: nahn su'adaa bilmalaabis aljadeeda

arabic: بينما كنت اشرب القهوة في المقهى رأيت صديقي القديم طارق صدفة
english: While I was drinking coffee in the cafe I saw my old friend Tariq by chance
transliteration: Baynama kuntu ashrabu al-qahwa fi al-maqha ra'aytu sadiqi al-qadim Tariq sudfatan

arabic: اقترب مني مبتسما وقال السلام عليكم صباح الخير
english: He approached me smiling and said hello good morning
transliteration: Iqtaraba minni mubtasiman wa qala as-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr

arabic: وقفت بسعادة واجبته صباح النور كيف حالك
english: I stood up happily and answered him good morning how are you
transliteration: Waqaftu bi-sa'ada wa ajabtuhu sabah an-nur kayfa haluka

arabic: عانقني بحرارة وقال انا بخير شكرا
english: He hugged me warmly and said I am fine thank you
transliteration: Anaqani bi-harara wa qala ana bi-khayr shukran

arabic: جلسنا معا لساعة نتبادل الاخبار ونتحدث عن ذكرياتنا الجميلة
english: We sat together for an hour to exchange news and talk about our beautiful memories
transliteration: Jalasna ma'an li-sa'a natabadal al-akhbar wa nathadath an dhikrayatina al-jamila

arabic: يذهب احمد الى الدكان
english: Ahmad goes to the shop
transliteration: yathhab ahmad ila addukan

arabic: هو يحمل القميص الجديد
english: He carries the new shirt
transliteration: huwa yahmil alqamees aljadeed

arabic: القميص كبير على احمد
english: The shirt is big on Ahmad
transliteration: alqamees kabeer ala ahmad

arabic: يعيد احمد القميص الى التاجر
english: Ahmad returns the shirt to the merchant
transliteration: yueed ahmad alqamees ila attajir

arabic: ياخذ احمد القميص الصغير
english: Ahmad takes the small shirt
transliteration: yakhuth ahmad alqamees assagheer

arabic: ذهب الأصدقاء إلى متجر كبير لشراء ملابس جديدة
english: The friends went to a large store to buy new clothes.
transliteration: dhahaba al asdiqa ila matjar kabir lishira malabis jadida

arabic: هم يتبادلون الآراء حول الألوان وقواعد الموضة الحديثة
english: They exchange opinions about colors and modern fashion rules.
transliteration: hum yatabadalun al ara hawla al alwan wa qawaid al mawda al haditha

arabic: قال أحمد أريد قميصا أزرق لأنه يعكس الانسجام والهدوء
english: Ahmad said I want a blue shirt because it reflects harmony and calmness.
transliteration: qala ahmad uridu qamisan azraq liannahu yaakis al insijam wa al hudu

arabic: رد البائع هذا الخيار ممتاز وسعره مناسب جدا
english: The seller replied this choice is excellent and its price is very suitable.
transliteration: radda al baia hadha al khiyar mumtaz wa siruhu munasib jiddan

arabic: دفع أحمد ثمن القميص وشكر البائع على مساعدته
english: Ahmad paid the price of the shirt and thanked the seller for his help.
transliteration: dafaa ahmad thaman al qamis wa shakara al baia ala musadatihi

arabic: يا خالد، هل يمكنك مساعدتي في اختيار وجبة سريعة من تطبيق "كرم الشام"، حيث أنني كمعلمة لغة عربية مرهقة جداً من تصحيح الامتحانات في شقتنا بحي الدقي في هذا اليوم الممطر؟
english: O Khalid, can you help me choose a fast meal from the "Karam Al-Sham" application, since I as an Arabic language teacher am very exhausted from grading the exams in our Al-Dokki neighborhood apartment on this rainy day?
transliteration: Ya Khalid, hal yumkinuka musa'adati fi ikhtiyar wajba sari'a min tatbiq "Karam Al-Sham", haythu annani kumu'allimat lugha 'arabiyya murhaqa jiddan min tashih al-imtihanat fi shaqqatina bihayy Al-Duqqi fi hadha al-yawm al-mumtir?
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: بالتأكيد يا آمنة، إذ يبدو أن العمل قد استنزف طاقتك بينما كنت أنا أكتب مقالي الصحفي؛ فما رأيك في طلب وجبتي شاورما بسعر مائة وخمسين جنيهاً مصرياً؟
english: Certainly Amna, as it seems that work has drained your energy while I was writing my journalistic article; so what do you think about ordering two shawarma meals at the price of one hundred and fifty Egyptian pounds?
transliteration: Bi-t-ta'kid ya Amina, idh yabdu anna al-'amal qad istanzafa taqatak baynama kuntu ana aktubu maqali as-suhufi; fama ra'yuk fi talab wajbatay shawarma bisi'r mi'a wa khamsin junayhan misriyyan?
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: حسناً... أوافقك الرأي، غير أنني أتساءل: هل صلينا صلاة العصر، أم أننا نسيناها وسط هذا التعب المفرط؟
english: Well... I agree with your opinion, however I wonder: did we pray the Asr prayer, or did we forget it amidst this excessive fatigue?
transliteration: Hasanan... uwafiquka ar-ra'y, ghayra annani atasa'al: hal sallayna salat al-'asr, am annana nasinaha wasat hadha at-ta'ab al-mufrit?
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: أوه، لقد نسيت تماماً بسبب انشغالي بالأخبار العاجلة، دعنا إذن نؤدي صلاتنا أولاً ثم نطلب طعامنا اللذيذ.
english: Oh, I completely forgot due to my busyness with the breaking news, let us then perform our prayer first then order our delicious food.
transliteration: Oh, laqad nasitu tamaman bisabab inshighali bil-akhbar al-'ajila, da'na idhan nu'addi salatana awwalan thumma natlub ta'amana al-ladhidh.
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: فكرة ممتازة، لأنني أحتاج حقاً إلى الوضوء بالماء البارد كي أستعيد نشاطي المفقود قبل تناول تلك الشاورما الساخنة.
english: Excellent idea, because I really need to perform ablution with cold water in order to regain my lost energy before eating that hot shawarma.
transliteration: Fikra mumtaza, li-annani ahtaju haqqan ila al-wudu' bil-ma' al-barid kay asta'ida nashati al-mafqud qabla tanawul tilka ash-shawarma as-sakhina.
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: عظيم، سأقوم أنا بتجهيز سجادات الصلاة في غرفة الجلوس، بينما تقومين أنتِ باختيار الإضافات التي تفضلينها مع وجباتنا.
english: Great, I will prepare the prayer rugs in the living room, while you choose the additions which you prefer with our meals.
transliteration: 'Azim, sa'aqumu ana bitajhiz sajjadat as-salah fi ghurfat al-julus, baynama taqumina anti bi-ikhtiyar al-idafat allati tufaddilinaha ma'a wajbatina.
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: عفواً، لقد لاحظت للتو مشكلة صغيرة؛ التطبيق يخبرني أن خدمة التوصيل متوقفة مؤقتاً بسبب غزارة الأمطار في شوارع القاهرة!
english: Excuse me, I just noticed a small problem; the application tells me that the delivery service is temporarily suspended due to the heavy rains in the streets of Cairo!
transliteration: 'Afwan, laqad lahaẓtu lit-taww mushkila saghira; at-tatbiq yukhbiruni anna khidmat at-tawsil mutawaqqifa mu'aqqatan bisabab ghazarat al-amtar fi shuwari' al-qahira!
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: أليس من الأفضل إذن أن نطبخ المعكرونة التي اشتريناها أمس، بدلاً من الانتظار لساعات طويلة بلا جدوى؟
english: Isn't it better then that we cook the pasta which we bought yesterday, instead of waiting for long hours uselessly?
transliteration: Alaysa min al-afdal idhan an natbukha al-ma'karuna allati ishtaraynaha amsi, badalan min al-intizar lisa'at tawila bila jadwa?
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: معك حق، فالمعكرونة بصلصة الطماطم ستكون دافئة ومريحة، وسنوفر بذلك نقودنا وأوقاتنا في هذا الجو العاصف.
english: You are right, for the pasta with tomato sauce will be warm and comforting, and we will thereby save our money and our times in this stormy weather.
transliteration: Ma'aka haqq, fal-ma'karuna bisalsat at-tamatim satakunu dafi'a wa murihah, wa sanuwaffiru bidhalika nuqudana wa awqatana fi hadha al-jaww al-'asif.
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: اتفقنا، فلنصلِّ العصر الآن بخشوع، وبعدها سنتعاون معاً في إعداد عشاء عائلي بسيط داخل مطبخنا الدافئ.
english: Agreed, so let us pray Asr now with reverence, and after it we will cooperate together in preparing a simple family dinner inside our warm kitchen.
transliteration: Ittafaqna, falnusalli al-'asr al-'an bikhushu', wa ba'daha sanata'awan ma'an fi i'dad 'asha' 'a'ili basit dakhil matbakhina ad-dafi'.
storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

arabic: ذهب سامي الى متجر الملابس
english: Sami went to the clothing store.
transliteration: thahaba sami ila matjar almalabis

arabic: اختار قميصا ازرق للعمل
english: He chose a blue shirt for work.
transliteration: ikhtara qamisan azraq lilamal

arabic: دفع سامي المال للعامل
english: Sami paid the money to the worker.
transliteration: dafaa sami almal lilamil

arabic: رجع الى البيت وهو سعيد
english: He returned to the house and he is happy.
transliteration: rajaa ila albayt wahuwa saeed

arabic: فتح الحقيبة ووجد تنورة صغيرة
english: He opened the bag and found a small skirt.
transliteration: fataha alhaqiba wawajada tannoura saghira

arabic: اذهب الى بيت جدي اليوم
english: I go to my grandfather's house today.
transliteration: adhhabu ila bayt jaddi al yawm
storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

arabic: يفتح جدي الباب بابتسامة كبيرة
english: My grandfather opens the door with a big smile.
transliteration: yaftahu jaddi al bab bibtisama kabira
storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

arabic: نجلس في غرفة الجلوس ونشرب الشاي
english: We sit in the living room and drink tea.
transliteration: najlisu fi ghurfat al julus wa nashrabu al shay
storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

arabic: تعطيني جدتي الكعك اللذيذ
english: My grandmother gives me delicious cake.
transliteration: tuutini jaddati al kaak al ladhidh
storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

arabic: انا سعيد مع عائلتي
english: I am happy with my family.
transliteration: ana said maa aailati
storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

arabic: ذهب الجد مع حفيده الى السوق الكبير اليوم
english: The grandfather went with his grandson to the big market today.
transliteration: Dhahaba al-jadd ma'a hafidihi ila as-suqi al-kabiri al-yawm.

arabic: اراد الجد ان يشتري كتابا قديما وبعض الخضروات
english: The grandfather wanted to buy an old book and some vegetables.
transliteration: Arada al-jadd an yashtariya kitaban qadiman wa ba'da al-khudrawat.

arabic: لكن الحفيد الصغير فضل هاتفا جديدا من بائع مختلف
english: But the young grandson preferred a new phone from a different seller.
transliteration: Lakinna al-hafida as-saghir fadala hatifan jadidan min ba'i'in mukhtalifin.

arabic: فهم الناس في السوق هذا الاختلاف بين الاجيال دائما
english: The people in the market always understood this difference between generations.
transliteration: Fahima an-nas fi as-suqi hadha al-ikhtilaf bayna al-ajyal da'iman.

arabic: السوق مكان يجمع الجديد والقديم معا في كل يوم
english: The market is a place that brings together the new and the old every day.
transliteration: As-suqu makanun yajma'u al-jadida wal-qadima ma'an fi kulli yawm.

arabic: أدرك الدكتور نبيل أستاذ التاريخ البالغ من العمر اثنين وأربعين عاما بخوف شديد أن الموعد النهائي لدفع رسوم النشر قد حل ومحفظته فارغة تماما.
english: Dr. Nabil, a forty-two-year-old history professor, realized with extreme fear that the final deadline to pay the publishing fees had arrived, and his wallet was completely empty.
transliteration: adraka ad-duktur nabil ustadh at-tarikh al-baligh min al-umr ithnayn wa-arba'in aaman bi-khawfin shadidin anna al-mawid an-niha'iy li-daf'i rusum an-nashri qad halla wa-mahfazatahu farighatun tamaman.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: لذا اندفع نحو فرع بنك مصر الواقع في شارع الجامعة محاولا ترتيب أفكاره المشتتة بينما يتصبب عرقا.
english: Therefore, he rushed toward the Bank Misr branch located on University Street, trying to organize his scattered thoughts while dripping with sweat.
transliteration: lidha indafa'a nahwa far'i banki misr al-waqi'i fi shari'i al-jami'ati muhawilan tartiba afkarihi al-mushattatati baynama yatasabbabu araqan.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: قال لموظف الصرافة بصوت متقطع يفتقر إلى هدوئه المعتاد عذرا هل يمكنني سحب خمسة آلاف جنيه مصري فورا من حسابي؟
english: He said to the teller with a broken voice lacking his usual calmness, excuse me, can I withdraw five thousand Egyptian pounds immediately from my account?
transliteration: qala li-muwazzafi as-sirafati bi-sawtin mutaqatti'in yaftaqiru ila hudu'ihi al-mu'tadi udhran hal yumkinuni sahbu khamsati alafi junayhin misriyyin fawran min hisabi?
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: استلم أوراقه النقدية الجديدة وعدها بدقة شديدة ثم دسها في حقيبته الجلدية المهترئة.
english: He received his crisp new banknotes, counted them with extreme precision, then tucked them into his worn leather bag.
transliteration: istalama awraqahu an-naqdiyyata al-jadidata wa-addaha bi-diqqatin shadidatin thumma dassaha fi haqibatihi al-jildiyyati al-muhtari'ati.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: بينما كان يغادر البنك لاحظ زحاما مروريا خانقا فقرر أن ركوب الحافلة العامة رقم أربعين هو الخيار الوحيد للوصول في الوقت المحدد.
english: While he was leaving the bank, he noticed suffocating traffic congestion, so he decided that riding public bus number forty was the only option to arrive on time.
transliteration: baynama kana yughadiru al-banka lahaza zihaman mururiyyan khaniqan fa-qarrara anna rukuba al-hafilati al-'ammati raqmi arba'ina huwa al-khiyaru al-wahidu lil-wusuli fi al-waqti al-muhaddadi.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: صعد إلى الحافلة المزدحمة بالطلاب والعمال ودفع تذكرة بخمسة جنيهات للمحصل الذي كان يصيح بصوت جهوري.
english: He boarded the bus crowded with students and workers, and paid a five-pound ticket to the conductor who was shouting with a booming voice.
transliteration: sa'ida ila al-hafilati al-muzdahimati bi-at-tullabi wa-al-'ummali wa-dafa'a tadhkaratan bi-khamsati junayhatin lil-muhassili alladhi kana yasihu bi-sawtin jahuriyyin.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: شقت الحافلة طريقها بصعوبة نحو وسط البلد حيث تتقاطع شوارع القاهرة القديمة مع المباني ذات الطراز المعماري الأوروبي.
english: The bus navigated its way with difficulty toward Downtown, where the streets of old Cairo intersect with buildings of European architectural style.
transliteration: shaqqati al-hafilatu tariqaha bi-su'ubatin nahwa wasati al-baladi haythu tataqata'u shawari'u al-qahirati al-qadimati ma'a al-mabani dhati at-tirazi al-mi'mariyyi al-urubbiyyi.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: غير أن نبيلا اكتشف فجأة أنه نسي عنوان المطبعة فتساءل في نفسه بقلق بالغ أين دونت ذلك العنوان اللعين؟
english: However, Nabil suddenly discovered that he forgot the address of the printing press, so he asked himself with extreme anxiety, where did I write down that damned address?
transliteration: ghayra anna nabilan iktashafa faj'atan annahu nasiya unwana al-matba'ati fa-tasa'ala fi nafsihi bi-qalaqin balighin ayna dawwantu dhalika al-unwana al-la'ina?
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: لحسن الحظ وجد قصاصة ورق صغيرة بجوار إيصال السحب البنكي مكتوبا عليها ميدان التحرير بجوار مطعم أبو طارق للكشري.
english: Fortunately, he found a small scrap of paper next to the bank withdrawal receipt, with written on it: Tahrir Square, next to Abu Tariq Koshary restaurant.
transliteration: li-husni al-hazhi wajada qusasata waraqin saghiratan bi-jiwari isali as-sahbi al-bankiyyi maktuban alayha maydanu at-tahriri bi-jiwari mat'ami abu tariqin lil-kushari.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: نزل من الحافلة بخطوات سريعة وواثقة متجها نحو المطبعة لإنقاذ كتابه المنتظر من الضياع.
english: He stepped off the bus with quick and confident steps, heading toward the printing press to save his awaited book from being lost.
transliteration: nazala min al-hafilati bi-khutuwatin sari'atin wa-wathiqatin muttajihan nahwa al-matba'ati li-inqadhi kitabihi al-muntazari min ad-daya'i.
storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

arabic: كان الصباح مزدحما في بيت السيد احمد
english: The morning was busy in Mr. Ahmed's house.
transliteration: Kana al-sabah muzdahiman fi bayt al-sayyid Ahmad

arabic: ابنته سارة كانت تستمع للموسيقى وتجهز نفسها بسرعة للعمل
english: His daughter Sarah was listening to music and quickly getting ready for work.
transliteration: Ibnatuhu Sara kanat tastami' lil-musica wa tujahhiz nafsaha bisur'a lil-amal

arabic: اما السيد احمد فكان يفضل شرب قهوته بهدوء وقراءة الاخبار
english: As for Mr. Ahmed, he preferred to drink his coffee calmly and read the news.
transliteration: Amma al-sayyid Ahmad fakan yufaddil shurb qahwatih bihudu' wa qira'at al-akhbar

arabic: كان لكل منهما قواعده الخاصة في التحضير لهذا اليوم
english: Each of them had their own rules for preparing for this day.
transliteration: Kana li-kull minhuma qawa'iduhu al-khassa fi al-tahdir li-hadha al-yawm

arabic: لم يتبادلا الكثير من الاحاديث لكنهما فهما ضرورة الانسجام في البيت
english: They did not exchange many conversations, but they understood the necessity of harmony in the house.
transliteration: Lam yatabadala al-kathir min al-ahadith lakinnahoma fahima darurat al-insijam fi al-bayt

arabic: مساء الخير اليوم قررت ان اطبخ طبقا جديدا لأول مرة
english: Good evening, today I decided to cook a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr al-yawm qarartu an atbukha tabaqan jadidan li'awwali marrah.

arabic: جمعت المكونات كلها وقرات الوصفة بعناية في كتاب الطبخ
english: I gathered all the ingredients and read the recipe carefully in the cookbook.
transliteration: Jama'tu al-mukawwinat kullaha wa qara'tu al-wasfah bi'inayah fi kitab at-tabkh.

arabic: بدأت الطبخ بحماس كبير ولكن المهمة كانت اصعب مما توقعت
english: I started cooking with great enthusiasm, but the task was harder than I expected.
transliteration: Bada'tu at-tabkh bihamas kabir walakinna al-muhimmah kanat as'ab mimma tawqa'tu.

arabic: بعد ساعات طويلة اصبح الطبق جاهزا والرائحة كانت شهية جدا
english: After long hours, the dish was ready, and the smell was very delicious.
transliteration: Ba'da sa'at tawilah asbaha at-tabaq jahizan wa ar-ra'ihah kanat shahiyyah jiddan.

arabic: لكن عندما جاءت امي قالت هذا طعام القط يا احمد
english: But when my mother came, she said, "This is the cat's food, Ahmed."
transliteration: Lakin 'indama ja'at ummi qalat hadha ta'am al-qitt ya Ahmad.

arabic: أحمد يستيقظ في الصباح في منزله الكبير
english: Ahmad wakes up in the morning in his big house.
transliteration: Ahmad yastayqidh fi al-sabah fi manzilihi al-kabir.

arabic: هو يريد أن يشرب القهوة لكنه لا يجد الكوب
english: He wants to drink coffee but he doesn't find the cup.
transliteration: Huwa yurid an yashraba al-qahwah lakinahu la yajid al-kub.

arabic: أحمد يبحث عن الكوب في كل غرفة
english: Ahmad looks for the cup in every room.
transliteration: Ahmad yabhat 'an al-kub fi kull ghurfah.

arabic: تحت السرير وفي المطبخ وعلى الطاولة هو لا يرى شيئا
english: Under the bed and in the kitchen and on the table, he sees nothing.
transliteration: Tahta al-sarir wa fi al-matbakh wa 'ala al-tawilah huwa la yara shay'an.

arabic: هذه مشكلة كبيرة جدا ماذا سيفعل الآن ليشرب القهوة
english: This is a very big problem. What will he do now to drink coffee?
transliteration: Hadhihi mushkilah kabirah jiddan madha sayaf'alu al'an liyashraba al-qahwah.

arabic: في المساء ذهبت الى بيت خالتي
english: In the evening I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: Fi al-masaa' dhahabtu ila bayti khalati.

arabic: طرقت الباب وقالت هي اهلا
english: I knocked on the door and she said welcome.
transliteration: Taraqtu al-baba wa qalat hiya ahlan.

arabic: القيت السلام عليها
english: I gave her greetings (peace).
transliteration: Alqaytu al-salama alayha.

arabic: شربت بعض الماء وتحدثنا
english: I drank some water and we talked.
transliteration: Sharibtu ba'da al-ma'i wa tahaddathna.

arabic: كان المساء جميلا مع العائلة
english: The evening was beautiful with the family.
transliteration: Kana al-masaa'u jamilan ma'a al-a'ilati.

arabic: لاحظت سارة ان الفستان الذي اشترته لم يكن مناسبا لها
english: Sarah noticed that the dress she bought was not suitable for her
transliteration: Lahazat Sarah anna al-fustan alladhi ishtarat-hu lam yakun munasiban laha

arabic: شعرت بقليل من التردد لكنها قررت اعادته الى المتجر
english: She felt a little hesitation but decided to return it to the shop
transliteration: Sha'arat bi-qaleelin min at-taraddud lakinna-ha qarrarat i'adatahu ila al-matjar

arabic: عندما وصلت الى المحل تبادلت الحديث باحترام مع البائع الذي فهم موقفها
english: When she arrived at the shop, she exchanged conversations with respect with the seller who understood her situation
transliteration: Indama wasalat ila al-mahall tabadalat al-hadith bi-ihtiram ma'a al-ba'i' alladhi fahima mawqifaha

arabic: بعد ان اعادت الفستان بنجاح شعرت براحة كبيرة وزاد نشاطها
english: After successfully returning the dress, she felt great comfort and her energy increased
transliteration: Ba'da an a'adat al-fustan bi-najah sha'arat bi-rahah kabirah wa zada nashatuha

arabic: كان هذا الموقف يحتاج الى اعداد جيد منها قبل الذهاب
english: This situation required good preparation from her before going
transliteration: Kana hadha al-mawqif yahtaju ila i'dad jayyid minha qabl adh-dhihab

arabic: في المساء كان الجد يشاهد الاخبار على التلفاز
english: In the evening, the grandfather was watching the news on television.
transliteration: Fi al-masa' kana al-jadd yushahid al-akhbar ala al-tilfaz.

arabic: الحفيدة ليلى تريد ان تستخدم الانترنت بسرعة
english: The granddaughter Layla wants to use the internet quickly.
transliteration: Al-hafida Layla turid an tastakhdim al-internet bi-sur'a.

arabic: الجد قال لليلى مساء الخير كيف حالك هذا الانترنت يعمل ببطء عندي
english: The grandfather said to Layla: "Good evening, how are you? This internet works slowly for me."
transliteration: Al-jadd qala li-Layla: "Masa' al-khayr kayfa haluki? Hadha al-internet ya'mal bi-but' ind-i."

arabic: ليلى كانت تريد حلا للمشكلة ولكن الجد كان سعيدا بمشاهدة التلفاز
english: Layla wanted a solution to the problem, but the grandfather was happy watching television.
transliteration: Layla kanat turid hallan lil-mushkila walakin al-jadd kana sa'idan bi-mushahadat al-tilfaz.

arabic: كل واحد منهما يرى العالم بطريقة مختلفة جدا
english: Each of them sees the world in a very different way.
transliteration: Kull wahid minhuma yara al-alam bi-tariqa mukhtalifa jiddan.

arabic: ذهبت الى مدينة جديدة مساء وكنت ابحث عن فندقي
english: I went to a new city in the evening and was looking for my hotel.
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila madinatin jadidatin masaa' wa kuntu abحثu 'an funduqi.

arabic: لكنني ضللت الطريق ولم اعرف اي اتجاه اسلك
english: But I got lost and did not know which way to take.
transliteration: Lakinnanee dallaltu at-tareeqa wa lam a'rif ayya ittijahin asluk.

arabic: لحسن الحظ رأيت رجلا يبدو عليه انه فاضل فسألته عن العنوان
english: Fortunately, I saw a man who seemed honorable, so I asked him for the address.
transliteration: Li-husni al-hazzi ra'aytu rajulan yabdoo 'alayhi annahu faadilun fa-sa'altuhu 'an al-'unwaan.

arabic: ابتسم الرجل وقدم لي وصفا دقيقا للطريق وكأن العلم نور
english: The man smiled and gave me precise directions, as if knowledge was light.
transliteration: Ibtasama ar-rajulu wa qaddama li wasfan daqeeqan lit-tareeqi wa ka'anna al-'ilma noorun.

arabic: وعندما وصلت الى الفندق عرفت انه المهندس الذي يخطط لمشروع ضخم في المدينة
english: And when I arrived at the hotel, I realized he was the engineer who was planning a huge project in the city.
transliteration: Wa 'indamaa wasaltu ila al-funduqi 'araftu annahu al-muhandisu alladhee yukhaṭṭiṭu li-mashroo'in ḍakhmin fi al-madeenah.

arabic: بدأت سارة واحمد التخطيط لاحتفال زفافهما الكبير بحماس شديد
english: Sarah and Ahmed began planning their big wedding celebration with great enthusiasm.
transliteration: Bada'at Sarah wa Ahmad al-takhteet li-ihtifal zafafihima al-kabeer bi-hamas shadeed.

arabic: عملا معا على كل التفاصيل من اختيار قاعة الحفل الى قائمة الضيوف والترتيبات الخاصة
english: They worked together on all the details, from choosing the ceremony hall to the guest list and special arrangements.
transliteration: Amila ma'an ala kull al-tafaseel min ikhtiyar qa'at al-hafl ila qa'imat al-duyuf wal-tartibat al-khassah.

arabic: كان تحديد الميزانية المناسبة وارسال بطاقات الدعوة مهمة تستغرق وقتا طويلا
english: Determining the appropriate budget and sending the invitation cards was a time-consuming task.
transliteration: Kana tahdeed al-mizaniyah al-munasibah wa irsal bitaqat al-da'wah muhimmah tastaghriq waqtan taweelan.

arabic: بعد شهور من الجهد والاجتماعات المكثفة اقترب موعد اليوم المنتظر بفارغ الصبر
english: After months of intense effort and meetings, the eagerly awaited day approached.
transliteration: Ba'da shuhour min al-juhd wal-ijtima'at al-mukaththafah iqtaraba maw'id al-yawm al-muntazar bi-farigh al-sabr.

arabic: لكن في اللحظة الاخيرة قررا الكشف عن مفاجأة ان الحفل كان للاحتفال بعيد ميلاد جدهما التسعين
english: But at the last moment, they decided to reveal the surprise that the party was to celebrate their grandfather's ninetieth birthday.
transliteration: Lakin fi al-lahdhah al-akheerah qarrara al-kashf an mufaja'ah anna al-hafl kana lil-ihtifal bi-eid milad jaddihima al-tis'een.

arabic: اليوم مطر كثير
english: Today there is much rain.
transliteration: Al-yawm matar katheer.

arabic: انا في البيت
english: I am in the house.
transliteration: Ana fi al-bayt.

arabic: انا اجلس في الغرفة قرب النافذة
english: I sit in the room near the window.
transliteration: Ana ajlis fi al-ghurfa qurb al-nafidha.

arabic: ارى المطر كبيرا وجميلا
english: I see big and beautiful rain.
transliteration: Ara al-matar kabeeran wa jameelan.

arabic: انا اشرب كوب شاي الان
english: I drink a cup of tea now.
transliteration: Ana ashrab koob shay al-aan.

arabic: امشي مع ابني الصغير في السوق مساء
english: I walk with my small son in the market in the evening.
transliteration: Amshi ma'a ibni as-sagheeri fi as-souqi masaa'an.

arabic: فجاة ضللنا الطريق ولم نعرف اين نذهب
english: Suddenly we lost the way and didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Faj'atan dalalna at-tareeqa wa lam na'rif ayna nadhhabu.

arabic: اقتربت من سيدة لطيفة وسالتها عن الاتجاهات بلطف
english: I approached a kind lady and asked her for directions gently.
transliteration: Iqtarabtu min sayyidatin lateefatin wa sa'altuha 'ani al-ittijahat bi-lutf.

arabic: ابتسمت السيدة وقالت لا تقلقي يا ابنتي بيتك قريب من هنا
english: The lady smiled and said "Don't worry, my daughter, your house is close from here."
transliteration: Ibtasamat as-sayyidatu wa qalat la taqlaqi ya ibnati baytuki qareebun min huna.

arabic: ثم قالت ان اباك رجل فاضل وسارشدك بنفسي الى هناك
english: Then she said, "Indeed, your father is an honorable man, and I will guide you there myself."
transliteration: Thumma qalat inna abaki rajulun fadilun wa sa'urshiduki bi-nafsi ila hunaka.

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد الجدة في البيت
english: Today is grandmother's birthday at home.
transliteration: Al-yawm eid milad al-jaddah fi al-bayt.

arabic: العائلة كلها سعيدة بهذا اليوم
english: The whole family is happy for this day.
transliteration: Al-aa'ilah kulluha sa'eedah bi-hadha al-yawm.

arabic: الجد والجدة يحبان الهدوء والطعام التقليدي
english: The grandfather and grandmother like quiet and traditional food.
transliteration: Al-jadd wa al-jaddah yuhibban al-hudoo' wa al-ta'am al-taqleediy.

arabic: الأطفال يحبون الموسيقى العالية واللعب
english: The children like loud music and playing.
transliteration: Al-atfal yuhibboon al-musiqa al-aaliyah wa al-la'ib.

arabic: لكن الجميع يحب العائلة والاحتفال معا
english: But everyone loves family and celebrating together.
transliteration: Lakin al-jamee' yuhibb al-aa'ilah wa al-ihtifal ma'an.

arabic: العائلة تريد رحلة هذا الاسبوع
english: The family wants a trip this week.
transliteration: Al-aa'ila turidu rihlatun hadha al-usbu'a.

arabic: ابي يريد مكانا هادئا في الجبل
english: My father wants a quiet place in the mountain.
transliteration: Abi yuridu makanun hadian fi al-jabali.

arabic: لكن اطفالي يريدون مكانا جديدا للعب
english: But my children want a new place to play.
transliteration: Lakin atfali yuriduna makanun jadidan lil-la'bi.

arabic: امي تتكلم مع الجميع عن رحلة سعيدة
english: My mother talks with everyone about a happy trip.
transliteration: Ummi tatakallamu ma'a al-jami'i 'an rihlatin sa'idatin.

arabic: نحن نريد وقتا جميلا للكل
english: We want a beautiful time for everyone.
transliteration: Nahnu nuridu waqtan jamilan lil-kulli.

arabic: كل مساء يذهب احمد الى المقهى
english: Every evening, Ahmed goes to the café.
transliteration: Kull masa' yadhhab Ahmad ila al-maqha

arabic: يجلس وينتظر صديقه ثم يقول مساء الخير
english: He sits and waits for his friend, then says "Good evening".
transliteration: Yajlis wa yantazir sadiquhu thumma yaqul masa' al-khayr

arabic: يسأل صديقه كيف حالك اليوم
english: He asks his friend, "How are you today?"
transliteration: Yas'al sadiquhu kayfa haluka al-yawm

arabic: يجيب الصديق انا بخير شكرا وانت كيف حالك
english: The friend replies, "I am fine, thank you, and how are you?"
transliteration: Yujeeb al-sadiq ana bi-khayr shukran wa anta kayfa haluka

arabic: يرد احمد انا ايضا بخير ثم يطلبان القهوة
english: Ahmed replies, "I am fine too," then they order coffee.
transliteration: Yarudd Ahmad ana aydan bi-khayr thumma yatluban al-qahwa

arabic: اليوم انا اريد ملابس جديدة
english: Today I want new clothes.
transliteration: Al-yawm ana ureed malabis jadeedah.

arabic: انا اذهب الى السوق الكبير
english: I go to the big market.
transliteration: Ana adhhab ila as-souq al-kabeer.

arabic: ارى قمصانا كثيرة بألوان زاهية
english: I see many shirts with bright colors.
transliteration: Ara qumsanan katheeratan bi-alwan zahiyah.

arabic: الملمس ناعم جدا و الرائحة طيبة
english: The touch is very soft and the smell is good.
transliteration: Al-malmas na'im jiddan war-ra'ihah tayyibah.

arabic: انا اشتري قميصا واحدا جميلا
english: I buy one beautiful shirt.
transliteration: Ana ashtari qameesan wahidan jameelan.

arabic: انطلقنا بشغف غامر نحو منزل خالتي حاملين في قلوبنا رغبة جامحة في تعميق اواصر القربى
english: We set off with immense eagerness towards my aunt's house, carrying in our hearts an overwhelming desire to deepen family bonds.
transliteration: Intalaqna bi-shaghaf ghamir nahwa manzil khalati, hamilina fi qulubina raghbah jamihah fi ta'miq awasir al-qurba.
storyTitle: A Visit of Warmth and Bonds

arabic: وما ان وصلنا حتى استقبلتنا بحفاوة وترحاب يغمره دفء صادق فاشاعت بهجة عارمة في الارجاء
english: No sooner had we arrived than she welcomed us with warm hospitality and a sincere warmth, spreading immense joy throughout the place.
transliteration: Wa ma in wasalna hatta istaqbalatna bi-hafawah wa tarhab yaghmuruhu dif' sadiq, fa-asha'at bahjah 'arimah fi al-arja'.
storyTitle: A Visit of Warmth and Bonds

arabic: قضينا لحظات ممتعة تخللها حديث شيق امتد ليربط بين ذكريات الاجداد واحلام الجيل الصاعد
english: We spent delightful moments interspersed with engaging conversation that stretched to connect the memories of the ancestors with the dreams of the rising generation.
transliteration: Qadayna lahazat mumti'ah takhallalaha hadith shaiyiq imtadd li-yarbut baina dhikrayat al-ajdad wa ahlam al-jeel al-sa'id.
storyTitle: A Visit of Warmth and Bonds

arabic: استشعر الجميع اهمية الحفاظ على هذه التقاليد العريقة التي ترسخ قيم المودة والتآزر بين افراد العائلة
english: Everyone sensed the importance of preserving these ancient traditions that establish the values of affection and mutual support among family members.
transliteration: Istash'ar al-jami' ahammiyat al-hifaz 'ala hadhihi al-taqalid al-'ariqah allati turassikh qiyam al-mawaddah wa al-ta'azur baina afrad al-'ailah.
storyTitle: A Visit of Warmth and Bonds

arabic: كانت تلك الزيارة تجسيدا حقيقيا لترابطنا الاسري مؤكدة على ضرورة استمرار التواصل لتعزيز هذه الروابط الثمينة
english: That visit was a true embodiment of our family cohesion, emphasizing the necessity of continuous communication to strengthen these precious bonds.
transliteration: Kanat tilka al-ziyarah tajsidan haqiqiyan li-tarabutina al-usari, mu'akkidah 'ala darurat istimrar al-tawasul li-ta'ziz hadhihi al-rawabit al-thaminah.
storyTitle: A Visit of Warmth and Bonds

arabic: انا في البيت بعد الظهر والجو ممطر
english: I am at home in the afternoon and the weather is rainy.
transliteration: Ana fi al-bayt ba'da al-dhuhr wa al-jaww mumtir.

arabic: انا اشاهد التلفاز واشرب الشاي
english: I am watching TV and drinking tea.
transliteration: Ana ushahid al-tilfaz wa ashrab ash-shay.

arabic: في المساء جاء ضيف الى بيتي
english: In the evening, a guest came to my house.
transliteration: Fi al-masa' ja'a dayf ila bayti.

arabic: فتحت الباب وقلت مساء الخير
english: I opened the door and said "Good evening."
transliteration: Fatahtu al-bab wa qultu masa' al-khayr.

arabic: الضيف كان صديقي القديم وقال مساء النور
english: The guest was my old friend and he said "Good evening" (response).
transliteration: Ad-dayf kana sadiqi al-qadim wa qala masa' an-nur.

arabic: دخلت المقهى و قلت صباح الخير للجميع
english: I entered the cafe and said good morning to everyone.
transliteration: Dakhalto al-maqha wa qultu sabah al-khair lil-jamee'

arabic: جلست و بدأت انتظر صديقي احمد
english: I sat down and started waiting for my friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Jalasto wa bada'to antazir sadeeqi Ahmad

arabic: طلبت قهوة عربية و نظرت الى الشارع
english: I ordered Arabic coffee and looked at the street.
transliteration: Talabto qahwatan Arabiyyah wa nazarto ila ash-shari'

arabic: كان الطقس جميلا و الهواء منعشا اليوم
english: The weather was beautiful and the air refreshing today.
transliteration: Kana at-taqs jameelan wa al-hawa'a mun'ishan al-yawm

arabic: سأطلب بعض الماء بعد قليل عندما يأتي احمد
english: I will order some water soon when Ahmed arrives.
transliteration: Sa'atlubu ba'd al-ma' ba'da qaleel 'indama ya'ti Ahmad

arabic: اليوم انا في المنزل
english: Today I am at home.
transliteration: Al-yawm ana fi al-manzil.

arabic: هذه غرفة كبيرة
english: This is a big room.
transliteration: Hadhihi ghurfah kabirah.

arabic: يوجد قط صغير تحت السرير
english: There is a small cat under the bed.
transliteration: Yujad qitt saghir tahta as-sarir.

arabic: القط يريد ان ياكل سمك
english: The cat wants to eat fish.
transliteration: Al-qitt yurid an ya'kul samak.

arabic: ليس عندي سمك اليوم
english: I don't have fish today.
transliteration: Laysa indi samak al-yawm.

arabic: كان الطفل الصغير يسأل كثيرا كل صباح
english: The small child used to ask a lot every morning.
transliteration: Kana al-tifl al-saghir yasal katheeran kull sabah

arabic: هو يسأل اين ذهب ابي الان
english: He asks "Where did my father go now?"
transliteration: Huwa yasal ayna dhahaba abi al-an

arabic: ثم يقول هل كتبنا الواجب اليوم
english: Then he says "Did we write the homework today?"
transliteration: Thumma yaqul hal katabna al-wajib al-yawm

arabic: الام تجيب بصبر وهو يسأل عن المدرسين
english: The mother answers patiently and he asks about the teachers.
transliteration: Al-umm tujeeb bisabr wa huwa yasal an al-mudarriseen

arabic: الطفل يحب ان يعرف كل شيء كل يوم
english: The child loves to know everything every day.
transliteration: Al-tifl yuhibb an ya'rif kull shay' kull yawm

arabic: ذهبت الى المقهى مساء وانتظرت صديقي هناك
english: I went to the café in the evening and waited for my friend there.
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila al-maqha masaa'an wa-intadhartu sadeeqi hunak.

arabic: رأيت رجلا كبيرا يقرأ كتابا بتمعن وبهدوء
english: I saw an old man reading a book carefully and quietly.
transliteration: Ra'aytu rajulan kabeeran yaqra'u kitaaban bi-tama'unun wa-bi-hudoo'.

arabic: وجلس بجانبه شابان يلعبان بهاتفهما الذكي بصوت عال
english: And two young men sat next to him playing loudly with their smartphones.
transliteration: Wajalas bi-jaanibihi shaabaan yal'abaan bi-haatifihima adh-dhakiyy bi-sawtin 'aalin.

arabic: الرجل الفاضل يفضل القراءة بهدوء بينما الشابان يفضلان التكنولوجيا الحديثة
english: The honorable man prefers reading quietly while the two young men prefer modern technology.
transliteration: Ar-rajulu al-faadil yufaddilu al-qira'ah bi-hudoo' baynama ash-shaabaan yufaddilaan at-tiknolojia al-hadeetha.

arabic: هذه فروق واضحة بين الاجيال وكل جيل له عالمه الخاص
english: These are clear differences between generations and each generation has its own world.
transliteration: Hadhihi furooq waadihah bayna al-ajyaal wa-kull jeel lahu 'alamuhu al-khaas.

arabic: ذهبت الى السوق المحلي مساء امس
english: I went to the local market yesterday evening
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-sooq al-mahali masaa ams
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: هناك قابلت رجلا فاضلا يبيع الخضروات الطازجة
english: There I met an honorable man selling fresh vegetables
transliteration: Hunaaka qaabaltu rajulan faadilan yabe'u al-khadrawaat at-taazijah
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: تبادلنا الحديث الودود وهذا العمل الصالح يسعد الجميع
english: We exchanged friendly conversation and this good deed pleases everyone
transliteration: Tabaadalna al-hadeeth al-wadood wa haadha al-amalu as-saalih yus'idu al-jamee'
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: عرض علي كوبا من الشاي الساخن كعادة اهل السوق
english: He offered me a cup of hot tea, as is the custom of the market people
transliteration: 'Arada 'alayya kooban min ash-shaayi as-saakhin ka-'aadati ahli as-sooq
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: كانت زيارة ممتعة وعكست روح الكرم الاصيلة في ثقافتنا
english: It was an enjoyable visit and reflected the authentic spirit of generosity in our culture
transliteration: Kaanat ziyaaratun mumti'ah wa 'akasanat rooha al-karam al-aseelah fi thaqafatina
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: التقى الجار احمد بالجار سامي صباحا
english: Neighbor Ahmed met neighbor Sami in the morning.
transliteration: Altaqa al-jaar Ahmad bil-jaar Saami sabaahan.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

arabic: قال احمد مبتسما هذا صديقي الجديد وهو يحب الزهور كثيرا
english: Ahmed said smiling: "This is my new friend, and he loves flowers very much."
transliteration: Qaala Ahmad mubtasiman: Hādhā ṣadīqī al-jadīd wa huwa yuḥibbu az-zuhūr kathīran.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

arabic: نظر سامي الى ما يحمله احمد بتعجب وقال اهذا صديقك الذي ياكل كل شيء
english: Sami looked at what Ahmed was carrying with surprise and said: "Is this your friend who eats everything?"
transliteration: Naẓara Saami ilā mā yaḥmiluhu Ahmad bi-ta'ajjub wa qaala: A-hādhā ṣadīquka alladhī ya'kulu kulla shay'?
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

arabic: ضحك احمد وقال نعم هو صديق رائع لكن خالة زوجتي لا تحبه كثيرا في الحديقة
english: Ahmed laughed and said: "Yes, he is a wonderful friend, but my wife's maternal aunt doesn't like him much in the garden."
transliteration: Ḍaḥika Ahmad wa qaala: Na'am huwa ṣadīq rā'i' lakin khālatu zawjatī lā tuḥibbuhu kathīran fil-ḥadīqah.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

arabic: احب اصدقائي كثيرا حتى لو كانوا ياكلون ازهار الجيران
english: I love my friends very much, even if they eat the neighbors' flowers.
transliteration: Uḥibbu aṣdiqāʾī kathīran ḥattā law kānū ya'kulūna azhāra al-jīrān.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

arabic: ذهبت اليوم الى السوق المحلي
english: Today I went to the local market.
transliteration: Dhahabtu al-yawm ilā as-sūq al-maḥallī
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: رايت بائعين كثيرين وناسا يشترون الخضروات والفواكه
english: I saw many sellers and people buying vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Ra'aytu bā'i'īn kathīrīn wa nāsan yashtarūna al-khaḍrawāt wa al-fawākih
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: كنت طالبة افكر في مستقبلي فربما اريد ان اكون طبيبة
english: I was a student thinking about my future, perhaps I want to be a doctor (female).
transliteration: Kuntu ṭālibatan ufaqqiru fī mustaqbalī farubbamā urīdu an akūna ṭabībatan
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: رايت شرطية تنظم حركة المرور قرب السوق وكان المنظر جميلا
english: I saw a policewoman organizing traffic near the market, and the view was beautiful.
transliteration: Ra'aytu shurṭiyyah tunazzimu ḥarakat al-murūr qurb as-sūq wa kāna al-manẓar jamīlan
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: بعد ان اشتريت بعض الخبز عدت الى البيت مسرورة
english: After I bought some bread, I returned home happy.
transliteration: Baʿda an ishtaraytu baʿḍ al-khubz ʿudtu ilā al-bayt masrūratan
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: ذهبت اليوم الى بيت الاقارب
english: I went today to the relatives' house.
transliteration: Dhahabtu al-yawma ila bayt al-aqareb.

arabic: في الصباح شربنا الشاي معهم
english: In the morning, we drank tea with them.
transliteration: Fi al-sabahi sharibna al-shaya ma'ahum.

arabic: ثم اكلنا الغداء و بعض الخبز
english: Then we ate lunch and some bread.
transliteration: Thumma akalna al-ghadaa wa ba'da al-khubz.

arabic: تحدثنا كثيرا وكان وقتا جميلا
english: We talked a lot and it was a beautiful time.
transliteration: Tahaddathna katheeran wa kana waqtan jameelan.

arabic: عدت الى بيتي ليلا
english: I returned to my house at night.
transliteration: 'Udtu ila baytee laylan.

arabic: في غرفة الجلوس في البيت مصباح قديم لا يعمل الآن
english: In the living room of the house, an old lamp does not work now.
transliteration: Fī ghurfat al-julūs fī al-bayt misbāḥ qadīm lā ya'mal al-ān.

arabic: سألت الأم ماذا حدث للمصباح يا أحمد
english: The mother asked: "What happened to the lamp, Ahmed?"
transliteration: Sa'alat al-umm: "Mādhā ḥadatha lil-miṣbāḥ yā Aḥmad?"

arabic: أجاب أحمد يا أمي لا أستطيع أن أرى شيئا المصباح معطل تماما
english: Ahmed replied: "Mother, I cannot see anything, the lamp is completely broken."
transliteration: Ajāba Aḥmad: "Yā ummī, lā astati' an arā shay'an, al-miṣbāḥ mu'aṭṭal tamāman."

arabic: قالت الأم نحتاج مصباحا جديدا هل تستطيع الذهاب للمتجر
english: The mother said: "We need a new lamp. Can you go to the store?"
transliteration: Qālat al-umm: "Naḥtāj miṣbāḥan jadīdan. Hal tastatī' al-dhahāb lil-matjar?"

arabic: رد أحمد نعم أستطيع أن أحضر واحدا اليوم
english: Ahmed replied: "Yes, I can bring one today."
transliteration: Radda Aḥmad: "Na'am, astati' an uḥḍira wāḥidan al-yawm."

arabic: هي اشترت قميصا لونه زهري
english: She bought a royal blue shirt.
transliteration: Hiya ishtarat qamisan lawnuhu zahri

arabic: بعد ذلك لم تحب اللون
english: After that she did not like the color.
transliteration: Ba'da dhalika lam tuhibb al-lawn

arabic: ذهبت الى المتجر لترجع القميص
english: She went to the shop to return the shirt.
transliteration: Dhahabat ila al-matjar li-turji'a al-qamis

arabic: كان البائع لطيفا جدا
english: The seller was very kind.
transliteration: Kana al-baa'i' latifan jiddan

arabic: شعرت بسعادة واشترت قميصا جديدا
