english: She felt happy and bought a new shirt.
transliteration: Sha'arat bi-sa'adah wa ishtarat qamisan jadidan

arabic: انا ذهبت اليوم الى السوق
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana dhahabtu al-yawm ila al-souq.
storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

arabic: السوق كان كبيرا جدا ومليئا بالناس
english: The market was very big and full of people.
transliteration: Al-souq kana kabeeran jiddan wa malee'an bi-al-nas.
storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

arabic: انا اردت تفاحة صغيرة
english: I wanted a small apple.
transliteration: Ana aradtu tuffahatan sagheera.
storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

arabic: الرجل قال هذه تفاحة كبيرة يا سيدي
english: The man said: "This is a big apple, sir!"
transliteration: Al-rajul qala: "Hadhihi tuffahatun kabeera ya sayyidi!"
storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

arabic: انا ضحكت واشتريت موزا كبيرا بدلا من ذلك
english: I laughed and bought a big banana instead.
transliteration: Ana dahiktu w-ishtaraytu mawzan kabeeran badalan min dhalik.
storyTitle: A Humorous Trip to the Market

arabic: رن هاتفي فجأة ورفعت السماعة بسرعة لأسمع صوت صديقي.
english: My phone rang suddenly and I picked up the receiver quickly to hear my friend's voice.
transliteration: Ranna hātifī faj'atan wa rafa'tu al-sammā'ata bi sur'atin li'asma'a ṣawta ṣadīqī.

arabic: سألني هل لديك خطط للغداء اليوم يا بطل الطبخ
english: He asked me: Do you have any plans for lunch today, oh cooking hero?
transliteration: Sa'alanī: Hal ladayka khuṭaṭun lil-ghadā'i al-yawma ya baṭala al-ṭabkhi?

arabic: أجبته ضاحكا انا آكل دجاجا وأرزا كل يوم تقريبا
english: I answered him laughing: I eat chicken and rice almost every day.
transliteration: Ajabtuhu ḍāḥikan: Ana ākulu dajājan wa aruzzen kulla yawmin taqrīban.

arabic: فقال هو مازحا يبدو أنك لا تريد لحما أو خبزا معي إذن
english: So he said jokingly: It seems you don't want meat or bread with me then!
transliteration: Fa qāla huwa māziḥan: Yabdu annaka lā turīdu laḥman aw khubzan ma'ī idhan!

arabic: ضحكنا معا واتفقنا أن نلتقي لاحقا لشرب القهوة بدلا من الغداء
english: We laughed together and agreed to meet later for coffee instead of lunch.
transliteration: Ḍaḥiknā ma'an wa ittafaqnā an naltaqiya lāḥiqan li-shurbi al-qahwati badalan mina al-ghadā'i.

arabic: عمر قال للضيف السلام عليكم صباح الخير
english: Omar said to the guest "As-salamu alaykum, good morning".
transliteration: Omar qala lid-dayfi As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr.

arabic: اجاب الضيف وعليكم السلام ثم سال كيف حالك يا عمر
english: The guest replied "Wa alaykum as-salam" then asked "How are you, Omar?"
transliteration: Ajaba ad-dayfu wa alaykum as-salam thumma sa'ala kayfa haluka ya Omar.

arabic: قال عمر انا بخير شكرا ثم سال ما اسمك يا سيدي
english: Omar said "I am fine, thank you" then asked "What is your name, sir?"
transliteration: Qala Omar ana bi-khayrin shukran thumma sa'ala ma ismuka ya sayyidi.

arabic: واصل عمر اسئلته الكثيرة اين بيتك ومن اين جئت
english: Omar continued his many questions: "Where is your house and where did you come from?"
transliteration: Wasala Omar as'ilatuhu al-kathirah: ayna baytuka wa min ayna ji'ta.

arabic: ابتسم الضيف وراى ان عمر طفل فضولي جدا
english: The guest smiled and saw that Omar was a very curious child.
transliteration: Ibtasama ad-dayfu wa ra'a anna Omar tiflun fuduliyyun jiddan.

arabic: انا ازور منزل خالتي الكبير
english: I visit my aunt's big house.
transliteration: Ana azuru manzil khalati al-kabir
storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

arabic: عندها قط صغير ولطيف
english: She has a small and cute cat.
transliteration: Indaha qittun saghirun wa latifun
storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

arabic: القط يريد سمك كثير
english: The cat wants a lot of fish.
transliteration: Al-qitt yurid samakan kathiran
storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

arabic: لكن ليس عندي سمك له
english: But I don't have fish for it.
transliteration: Lakin laysa indi samakun lahu
storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

arabic: فقفز القط على السرير فورا
english: So the cat immediately jumped on the bed.
transliteration: Fa-qafaza al-qitt ala as-sariri fawran
storyTitle: A Funny Visit to Aunt's House

arabic: ذهبت الى السوق صباحا
english: I went to the market in the morning
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-souqi sabahan

arabic: كان السوق مزدحما جدا
english: The market was very crowded
transliteration: Kana as-souqu muzdahiman jiddan

arabic: رايت بائعين كثيرين يعملون بجد
english: I saw many sellers working diligently
transliteration: Ra'aytu ba'ieena katheereena ya'maloona bi-jiddin

arabic: رجل فاضل باع فواكه طازجة
english: An honorable man sold fresh fruits
transliteration: Rajulun faadilun ba'a fawakihah taazijah

arabic: اشتريت بعض الخضروات وعدت الى البيت مسرورا
english: I bought some vegetables and returned home happily
transliteration: Ishtaraytu ba'da al-khadrawati wa 'udtu ila al-bayti masrooran

arabic: اليوم هو الثلاثاء ونحن نفكر في عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: Today is Tuesday and we are thinking about the weekend holiday
transliteration: al-yawmu huwa th-thulāthāʾu wa naḥnu nufakkiru fī ʿuṭlati nihāyati l-usbuʿi

arabic: قال احمد ما هو التاريخ
english: Ahmed said "What is the date"
transliteration: qāla aḥmadu mā huwa at-tārīkhu

arabic: اجابت سارة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع تبدا يوم الجمعة الخامس من هذا الشهر
english: Sara replied "The weekend begins on Friday the fifth of this month"
transliteration: ajābat sāratu ʿuṭlatu nihāyati l-usbuʿi tabdaʾu yawma l-jumuʿati l-khāmisi min hādhā ash-shahri

arabic: قال احمد ممتاز لنذهب الى البحر ثم نخطط لرحلة طويلة في الشهر القادم
english: Ahmed said "Excellent let's go to the sea then we will plan a long trip next month"
transliteration: qāla aḥmadu mumtāzun linadhhab ilā l-baḥri thumma nukhaṭṭiṭu liriḥlatin ṭawīlatin fī ash-shahri l-qādimi

arabic: وافقت سارة بسعادة وقالا تبدو فكرة رائعة
english: Sara happily agreed and they said "That sounds like a great idea"
transliteration: wāfaqat sāratu bisaʿādah wa qālā tabdū fikratan rāʾiʿatan

arabic: الاسرة تخطط لرحلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: The family plans a weekend trip.
transliteration: Al-usrah tukhattitu li-rihlati nihayat al-usbu'

arabic: الجد يريد منزلا صغيرا هادئا
english: The grandfather wants a small quiet house.
transliteration: Al-jadd yuridu manzilan saghiran hadi'an

arabic: الاطفال يريدون رحلة كبيرة وممتعة
english: The children want a big and fun trip.
transliteration: Al-atfal yuriduna rihlatan kabiratan wa mumti'atan

arabic: انا اريد سريرا مريحا
english: I want a comfortable bed.
transliteration: Ana uridu sariran murihan

arabic: هذه رحلة جميلة للاسرة كلها
english: This is a beautiful trip for the whole family.
transliteration: Hadhihi rihlatun jamilatun lil-usrah kulliha

arabic: جلست سارة على طاولة صغيرة في مقهى هادئ
english: Sarah sat at a small table in a quiet café.
transliteration: Jalasat Sara ala tawila saghira fi maqhan hadi'.

arabic: كانت سعيدة بلقاء صديقتها ولكنها بدأت تنتظر بصبر
english: She was happy to meet her friend, but she started to wait patiently.
transliteration: Kanat sa'idatan biliqa' sadiqiha walakinaha bada'at tantaziru bisabr.

arabic: مر بعض الوقت وهي تنظر الى الباب و تفكر في موعدها
english: Some time passed as she looked at the door and thought about her appointment.
transliteration: Marra ba'd al-waqt wa hiya tanzur ila al-bab wa tufakkiru fi maw'idiha.

arabic: بعد قليل شعرت ببعض الملل وأخرجت جوالها
english: After a little while, she felt some boredom and took out her mobile phone.
transliteration: Ba'da qalilin sha'arat bib'd al-malal wa akhrajat jawwalaha.

arabic: تنهدت سارة و تمنت أن تصل صديقتها قريبا
english: Sarah sighed and wished her friend would arrive soon.
transliteration: Tanahhadat Sara wa tamannat an tasila sadiqiha qariban.

arabic: كانت صدفة غريبة أن ألتقي بصديق قديم في السوق بعد سنوات طويلة
english: It was a strange coincidence to meet an old friend in the market after many long years.
transliteration: Kaanat sudfah ghareebah an altaqiya bi-sadeeqin qadeemin fi as-sooqi ba'da sanawaatin taweelah.

arabic: تعرف كلانا على الآخر على الفور وبدأنا في الحديث عن الماضي
english: Both of us recognized each other immediately and started talking about the past.
transliteration: Ta'arrafa kilaana 'ala al-aakhari 'ala al-fawri wa bada'na fi al-hadeethi 'ani al-maadi.

arabic: لاحظت بعض التغيرات في شكله لكن تعابير وجهه كانت مألوفة
english: I noticed some changes in his appearance, but his facial expressions were familiar.
transliteration: Lahaztu ba'da at-taghayyuraati fi shaklihi lakinna ta'aabeera wajhihi kaanat ma'loofah.

arabic: فجأة وبينما كنا نضحك شعر هو بشيء من الارتباك
english: Suddenly, while we were laughing, he felt a certain confusion/unease.
transliteration: Faj'ah wa baynama kunna nadhaku sha'ara huwa bi-shay'in min al-irtibaak.

arabic: ثم أدركت أنه ليس صديقي بل شخص آخر يشبهه كثيرا
english: Then I realized that he was not my friend, but rather another person who resembled him greatly.
transliteration: Thumma adraktu annahu laysa sadeeqi bal shakhsun aakharu yushbihuhu katheeran.

arabic: استيقظ مبكرا كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: Astayqizu mubakkiran kulla yawm.

arabic: اشرب قهوتي بسرعة واجهز للعمل
english: I drink my coffee quickly and prepare for work.
transliteration: Ashrabu qahwati bi-sur'a wa-ujahizu lil-amal.

arabic: ارى سيارات كثيرة في الشارع
english: I see many cars on the street.
transliteration: Ara sayyarat katheera fi al-shari'.

arabic: انا مدرس واحب عملي
english: I am a teacher and I love my work.
transliteration: Ana mudarris wa-uhibbu amali.

arabic: الان اذهب الى المدرسة
english: Now I go to school.
transliteration: Al-an adhabu ila al-madrasa.

arabic: جلست العائلة معًا في المساء للتخطيط لرحلة نهاية الأسبوع
english: The family sat together in the evening to plan for the weekend trip
transliteration: Jalisat al-a'ilah ma'an fi al-masa'i li-al-takhteet li-rihlat nihayat al-usbu'

arabic: اقترح الأب أن يكون موعد الانطلاق مبكرًا يوم السبت صباحًا
english: The father suggested that the departure time be early on Saturday morning
transliteration: Iqtarah al-ab an yakuna maw'id al-intilaq mubakkiran yawm al-sabt sabahan

arabic: قالت الأم هذا موعد مناسب للجميع لكي نستمتع بالوقت هناك
english: The mother said, "This is a suitable time for everyone so that we can enjoy the time there"
transliteration: Qalat al-umm hadha maw'id munasib lil-jami'i li-kay nastamti'a bil-waqti hunak

arabic: فرح الأطفال كثيرًا بتحديد موعد الرحلة إلى الشاطئ الجميل
english: The children were very happy with setting the trip's time to the beautiful beach
transliteration: Fariha al-atfal kathiran bi-tahdid maw'id al-rihlah ila ash-shati' al-jameel

arabic: تمنت العائلة قضاء وقت ممتع معًا وهذا هو أفضل موعد
english: The family wished to spend enjoyable time together and this is the best time
transliteration: Tamannat al-a'ilah qada'a waqt mumti' ma'an wa hadha huwa afdal maw'id

arabic: اليوم هو عيد ميلاد صديقنا احمد
english: Today is our friend Ahmed's birthday.
transliteration: Al-yawm huwa eid milad sadeeqona Ahmed

arabic: جاء اصدقاؤه المدرسون الى البيت للاحتفال
english: His teacher friends came to the house to celebrate.
transliteration: Jaa asdiqauhu al-mudarrisoon ila al-bayt lil-ihtifal

arabic: هم كتبوا رسائل جميلة وقدموا له ثلاثة كتب جديدة كهدية
english: They wrote beautiful letters and presented him with three new books as a gift.
transliteration: Hum katabu rasa'il jameelah wa qaddamu lahu thalathat kutub jadeedah ka-hadiya

arabic: احمد قال شكرا لكم هذه كتب رائعة لكنه كان يريد سيارة جديدة
english: Ahmed said "Thank you! These are wonderful books!" but he wanted a new car.
transliteration: Ahmed qala shukran lakum hadhihi kutub ra'i'ah lakinahu kana yureed sayyarah jadeedah

arabic: الجميع ضحكوا كثيرا في الحفلة
english: Everyone laughed a lot at the party.
transliteration: Al-jamee' dahiku katheeran fi al-haflah

arabic: اذهب اليوم الى السوق
english: I go to the market today.
transliteration: Adhhabu al-yawm ila as-souq.

arabic: السوق كبير
english: The market is big.
transliteration: As-souq kabeer.

arabic: اشتري خبز وحليب
english: I buy bread and milk.
transliteration: Ashtaree khubz wa haleeb.

arabic: واشتري فاكهة وخضروات
english: And I buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Wa ashtaree fakihah wa khadrawat.

arabic: اذهب الى البيت
english: I go to the house (home).
transliteration: Adhhabu ila al-bayt.

arabic: زرنا اقاربنا في بيتهم الكبير وكانت لحظة تحية حارة
english: We visited our relatives in their big house and it was a moment of warm greeting.
transliteration: Zurnā aqāribanā fī baytihim al-kabeer wa kānat lahzat tahiyyah haarah.

arabic: استقبلتنا العائلة بكرم في بهو واسع ثم جلسنا في قاعة الضيوف
english: The family welcomed us generously in a spacious foyer, then we sat in the guests' hall.
transliteration: Istaqbalatnā al-aa'ilah bi-karam fī bahw waasi' thumma jalasnā fī qaa'at ad-duyoof.

arabic: على مائدة الطعام قدموا لنا طبقا تقليديا بمذاق لذيذ جدا
english: On the dining table, they served us a traditional dish with a very delicious taste.
transliteration: Ala ma'idat at-ta'am qaddamoo lanā tabaqan taqleediyan bi-madhaq ladheedh jiddan.

arabic: بعد تناول الطعام تجمعنا حول القهوة والشاي وتبادلنا اطراف الحديث
english: After eating, we gathered around the coffee and tea and exchanged conversations.
transliteration: Ba'da tanawul at-ta'am tajamma'nā hawl al-qahwah wa ash-shay wa tabādalnā atrāf al-hadeeth.

arabic: كانت الزيارة مناسبة رائعة اظهرت كرم الضيافة العربية الاصيل
english: The visit was a wonderful occasion that showed the authentic Arab hospitality.
transliteration: Kānat az-ziyarah munasabah ra'i'ah azharat karam ad-diyafah al-arabiyyah al-aseel.

arabic: انا الان في شارع كبير
english: I am in a big street now.
transliteration: Ana al-an fi shari' kabeer.

arabic: انا اريد ان اذهب الى السوق
english: I want to go to the market.
transliteration: Ana ureed an adh-hab ila as-souq.

arabic: اين السوق
english: Where is the market?
transliteration: Ayna as-souq?

arabic: السوق هنا
english: The market is here.
transliteration: As-souq huna.

arabic: انا اعمل هناك كل صباح
english: I work there every morning.
transliteration: Ana a'mal hunak kull sabahin.

arabic: انا ذهبت اليوم
english: I went today.
transliteration: Ana dhahabtu al-yawm.

arabic: ذهبت مع امي وابي
english: I went with my mother and father.
transliteration: Dhahabtu ma'a ummi wa abi.

arabic: ذهبنا بالسيارة
english: We went by car.
transliteration: Dhahabna bil-sayyarah.

arabic: زرنا بيت عمتي
english: We visited my aunt's house.
transliteration: Zurna bayta ammti.

arabic: كنت سعيدا جدا
english: I was very happy.
transliteration: Kuntu sa'eedan jiddan.

arabic: ذهبت ليلى الى السوق مساء لشراء ملابس جديدة
english: Layla went to the market in the evening to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Dhahabat Layla ila as-sooqi masaa'an li-shira'i malabis jadeedah.

arabic: كانت تشعر بسعادة وحماس لرؤية الالوان الجميلة
english: She felt happiness and excitement to see the beautiful colors.
transliteration: Kanat tash'uru bi-sa'adatin wa hamasin li-ru'yati al-alwani al-jameelah.

arabic: جربت قمصانا كثيرة لكن لم يعجبها اي منها تماما
english: She tried many shirts, but none of them completely pleased her.
transliteration: Jarrabat qumsanan katheerah lakin lam yu'jibha ayyun minha tamaman.

arabic: فجاة رات فستانا لفت انتباهها فظهرت ابتسامة كبيرة على وجهها
english: Suddenly, she saw a dress that caught her attention, and a big smile appeared on her face.
transliteration: Faj'atan ra'at fustanan lafata intibahaha fa-zaharat ibtisamatun kabeerah 'ala wajhiha.

arabic: اشترته بفرح كبير وشعرت برضا حقيقي عن اختيارها
english: She bought it with great joy, feeling true satisfaction with her choice.
transliteration: Ishtarat-hu bi-farahin kabeerin wa sha'arat bi-ridan haqeeqiyyin 'an ikhtiyariha.

arabic: الاسرة تخطط لرحلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: The family plans a trip for the weekend.
transliteration: Al-usratu tukhattitu li-rihlati nihayati al-usbu'i

arabic: الاب يريد رحلة هادئة
english: The father wants a quiet trip.
transliteration: Al-abu yuridu rihlatun hadi'atan

arabic: البنت تريد رحلة مع صديقاتها
english: The daughter wants a trip with her friends.
transliteration: Al-bintu turidu rihlatun ma'a sadiqatiha

arabic: السيارة صغيرة
english: The car is small.
transliteration: Al-sayyaratun saghiratun

arabic: الاسرة تذهب الى حديقة جميلة مع طعام وماء
english: The family goes to a beautiful park with food and water.
transliteration: Al-usratu tadhhabu ila hadiqatin jamilatin ma'a ta'amin wa ma'in

arabic: في المساء كنت امشي في المدينة لزيارة السوق
english: In the evening, I was walking in the city to visit the market.
transliteration: Fi al-masa' kuntu amshi fi al-madina li-ziyarat as-souq.

arabic: بعد قليل وجدت نفسي في شارع غريب ولا اعرف اين انا
english: After a while, I found myself on a strange street and did not know where I was.
transliteration: Ba'da qalil wajadtu nafsi fi shari' gharib wa la a'rifu ayna ana.

arabic: رايت رجلا يمر فاقتربت منه وقلت مساء الخير كيف حالك يا سيدي
english: I saw a man passing by, so I approached him and said, 'Good evening, how are you, sir?'
transliteration: Ra'aytu rajulan yamur fa-qtarabtu minhu wa qultu masa' al-khayr kayfa haluka ya sayyidi.

arabic: اجاب الرجل انا بخير شكرا لك ثم سالته عن الطريق الى السوق
english: The man replied, 'I am fine, thank you,' then I asked him about the way to the market.
transliteration: Ajaba ar-rajul ana bi-khayr shukran lak thumma sa'altuhu 'an at-tariq ila as-souq.

arabic: اشار الرجل الى اليمين وقال اذهب مباشرة ثم انعطف يسارا ستجده هناك
english: The man pointed to the right and said, 'Go straight, then turn left, you will find it there.'
transliteration: Ashara ar-rajul ila al-yamin wa qala idhhab mubasharatan thumma in'atif yasaran sa-tajiduhu hunak.

arabic: مساء الخير قررت ان اطبخ طبقا جديدا اليوم
english: Good evening, I decided to cook a new dish today.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr qarrartu an atbukha tabaqan jadidan al-yawm.

arabic: الروائح الزكية من البهارات ملأت المطبخ
english: The fragrant smells of spices filled the kitchen.
transliteration: Ar-rawa'ih az-zakiyyah min al-baharat mala'at al-matbakh.

arabic: سمعت صوت الزيت وهو يسخن في المقلاة
english: I heard the sound of oil heating in the pan.
transliteration: Sami'tu sawt az-zayt wa huwa yaskhunu fi al-miqlah.

arabic: الطبق بدا جميلا جدا والوانه زاهية
english: The dish looked very beautiful and its colors were bright.
transliteration: At-tabaq bada jamilan jiddan wa alwanuhu zahiyah.

arabic: تذوقت الطعام وكان لذيذا جدا الحمد لله
english: I tasted the food and it was very delicious, praise be to God.
transliteration: Tadhawwaqtu at-ta'am wa kana ladhidhan jiddan al-hamdu lillah.

arabic: مساء الخير يا احمد الباب مكسور
english: Good evening Ahmad, the door is broken.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr ya Ahmad al-bab maksoor

arabic: مساء النور نعم الباب لا يغلق
english: Good evening, yes the door does not close.
transliteration: Masa' an-nur na'am al-bab la yughliq

arabic: نحتاج الى عامل يصلحه
english: We need a worker to fix it.
transliteration: Nahtaj ila amil yuslihuh

arabic: هذا فكرة جيدة جدا
english: This is a very good idea.
transliteration: Hadha fikra jayyida jiddan

arabic: سوف اتصل به غدا صباحا
english: I will call him tomorrow morning.
transliteration: Sawfa attasil bihi ghadan sabahan

arabic: اليوم زرت انا و الام بيت خالتي
english: Today, Mother and I visited my aunt's house.
transliteration: Al-yawma zur tu ana wa al-umm bayta khalati.

arabic: كان الضوء في المطبخ لا يعمل
english: The light in the kitchen was not working.
transliteration: Kana ad-daw'u fi al-matbakhi la ya'malu.

arabic: قال الابن سوف احاول لاصلاح الضوء
english: The son said, "I will try to fix the light."
transliteration: Qala al-ibnu sawfa uhawilu li-islahi ad-daw'i.

arabic: هو شاب طيب جدا ويحب مساعدة الاسرة
english: He is a very kind young man and loves to help the family.
transliteration: Huwa shabbun tayyibun jiddan wa yuhibbu musa'adata al-usra.

arabic: لكن بعد قليل عرفنا انه ليس ابن خالتي بل صديق مغربي
english: But after a short while, we learned that he is not my aunt's son, but a Moroccan friend.
transliteration: Lakin ba'da qalilin 'arafna annahu laysa ibna khalati bal sadiqun maghribiyyun.

arabic: اليوم نريد ان نخطط لحفل الزفاف
english: Today we want to plan the wedding party.
transliteration: Al-yawm nureed an nukhattita lihafl az-zafaf

arabic: اين نريد ان يكون الحفل يا احمد
english: Where do we want the party to be, Ahmed?
transliteration: Ayna nureed an yakoon al-hafl ya Ahmed

arabic: انا اريد حفلا كبيرا في مدينة جميلة
english: I want a big party in a beautiful city.
transliteration: Ana ureed haflan kabeeran fi madina jamila

arabic: نعم هذا جيد يا ليلى ونريد طعاما لذيذا
english: Yes, this is good, Layla, and we want delicious food.
transliteration: Naam hadha jayyid ya Layla wa nureed taaman ladheedhan

arabic: غدا نكمل التخطيط شكرا لك
english: Tomorrow we will complete the planning, thank you.
transliteration: Ghadan nukmil at-takhteet shukran lak

arabic: العائلة تجلس حول المائدة للطعام
english: The family sits around the table for food.
transliteration: Al-a'ila tajlisu hawla al-ma'ida li-al-ta'am.

arabic: الأب والجد سعيدان جدا
english: The father and grandfather are very happy.
transliteration: Al-ab wa al-jadd sa'eedan jiddan.

arabic: الأم تبتسم وتقول ابني كتب الدرس جيدا
english: The mother smiles and says: My son wrote the lesson well.
transliteration: Al-umm tabtasim wa taqool ibni kataba al-dars jayyidan.

arabic: الأطفال يقولون نحن كتبنا الواجب
english: The children say: We wrote the homework.
transliteration: Al-atfal yaqulun nahnu katabna al-wajib.

arabic: الجميع يأكلون ويشربون بفرح
english: Everyone eats and drinks with joy.
transliteration: Al-jamee' ya'kuloon wa yashraboon bi-farah.

arabic: نجلس في مقهى جميل ودافئ
english: We sit in a beautiful and warm café
transliteration: Najlisu fi maqhan jameelin wa dafi'in

arabic: أمي وأبي ينتظران القهوة لهما
english: My mother and father are waiting for their coffee
transliteration: Ummi wa abi yantazirani al-qahwata lahuma

arabic: أنا أحب قضاء الوقت مع عائلتي كل يوم
english: I love spending time with my family every day
transliteration: Ana uhibbu qada'a al-waqti ma'a 'ailati kull yawmin

arabic: أخي الصغير يلعب بسعادة ويشرب عصيرا
english: My little brother plays happily and drinks juice
transliteration: Akhi as-saghiru yal'abu bi-sa'adatin wa yashrabu 'asiran

arabic: هذه اللحظات العائلية هي الأجمل دائما
english: These family moments are always the most beautiful
transliteration: Hadhihi al-lahazat al-'ailiyyah hiya al-ajmalu da'iman

arabic: ذهبت لزيارة عمي مساء
english: I went to visit my uncle in the evening.
transliteration: Dhahabtu li-ziyarati 'ammi masa'an.

arabic: قلت مساء الخير عند الباب
english: I said "Good evening" at the door.
transliteration: Qultu masa' al-khayr 'inda al-bab.

arabic: قال عمي مساء النور كيف حالك
english: My uncle said "Good evening" (response) and "How are you?".
transliteration: Qala 'ammi masa' an-nur kayfa haluka?

arabic: اجبت انا بخير شكرا
english: I replied, "I am fine, thank you."
transliteration: Ajabtu ana bi-khayr shukran.

arabic: كانت الزيارة جميلة جدا
english: The visit was very nice.
transliteration: Kanat az-ziyarah jamilah jiddan.

arabic: الجد قال مساء الخير للعائلة الكبيرة
english: The grandfather said "Good evening" to the large family.
transliteration: Al-jadd qala masa' al-khayr lil-'a'ilah al-kabirah

arabic: سأل الجد حفيده احمد كيف حالكَ
english: The grandfather asked his grandson Ahmed, "How are you?"
transliteration: Sa'ala al-jadd hafīdahu Ahmad kayfa haluka

arabic: أجاب احمد انا بخير شكرا يا جدي
english: Ahmed answered, "I am fine, thank you, my grandfather."
transliteration: Ajaba Ahmad ana bi-khayr shukran ya jaddi

arabic: جلست العائلة حول المائدة بفرح
english: The family sat around the table with joy.
transliteration: Jalasat al-'a'ilah hawla al-ma'idah bi-farah

arabic: استمتع الجميع بالطعام والضحكات ملأت البيت
english: Everyone enjoyed the food and laughter filled the house.
transliteration: Istamta'a al-jami' bi-t-ta'am wa-d-dahikat mala'at al-bayt

arabic: السلام عليكم صباح الخير يا جارتي سارة
english: Hello good morning my neighbor Sara
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr ya jarati Sara

arabic: وعليكم السلام صباح النور يا أحمد كيف حالكَ
english: And peace be upon you too morning of light Ahmad how are you
transliteration: Wa alaykum as-salam sabah an-nur ya Ahmad kayfa haluka

arabic: أنا بخير شكراً لكِ يا سارة
english: I am fine thank you Sara
transliteration: Ana bi-khayr shukran laki ya Sara

arabic: كيف حال الأهل يا سارة
english: How is the family Sara
transliteration: Kayfa hal al-ahl ya Sara

arabic: الجميع بخير الحمد لله
english: Everyone is fine praise be to God
transliteration: Al-jami' bi-khayr al-hamdu lillah

arabic: صباح الخير يا جاري
english: Good morning, my neighbor
transliteration: Sabah al-khayr ya jari

arabic: كيف حالك اليوم
english: How are you today
transliteration: Kayfa haluk al-yawm

arabic: هو يقول انا بخير الحمد لله
english: He says, "I am fine, praise be to God"
transliteration: Huwa yaqul ana bi-khayr alhamdulillah

arabic: انا اذهب الى العمل الآن
english: I am going to work now
transliteration: Ana adhhab ila al-amal al-an

arabic: مع السلامة يا صديقي
english: Goodbye, my friend
transliteration: Ma'a as-salamah ya sadiqi

arabic: احمد ووالده ذهبا الى المتجر مساء لارجاع قميص جديد
english: Ahmed and his father went to the shop in the evening to return a new shirt.
transliteration: Ahmad wa waaliduhu dhahaba ila al-matjari masaa'an li-irjaa'i qameesin jadeedin.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

arabic: قال الاب ان العمل الصالح مع الزبائن مهم جدا لاي متجر
english: The father said that good work with customers is very important for any shop.
transliteration: Qaala al-abu inna al-'amala as-saaliha ma'a az-zabaa'ini muhimmun jiddan li-ayyi matjarin.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

arabic: لكن احمد عرف ان المتجر يحتاج الفاتورة للارجاع
english: But Ahmed knew that the shop needed the receipt for the return.
transliteration: Laakinna Ahmada 'arafa anna al-matjara yahtaaju al-faatoorata lil-irjaa'i.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

arabic: الموظف الشاب قال ان سياسات الارجاع تغيرت مع الوقت
english: The young employee said that return policies have changed with time.
transliteration: Al-muwazzafu ash-shaabu qaala inna siyaasaati al-irjaa'i taghayyarat ma'a al-waqti.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

arabic: تعلم الاب شيئا جديدا وادرك ان الزمن يتطور دائما
english: The father learned something new and realized that time always evolves.
transliteration: Ta'allama al-abu shay'an jadeedan wa adraka anna az-zamana yatatawwaru daa'iman.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning to the Shop

arabic: وصلت العائلة الكبيرة الى بيت الجدة لتناول طعام العشاء
english: The large family arrived at Grandmother's house for dinner.
transliteration: Wasalat al-ailat al-kabira ila bayt al-jaddah litanawul ta'am al-asha'

arabic: قالت الام مساء الخير يا جدة السلام عليكم جميعا
english: The mother said "Good evening, Grandmother! Hello everyone!"
transliteration: Qalat al-umm masa' al-khayr ya jaddah As-salamu alaykum jami'an

arabic: اجابت الجدة بابتسامة وعليكم السلام مساء النور يا ابنتي تفضلوا الطعام جاهز
english: The Grandmother replied with a smile "And peace be upon you too, good evening, my daughter! Please come in, the food is ready."
transliteration: Ajabat al-jaddah bi-ibtisamah Wa alaykum as-salam Masa' an-nur ya ibnati tafaddalu at-ta'am jahiz

arabic: جلس الجميع حول المائدة وقال الاب هذا عشاء لذيذ جدا شكرا لك يا امي
english: Everyone sat around the table, and the father said "This is a very delicious dinner, thank you, Mother!"
transliteration: Jalasa al-jami' hawla al-ma'idah wa qala al-ab hatha asha' ladhidh jiddan shukran laki ya ummi

arabic: استمتعت العائلة بالحديث والضحك والطعام في هذا المساء الجميل
english: The family enjoyed talking, laughing, and eating on this beautiful evening.
transliteration: Istamta'at al-ailah bil-hadith wa ad-dahk wa at-ta'am fi hatha al-masa' al-jamil

arabic: مساء الخير كان احمد في الملعب
english: Good evening, Ahmed was at the stadium.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr kana Ahmad fi al-mal'ab

arabic: قابل صديقه سامي وقال له السلام عليكم
english: He met his friend Sami and said to him, "Peace be upon you."
transliteration: Qabala sadiqa-hu Sami wa qala lahu As-salamu alaykum

arabic: سال احمد كيف حالك يا سامي
english: Ahmed asked: How are you, Sami?
transliteration: Sa'ala Ahmad: Kayfa haluka ya Sami?

arabic: اجاب سامي انا بخير شكرا يا احمد
english: Sami replied: I am fine, thank you, Ahmed.
transliteration: Ajaba Sami: Ana bi-khayr shukran ya Ahmad

arabic: هما يشاهدان مباراة كرة القدم الان
english: They are watching the football match now.
transliteration: Huma yushahidan mubarat kurat al-qadam al-an

arabic: اتصلت لينا بصديقتها سارة مساء الخير
english: Lina called her friend Sara. Good evening.
transliteration: Ittasalat Lina bi-sadiqatiha Sara. Masa' al-khayr.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: سالت لينا كيف حالك يا سارة
english: Lina asked, "How are you, Sara?"
transliteration: Sa'alat Lina, "Kayfa haluki ya Sara?"
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اجابت سارة انا بخير شكرا لك
english: Sara answered, "I am fine, thank you."
transliteration: Ajabat Sara: "Ana bi-khayr, shukran laki."
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: قالت لينا ماذا تفعلين في المساء عادة
english: Lina said, "What do you usually do in the evening?"
transliteration: Qalat Lina: "Maza taf'alin fi al-masa' 'adatan?"
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: ردت سارة اقرا كتابا واشرب الشاي
english: Sara replied, "I read a book and drink tea."
transliteration: Raddat Sara: "Aqra'u kitaban wa ashrabu ash-shay."
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: انا ازور منزل عمتي اليوم
english: I visit my aunt's house today.
transliteration: Ana azuru manzil ammatti al-yawm.
storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

arabic: رائحة خبز طازج جميلة تملا المكان
english: The beautiful smell of fresh bread fills the place.
transliteration: Raihatu khubzin tazajin jamilatun tamla'u al-makan.
storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

arabic: عندها قط اسود صغير يلعب بسعادة
english: She has a small black cat playing happily.
transliteration: Indaha qittun aswadu saghirun yal'abu bi-sa'adah.
storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

arabic: انا ارى غرفة نوم كبيرة فيها سرير ابيض
english: I see a big bedroom with a white bed in it.
transliteration: Ana ara ghurfata nawmin kabiratun fiha sarirun abyad.
storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

arabic: هذه حقا زيارة ممتعة لي
english: This is truly an enjoyable visit for me.
transliteration: Hadhihi haqqan ziyaratun mumti'atun li.
storyTitle: A Visit to My Aunt's House

arabic: سارة تخطط لرحلة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع مع اصدقائها
english: Sara is planning a weekend trip with her friends.
transliteration: Sārah tukhaṭṭiṭu liriḥlati ʻuṭlati nihāyati al-usbūʻi maʻa aṣdiqāʼihā.

arabic: اختاروا الذهاب الى الجبال ليستمتعوا بالهواء النقي والمناظر الجميلة
english: They chose to go to the mountains to enjoy the fresh air and beautiful views.
transliteration: Ikhtārū adh-dhahāba ilā al-jibāli liyastamtiʻū bil-hawāʼi an-naqiyyi wal-manāẓiri al-jamīlati.

arabic: تخيلوا رائحة الزهور البرية وصوت الرياح الخفيفة بين الاشجار
english: They imagined the smell of wild flowers and the sound of the light wind among the trees.
transliteration: Takhayyalū rāʼiḥata az-zuhūri al-barriyyati waṣawta ar-riyāḥi al-khafīfati bayna al-ashjāri.

arabic: سيحضرون طعاما لذيذا ويضحكون كثيرا تحت اشعة الشمس الدافئة
english: They will bring delicious food and laugh a lot under the warm sun.
transliteration: Sayuḥḍirūna ṭaʻāman ladhīdhan wayaḍḥakūna kathīran taḥta ashiʻʻati ash-shamsi ad-dāfiʼati.

arabic: هذه الخطة الجميلة ستجعل عطلتهم لا تنسى
english: This beautiful plan will make their holiday unforgettable.
transliteration: Hadhihi al-khuṭṭatu al-jamīlatu satajʻalu ʻuṭlatahum lā tunsá.

arabic: كنت في حالة ترقب شديد لمكالمة صديقي أحمد الذي طال غيابه
english: I was in a state of intense anticipation for the call from my friend Ahmed, whose absence had been prolonged.
transliteration: Kuntu fī ḥālati taraqqubin shadīdin li-mukālamati ṣadīqī Aḥmada alladhī ṭāla ghiyābuhu.
storyTitle: A Phone Call and Fluctuating Emotions

arabic: وما إن بدأ حديثه حتى انتابني شعور بالضيق الشديد عندما كشف عن أزمة طارئة يمر بها
english: No sooner had he started speaking than I was seized by a strong feeling of distress when he revealed an urgent crisis he was going through.
transliteration: Wa mā in bada'a ḥadīthahu ḥattā intābanī shu'ūrun biḍ-ḍīqi ash-shadīdi 'indamā kashafa 'an azmatin ṭāri'atin yamurru bihā.
storyTitle: A Phone Call and Fluctuating Emotions

arabic: اضطربت أفكاري للحظات واستغرقت في محاولة لاستيعاب حجم المشكلة وتعقيداتها
english: My thoughts became agitated for moments, and I immersed myself in an attempt to comprehend the magnitude and complexities of the problem.
transliteration: Iḍṭarabāt afkārī lil-ḥaẓātī wa-staghraqtū fī muḥāwalatin listī'ābi ḥajmi al-mushkilati wa ta'qīdātihā.
storyTitle: A Phone Call and Fluctuating Emotions

arabic: ومع استمرار الحوار الهادئ بدأت سحابة الإرباك تتبدد تدريجيا وتتضح معالم الحلول الممكنة
english: With the continuation of the calm conversation, the cloud of confusion began to dissipate gradually, and the outlines of possible solutions became clear.
transliteration: Wa ma'a istimrāri al-ḥiwāri al-hādi'i bada'at saḥābatul-irbāki tatabaddadu tadrījiyyan wa tattadiḥu ma'ālimu al-ḥulūli al-mumkinati.
storyTitle: A Phone Call and Fluctuating Emotions

arabic: وعندما استعاد أحمد هدوءه أكدت له دعمي الكامل فانتابني إحساس عميق بالراحة والطمأنينة
english: And when Ahmed regained his composure, I assured him of my full support, and I was overcome by a deep feeling of relief and tranquility.
transliteration: Wa 'indamā ista'āda Aḥmadu hudū'ahu akkadtu lahu da'mī al-kāmila fa-ntābanī iḥsāsun 'amīqun bir-rāḥati waṭ-ṭuma'nīnati.
storyTitle: A Phone Call and Fluctuating Emotions

arabic: اليوم ذهبت الجدة وحفيدتها الى السوق المحلي
english: Today, the grandmother and her granddaughter went to the local market.
transliteration: Al-yawma dhahabat al-jaddatu wa-ḥafīdatuhā ilā as-sūqi al-maḥallī.

arabic: في قسم الملابس رأت الجدة قميصا وسألت حفيدتها هل يعجبك هذا القميص
english: In the clothing section, the grandmother saw a shirt and asked her granddaughter, "Do you like this shirt?"
transliteration: Fī qismi al-malābisī raʾat al-jaddatu qamīṣan wa-saʾalat ḥafīdatahā hal yuʿjibuki hādhā al-qamīṣu.

arabic: اجابت الحفيدة لا لا يعجبني انه قديم جدا
english: The granddaughter replied, "No, I don't like it; it is very old-fashioned."
transliteration: Ajābat al-ḥafīdatu "Lā, lā yuʿjibunī, innahu qadīmun jiddan."

arabic: ثم اشارت الحفيدة الى تنورة عصرية وقالت هذه تنورة زرقاء صغيرة من القطن
english: Then the granddaughter pointed to a modern skirt and said, "This is a small blue skirt made of cotton."
transliteration: Thumma ashārat al-ḥafīdatu ilā tannūratin ʿaṣrīyatin wa-qālat "Hādhihi tannūratun zarqāʾu ṣaghīratun mina al-quṭni."

arabic: قالت الجدة نعم يعجبني ولكن ماذا تلبسين انت يا عزيزتي
english: The grandmother said, "Yes, I like it, but what are you wearing, my dear?"
transliteration: Qālat al-jaddatu "Naʿam, yuʿjibunī, wa-lākin mādhā talbasīna anti yā ʿazīzatī?"

arabic: شعرت مريم ببعض التردد قبل ان تعيد الفستان الى المحل
english: Maryam felt some hesitation before returning the dress to the shop.
transliteration: Sha'arat Maryam bi-ba'd at-taraddud qabl an tu'id al-fustan ila al-mahall.

arabic: عند دخولها قالت السلام عليكم فرد عليها البائع وعليكم السلام
english: Upon entering, she said "As-salamu alaykum" and the seller replied "Wa alaykum as-salam".
transliteration: Inda dukhuliha qalat "As-salamu alaykum" fa-radd alayha al-ba'i' "Wa alaykum as-salam".

arabic: قالت مريم صباح الخير اريد ان اعيد هذا الفستان لو سمحت
english: Maryam said: "Good morning, I want to return this dress, please".
transliteration: Qalat Maryam: "Sabah al-khayr, urid an u'id hadha al-fustan law samaht".

arabic: اجاب البائع بابتسامة صباح النور تفضلي لا مشكلة
english: The seller replied with a smile: "Sabah an-nur, please, no problem".
transliteration: Ajab al-ba'i' bi-ibtisama: "Sabah an-nur, tafaddali la mushkilah".

arabic: شكرت مريم البائع وخرجت من المحل وهي تشعر بالارتياح
english: Maryam thanked the seller and left the shop feeling relieved.
transliteration: Shakarat Maryam al-ba'i' wa kharajat min al-mahall wa hiya tash'ur bi-al-irtiyah.

arabic: سارة كانت متحمسة جدا لعمل خطة عطلة نهاية الاسبوع
english: Sara was very excited to make a plan for the weekend.
transliteration: Sara kanat mutahammisah jiddan li-'amal khittat 'utlat nihayat al-usbu'.

arabic: اختيار مكان الرحلة كان قرارا صعبا بعض الشيء
english: Choosing the trip's place was a somewhat difficult decision.
transliteration: Ikhtiyar makan ar-rihlah kana qararan sa'ban ba'd ash-shay'.

arabic: صديقتها هند اقترحت مكانا رائعا جدا فقالت سارة هذا افضل مكان
english: Her friend Hind suggested a very wonderful place, so Sara said, "This is the best place!"
transliteration: Sadeeqatuha Hind iqtarahat makan an ra'i'an jiddan faqalat Sara hadha afdal makan.

arabic: بعد ذلك شعرتا بالسعادة لان الخطة كانت جاهزة
english: After that, they felt happy because the plan was ready.
transliteration: Ba'd dhalik sha'arata bis-sa'adah li'anna al-khittah kanat jahizah.

arabic: انهما الان تنتظران وقت عطلة نهاية الاسبوع بفارغ الصبر
english: Now they are eagerly waiting for the weekend.
transliteration: Innahuma al-an tantaziran waqt 'utlat nihayat al-usbu' bifarigh as-sabr.

arabic: قررت الذهاب الى السوق لشراء ملابس جديدة استعدادا لمناسبة قادمة
english: I decided to go to the market to buy new clothes in preparation for an upcoming occasion.
transliteration: Qarrartu al-dhahāba ilā as-sūq li-shirā'i malābis jadīdah isti'dādan li-munāsabah qādimah.

arabic: كان المحل مليئا بالعديد من الخيارات والازياء المتنوعة
english: The shop was full of many choices and diverse styles.
transliteration: Kāna al-maḥall malī'an bi-al-'adīd min al-khiyārāt wa-al-aziyā' al-mutanawwi'ah.

arabic: اخترت ثوبا انيقا يناسب اجواء لقاء العائلة الكبيرة
english: I chose an elegant dress that suits the atmosphere of the extended family gathering.
transliteration: Ikhtartu thawban anīqan yunāsibu ajwā'a liqā' al-ʿā'ilah al-kabīrah.

arabic: فملابس المناسبات جزء مهم من التقاليد التي نتبادل فيها الاحترام والمودة
english: For occasion clothes are an important part of the traditions in which we exchange respect and affection.
transliteration: Fa-malābis al-munāsabāt juz'un muhimun min at-taqālīd allatī natabādalu fīhā al-iḥtirāma wa-al-mawaddah.

arabic: شعرت بسعادة غامرة وانا اتخيل نفسي مرتديا اياه في تلك اللحظات السعيدة
english: I felt immense happiness imagining myself wearing it in those happy moments.
transliteration: Sha'artu bi-sa'ādah ghāmirah wa-anā atakhayyalu nafsī murtadiyan iyyāhu fī tilka al-laḥaẓāt as-sa'īdah.

arabic: في هذا الصباح استيقظت مبكرا لعمل الافطار في المطبخ
english: This morning I woke up early to make breakfast in the kitchen.
transliteration: Fi hatha al-sabah istaiqaztu mubakkiran li-amal al-iftar fi al-matbakh.

arabic: اريد تنظيف كل المنزل اليوم لكن هناك مشكلة
english: I want to clean the whole house today but there is a problem.
transliteration: Ureedu tanzifa kulli al-manzil al-yawm lakin hunaka mushkilah.

arabic: الغسالة قديمة جدا وهي لا تعمل الان
english: The washing machine is very old and it does not work now.
transliteration: Al-ghassalah qadimah jiddan wa hiya la ta'mal al-aan.

arabic: يجب غسل الملابس لكن كيف
english: Clothes must be washed but how?
transliteration: Yajibu ghasl al-malabis lakin kayf?

arabic: علينا ان نجد حلا لهذه المشكلة الكبيرة
english: We must find a solution for this big problem.
transliteration: Alayna an najida hallan li-hathihi al-mushkilah al-kabirah.

arabic: السلام عليكم صباح الخير ذهبنا اليوم للتسوق
english: Hello good morning we went today for shopping
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr dahabna al-yawm lil-tasawwuq

arabic: مع امي وابي كيف حالك يا ابي
english: With my mother and father How are you father
transliteration: Ma ummi wa abi kayfa haluka ya abi

arabic: انا بخير شكرا يا بني نشتري ملابس جديدة
english: I am fine thank you my son we are buying new clothes
transliteration: Ana bi-khayr shukran ya bunayya nashtari malabis jadidah

arabic: الجو جميل والملابس كثيرة اخترت قميصا ازرق
english: The weather is beautiful and the clothes are many I chose a blue shirt
transliteration: Al-jaww jameel wal-malabis katheerah ikhtartu qameesan azraq

arabic: امي سعيدة وانا سعيد عدنا الى البيت مساء الخير
english: My mother is happy and I am happy we returned home good evening
transliteration: Ummi sa'eedah wa ana sa'eed udna ila al-bayt masa' al-khayr

arabic: الاب قال صباح الخير للام والاطفال
english: The father said good morning to the mother and children.
transliteration: Al-ab qala sabah al-khayr lil-umm wal-atfal.
storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

arabic: الام والاطفال ردوا صباح النور
english: The mother and children replied good morning.
transliteration: Al-umm wal-atfal raddoo sabah an-nur.
storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

arabic: ذهبت العائلة الى مباراة كرة القدم
english: The family went to a football match.
transliteration: Dhahabat al-ailah ila mubarat kurat al-qadam.
storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

arabic: هناك قابلوا اصدقاء وقالوا السلام عليكم
english: There they met friends and said As-salamu alaykum.
transliteration: Hunaka qabaloo asdiqa wa qaloo as-salamu alaykum.
storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

arabic: الاصدقاء ردوا وعليكم السلام وشاهدوا المباراة معا
english: The friends replied Wa alaykum as-salam and watched the match together.
transliteration: Al-asdiqa raddoo wa alaykum as-salam wa shahadoo al-mubarat maan.
storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

arabic: في كل صباح تتجدد حلقة التساؤلات المتواصلة التي يطرحها طفلي ذو الفضول اللامتناهي
english: Every morning, the continuous cycle of questions posed by my child, with his infinite curiosity, renews itself.
transliteration: Fi kulli sabah tatajaddadu halaqatu al-tasa'ulat al-mutawasila allati yatrahaha tifli dhu al-fudul al-la mutanahi.

arabic: يبدو وكأنه يسعى لاستكشاف أبعاد الكون بأكمله في محاولة حثيثة لاكتساب معرفة عميقة
english: It seems as if he strives to explore the dimensions of the entire universe in an earnest attempt to acquire profound knowledge.
transliteration: Yabdu wa ka'annahu yas'a li-istikshaf ab'ad al-kawn bi-akmalihi fi muhawalat hathithatin li-iktisab ma'rifatin 'amiqah.

arabic: غالبا ما أجد نفسي عاجزا عن مواكبة ذهنه الوقاد في استيعاب كل هذه التفاصيل المحيرة
english: Often I find myself incapable of keeping pace with his keen mind in comprehending all these perplexing details.
transliteration: Ghaliban ma ajidu nafsi 'ajizan 'an muwakabat dhinihi al-waqqad fi isti'ab kulli hadhihi al-tafasil al-muhayyirah.

arabic: إن هذا الكم الهائل من الأسئلة يستنزف قدرتي المحدودة على الشرح والتفسير أحيانا
english: Indeed, this enormous volume of questions sometimes exhausts my limited capacity for explanation and interpretation.
transliteration: Inna hadha al-kamma al-ha'il min al-as'ilah yastanzifu qudrati al-mahdudah 'ala al-sharh wa al-tafsir ahianan.

arabic: لكنني أدرك أن هذا الشغف الجلي بالاستقصاء هو جوهر النمو والتعلم من منظوره الفريد
english: However, I realize that this clear passion for inquiry is the essence of growth and learning from his unique perspective.
transliteration: Lakinnani udriku anna hadha al-shaghaf al-jali bi al-istiqsa' huwa jawhar al-numuww wa al-ta'allum min manzurihi al-farid.

arabic: في صباح جميل يتأمل الجاران المتجاوران مشهد شروق الشمس من شرفتيهما المطلتين
english: On a beautiful morning, the adjacent neighbors contemplate the scene of the sunrise from their overlooking balconies.
transliteration: Fi sabahin jameelin yatamal al-jārān al-mutajāwirān mashhad shuruq ash-shams min shurfatihayhimā al-mutillatayn.

arabic: بدأ السيد خالد والسيدة ليلى يتبادلان أطراف الحديث بينما كان نسيم عليل يداعب وجوههما
english: Mr. Khalid and Mrs. Layla began exchanging pleasantries while a gentle breeze caressed their faces.
transliteration: Badaa as-sayyid Khalid wa as-sayyidah Layla yatabadalān atrāf al-hadeeth baynamā kāna naseemun aleelun yudāib wujoohahumā.

arabic: كانت رائحة القهوة الطازجة تعبق في الأجواء ممزوجة بعبق أزهار الياسمين من حديقة ليلى
english: The aroma of fresh coffee permeated the air, mixed with the fragrance of jasmine flowers from Layla's garden.
transliteration: Kānat rā'ihat al-qahwah at-tāzajah tabu fi al-ajwā' mamzūjatan bia'baq azhār al-yāsmeen min hadeeqat Layla.

arabic: تبادلا همومهما اليومية وتحديات الحياة المعاصرة بصدق يثبت عمق علاقتهما الجوارية
english: They genuinely exchanged their daily worries and the challenges of modern life, proving the depth of their neighborly relationship.
transliteration: Tabādalā humoomahumā al-yawmiyyah wa tahaddiyāt al-hayāh al-mu'āsirah bisidqin yuthbit umq alāqatihimā al-jiwāriyyah.

arabic: وفي هذه اللحظات الهادئة كانت الألفة والمودة سائدة بينهما كأنهما كيان واحد لا يفترق
english: And in these quiet moments, familiarity and affection prevailed between them, as if they were one inseparable entity.
transliteration: Wa fi hādhihi al-lahazāt al-hādi'ah kānat al-ulfah wal-mawaddah sā'idah baynahumā ka'annahumā kiyān wāhid lā yaftariq.

arabic: أحمد يستيقظ ويقول صباح الخير
english: Ahmed wakes up and says "Good morning".
transliteration: Ahmed yastayqidh wa yaqool "Sabah al-khayr".

arabic: أمه تجيب صباح النور يا حبيبي
english: His mother replies "Good morning, my dear".
transliteration: Ummuhu tujeeb "Sabah an-nur ya habibi".

arabic: ثم يسأل لماذا السماء زرقاء
english: Then he asks, "Why is the sky blue?"
transliteration: Thumma yasal "Limadha as-samaa' zarqaa'?".

arabic: وبعد قليل سأل لماذا الطيور تطير
english: And after a little while, he asked, "Why do birds fly?"
transliteration: Wa ba'da qaleel, sa'ala "Limadha at-tuyoor tateer?".

arabic: ابتسمت الأم وقالت أحمد يحب السؤال كثيرا
english: The mother smiled and said, "Ahmed loves asking questions a lot".
transliteration: Ibtasamat al-umm wa qalat "Ahmed yuhibb as-su'aal katheeran".

arabic: أمس اشتريت قميصا من المتجر
english: Yesterday, I bought a shirt from the shop.
transliteration: Ams ishtaraytu qamisan min al-matjar.

arabic: لكن القميص كان كبيرا جدا
english: But the shirt was very big.
transliteration: Lakinna al-qamisa kana kabiran jiddan.

arabic: اليوم رجعت الى المتجر مرة اخرى
english: Today, I returned to the shop once again.
transliteration: Al-yawm raja'tu ila al-matjar marratan ukhra.

arabic: قلت للبائع مرحبا هذا القميص كبير اريد قميصا صغيرا
english: I said to the seller, "Hello, this shirt is big. I want a small shirt."
transliteration: Qultu lil-ba'i' marhaban hadha al-qamisu kabirun uridu qamisan saghiran.

arabic: ابتسم البائع واعطاني قميصا صغيرا جديدا شكرا لك
english: The seller smiled and gave me a new small shirt. Thank you.
transliteration: Ibtasama al-ba'i' wa a'tani qamisan saghiran jadidan shukran lak.

arabic: مساء الخير انا جارك الجديد
english: Good evening I am your new neighbor
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr ana jaruka al-jadid

arabic: مساء النور اهلا بك ما اسمك
english: Good evening welcome what is your name
transliteration: Masa' an-nur ahlan bik ma ismuka

arabic: اسمي خالد وما اسمك
english: My name is Khalid and what is your name
transliteration: Ismi Khalid wa ma ismuki

arabic: اسمي نورة كيف حالك اليوم
english: My name is Noura how are you today
transliteration: Ismi Noura kayfa haluka al-yawm

arabic: انا بخير شكرا
english: I am fine thank you
transliteration: Ana bi-khayr shukran

arabic: العائلة في البيت اليوم
english: The family is in the house today.
transliteration: Al-a'ilah fi al-bayt al-yawm

arabic: هم ياكلون طعاما لذيذا
english: They are eating delicious food.
transliteration: Hum ya'kulun ta'aman ladhithan

arabic: الاب يقول هل تريدون ارزا ولحما
english: The father says "Do you want rice and meat?"
transliteration: Al-ab yaqul hal turidun aruzzan wa lahman

arabic: الام تقول نعم شكرا يا ابي
english: The mother says "Yes, thank you, my father."
transliteration: Al-umm taqul na'am shukran ya abi

arabic: الطفل يقول هل هنا مياه
english: The child says "Is there water here?"
transliteration: Al-tifl yaqul hal huna miyah

arabic: ذهبت سارة الى المتجر اليوم
english: Sarah went to the shop today.
transliteration: Dhahabat Sarah ila al-matjar al-yawm.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

arabic: قالت مرحبا اريد ارجاع هذا الشيء
english: She said: "Hello, I want to return this thing."
transliteration: Qalat marhaba ureed irja' hadha al-shay'.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

arabic: رد البائع اهلا بك ما المشكلة
english: The seller replied: "Welcome, what is the problem?"
transliteration: Radda al-ba'i' ahlan bik ma al-mushkilah?
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

arabic: قالت سارة اشتريت هذا امس ولكنه كبير
english: Sarah said: "I bought this yesterday, but it is big."
transliteration: Qalat Sarah ishtaraytu hadha ams wa lakinahu kabeer.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

arabic: قال البائع لا مشكلة تفضلي
english: The seller said: "No problem, please."
transliteration: Qala al-ba'i' la mushkilah tafaddali.
storyTitle: Daily Challenge: Returning Something to the Shop

arabic: ايمن يقول ماذا نفعل في نهاية الاسبوع
english: Ayman says: What do we do on the weekend?
transliteration: Ayman yaqul: madha naf'al fi nihayat al-usbu'?

arabic: سلمى تقول لنذهب الى حديقة المدينة
english: Salma says: Let's go to the city park.
transliteration: Salma taqul: linadhhab ila hadiqa al-madina.

arabic: ايمن يقول هذه فكرة جيدة
english: Ayman says: This is a good idea.
transliteration: Ayman yaqul: Hadhihi fikrah jayyidah.

arabic: سلمى تسال هل نريد قهوة هناك
english: Salma asks: Do we want coffee there?
transliteration: Salma tas'al: Hal nurid qahwah hunak?

arabic: ايمن يقول نعم نريد قهوة ومرحا
english: Ayman says: Yes, we want coffee and fun.
transliteration: Ayman yaqul: Na'am nurid qahwah wa marahan.

arabic: مساء اجتمعت العائلة في غرفة المعيشة.
english: In the evening, the family gathered in the living room.
transliteration: Masaa'an ijtama'at al-aa'ilatu fi ghurfat al-ma'eeshah.

arabic: أرادوا ان يخططوا لرحلة في عطلة نهاية الاسبوع القادم.
english: They wanted to plan a trip for the coming weekend.
transliteration: Aradoo an yukhattitoo li-rihlatin fi 'utlat nihayat al-usbu' al-qadim.

arabic: تكلم الاب بصوت سعيد عن رحلة الى مدينة جميلة.
english: The father spoke with a happy voice about a trip to a beautiful city.
transliteration: Takallama al-abu bi-sawtin sa'eedin 'an rihlatin ila madinatin jameelah.

arabic: كان الاطفال سعداء جدا بالفكرة للذهاب الى البحر.
english: The children were very happy with the idea to go to the sea.
transliteration: Kana al-atfalu su'ada' jiddan bil-fikrati li-l-dhahabi ila al-bahr.

arabic: سيسافرون بالسيارة يوم السبت وهم متحمسون للوقت الجميل معا.
english: They will travel by car on Saturday and are excited for the beautiful time together.
transliteration: Sa-yusafiroona bil-sayyarati yawm al-sabti wa hum mutahammisoon li-l-waqtil jameeli ma'an.

arabic: قررت سارة ان تطهو طبقا جديدا للمرة الاولى
english: Sarah decided to cook a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: Qarrarat Sarah an taṭhuwa ṭabaqan jadīdan lil-marrah al-ūlá.

arabic: تلبس مريلة المطبخ وتشعر بالحماس الشديد
english: She wears the kitchen apron and feels great excitement.
transliteration: Talbasu miryalat al-maṭbakh wa tashʿuru bil-ḥamās ash-shadīd.

arabic: تتبع الوصفة بحذر ولكنها قلقة قليلا
english: She follows the recipe carefully, but she is a little worried.
transliteration: Tattabiʿu al-waṣfah bi-ḥadhar walākinnhā qaliqah qalīlan.

arabic: بعد ان ذاقت قالت نعم يعجبني هذا الطبق جدا
english: After she tasted, she said, "Yes, I really like this dish."
transliteration: Baʿda an dhāqat qālat naʿam yuʿjibunī hādhā aṭ-ṭabaqu jiddan.

arabic: كانت سعيدة جدا بوجبتها اللذيذة ونجاحها الاول
english: She was very happy with her delicious meal and her first success.
transliteration: Kānat saʿīdah jiddan bi-wajbatihā al-ladhīdhah wa najāḥihā al-awwal.

arabic: وصلت الى المقهى صباحا
english: I arrived at the cafe in the morning.
transliteration: Wasaltu ila al-maqha sabahan.

arabic: قلت صباح الخير للنادل
english: I said good morning to the waiter.
transliteration: Qultu Sabah al-khayr li al-nadil.

arabic: اجاب صباح النور
english: He replied good morning (of light).
transliteration: Ajaba Sabah an-nur.

arabic: انتظرت عائلتي بسعادة
english: I waited for my family with happiness.
transliteration: Intazartu a'ilati bi-sa'adah.

arabic: جاءت امي وابي وشربنا القهوة معا
english: My mother and father came and we drank coffee together.
transliteration: Ja'at ummi wa abi wa sharibna al-qahwah ma'an.

arabic: السيدة أميرة رأت يوسف وقالت: صباح الخير يا سيد يوسف!
english: Ms. Amira saw Youssef and said: Good morning, Mr. Youssef!
transliteration: As-Sayyidatu Amira ra'at Yusuf wa-qalat: Sabah al-khayr ya Sayyid Yusuf!
storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

arabic: فرد يوسف مبتسماً: صباح النور يا أميرة، كيف حالك؟
english: Youssef replied, smiling: Good morning, Amira, how are you?
transliteration: Fa-radda Yusuf mubtasiman: Sabah an-nur ya Amira, kayfa haluk?
storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

arabic: أجابت أميرة: بخير والحمد لله، هل أنت مستعد؟
english: Amira replied: Well, thank God, are you ready?
transliteration: Ajabat Amira: Bi-khayrin wal-hamdu li-Allah, hal anta musta'idd?
storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

arabic: بعد الاجتماع، ودع يوسف: السلام عليكم، أراك مساءً.
english: After the meeting, Youssef bid farewell: Peace be upon you, I will see you in the evening.
transliteration: Ba'da al-ijtima', wadda'a Yusuf: As-salamu alaykum, araka masa'an.
storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

arabic: ردت أميرة: وعليكم السلام يا يوسف، مساء الخير، إلى اللقاء.
english: Amira replied: And peace be upon you too, Youssef, good evening, goodbye.
transliteration: Raddat Amira: Wa alaykum as-salam ya Yusuf, masa' al-khayr, ila al-liqa'.
storyTitle: A Greeting at the Doha Museum

arabic: بينما كنت متجها الى المكتبة المعهودة صباح اليوم وجدت نفسي تائها في حي لم اعهده من قبل مما اثار قلقي حيال موعدي المقرر
english: As I was heading to the usual library this morning, I found myself lost in an unfamiliar neighborhood, which raised my concern about my scheduled appointment.
transliteration: Baynama kuntu muttajihan ila al-maktabati al-ma'hudati sabaha al-yawmi wajadtu nafsi taihan fi hayyin lam a'ahadhu min qablu mimma athara qalqi hiyala maw'idi al-muqarrari.

arabic: بعد تردد وجيز اقتربت من مقهى يعج بالرواد وقررت ان استفسر عن الاتجاه الصحيح للشارع الرئيسي المؤدي الى وجهتي
english: After a brief hesitation, I approached a bustling cafe and decided to inquire about the correct direction to the main street leading to my destination.
transliteration: Ba'da taraddudin wajizin iqtarabtu min maqhan ya'ijju bil-ruwwadi wa qarrartu an astafsirra 'ani al-ittijahi al-sahihi lil-shari'i al-ra'isiyi al-mu'addiy ila wajhati.

arabic: ارشدني شاب ودود الى عبور مفترق الطرق عند اشارة المرور ومن ثم الانعطاف يمينا عند الدوار الكبير حيث يقع مبنى المكتبة
english: A friendly young man guided me to cross the intersection at the traffic light and then turn right at the large roundabout where the library building is located.
transliteration: Arshadani shabbun wadudun ila 'uburi muftaraqi al-turuqi 'inda isharati al-mururi wa min thamma al-in'itafi yaminan 'inda al-duwwari al-kabiri haythu yaqa'u mabna al-maktabati.

arabic: بتعليماته الواضحة واصلت سيري على الاقدام متجاوزا عدة محلات تجارية على الجانب الايمن مستشعرا بوادر الوصول
english: Following his clear instructions, I continued walking on foot, passing several shops on the right side, sensing the signs of arrival.
transliteration: Bita'limatihi al-wadihati wasaltu sairi 'ala al-aqdami mutajawizan 'iddata mahallatin tijariyatin 'ala al-janibi al-aymani mustash'iran bawadira al-wusuli.

arabic: وصلت الى وجهتي اخيرا شاكرا لطف الغرباء ومدركا اهمية الاستفسار عندما يضل المرء سبيله
english: I finally arrived at my destination, grateful for the kindness of strangers, and realizing the importance of asking for directions when one loses their way.
transliteration: Wasaltu ila wajhati akhiran shakiran lutf al-ghuraba'i wa mudrikan ahammiyyata al-istifsari 'indama yudillu al-mar'u sabilahu.

arabic: انا في المقهى اليوم
english: I am at the cafe today.
transliteration: Ana fi al-maqha al-yawm.

arabic: انا انتظر صديقي الجديد
english: I am waiting for my new friend.
transliteration: Ana antadhiru sadeeqi al-jadeed.

arabic: الوقت طويل جدا و انا اشرب الماء فقط
english: The time is very long and I only drink water.
transliteration: Al-waqtu taweelun jiddan wa ana ashrabu al-maa'a faqat.

arabic: ارى الناس يتحدثون كثيرا اين صديقي الان
english: I see people talking a lot. Where is my friend now?
transliteration: Ara an-nasa yatahaddathoon katheeran. Ayna sadeeqi al-aan?

arabic: ربما هو نائم في البيت
english: Perhaps he is sleeping at home.
transliteration: Rubbama huwa naa'imun fi al-bayt.

arabic: السلام عليكم صباح الخير يا أحمد
english: Hello good morning Ahmed
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr ya Ahmad

arabic: كيف حالك اليوم باب الثلاجة لا يغلق
english: How are you today The refrigerator door does not close
transliteration: Kayfa haluka al-yawm bab ath-thallajah la yughlaq

arabic: هذا مشكلة صغيرة ولكنها مضحكة
english: This is a small problem but it is funny
transliteration: Hadha mushkilah saghirah wa lakinaha mudhikah

arabic: أنا بخير ولكن الثلاجة ليست بخير
english: I am fine but the refrigerator is not fine
transliteration: Ana bi-khayr wa lakin ath-thallajah laysat bi-khayr

arabic: هل لديك حل يا صديقي ما اسمك
english: Do you have a solution my friend What is your name
transliteration: Hal ladayka hall ya sadeeqi ma ismuka

arabic: حاول السيد جمال تحية صديقه القديم، السيد فؤاد، الذي مر مسرعًا في سوق الحميدية.
english: Mr. Jamal tried to greet his old friend, Mr. Fouad, who hurried past in Al-Hamidiyah Souq.
transliteration: Hawala al-Sayyid Jamal tahiyyata sadeeqihi al-qadeem, al-Sayyid Fouad, alladhi marra musri'an fi Souq al-Hamidiyah.

arabic: اقترب منه قائلاً: "السلام عليكم يا أخي فؤاد، كيف حالك اليوم؟"
english: He approached him saying: "Peace be upon you, my brother Fouad, how are you today?"
transliteration: Iqtaraba minhu qa'ilan: "Al-salamu alaykum ya akhi Fouad, kayfa haluka al-yawm?"

arabic: لم يسمع فؤاد التحية، إذ كان منغمسًا في هاتفه، متجاهلاً نداء جمال.
english: Fouad did not hear the greeting, as he was engrossed in his phone, ignoring Jamal's call.
transliteration: Lam yasma' Fouad al-tahiyyah, idh kana munghamisًا fi hatifihi, mutajahilan nida' Jamal.

arabic: "يا له من أمر محير!" تمتم جمال لنفسه، "هل نسيني تمامًا؟"
english: "What a puzzling matter!" Jamal muttered to himself, "Has he completely forgotten me?"
transliteration: "Ya lahu min amr muhayyar!" tamtama Jamal li-nafsihi, "Hal nasiyani tamaman?"

arabic: قرر جمال أن يرفع صوته مرة أخرى، "يا فؤاد! صباح الخير، ألا تتذكرني؟"
english: Jamal decided to raise his voice again, "Fouad! Good morning, do you not remember me?"
transliteration: Qarrara Jamal an yarfa'a sawtahu marratan ukhra, "Ya Fouad! Sabah al-khayr, ala tatadhakkaroni?"

arabic: التفت فؤاد أخيرًا، بعينين واسعتين من الدهشة، وقال: "وعليكم السلام! جمال؟ أهلاً وسهلاً بك!"
english: Fouad finally turned, with wide eyes of surprise, and said: "And peace be upon you! Jamal? Welcome!"
transliteration: Iltatafa Fouad akhirًا, bi-'aynayni wasi'atayni min al-dahshah, wa-qala: "Wa 'alaykum al-salam! Jamal? Ahlan wa sahlan bik!"

arabic: صافحه جمال بحرارة قائلاً: "كيف حالك يا صديقي العزيز؟ لقد اشتقت إليك كثيرًا."
english: Jamal shook his hand warmly, saying: "How are you, my dear friend? I have missed you greatly."
transliteration: Safahahu Jamal bi-hararah qa'ilan: "Kayfa haluka ya sadeeqi al-'aziz? Laqad ishtaqtu ilayka kathiran."

arabic: اعتذر فؤاد عن إهماله، موضحًا أنه كان يبحث عن قهوة السلطان لزوجته.
english: Fouad apologized for his oversight, explaining that he was looking for Sultan's Coffee for his wife.
transliteration: I'tadhara Fouad 'an ihmalih, muwaddihan annahu kana yabhathu 'an qahwati al-Sultan li-zawjatihi.

arabic: ابتسم جمال ودعاه قائلاً: "تففضل معي، فلنشرب كوبًا من الشاي قبل أن تغادر."
english: Jamal smiled and invited him, saying: "Please come with me, let's drink a cup of tea before you leave."
transliteration: Ibtasama Jamal wa da'ahu qa'ilan: "Tafaddal ma'i, fa-li-nashrab kooobًا min al-shay qabla an tughadir."

arabic: وافق فؤاد شاكرًا، ووعد بزيارته في محله قريبًا، ثم ودع كل منهما الآخر بابتسامة.
english: Fouad agreed gratefully, and promised to visit him at his shop soon, then each of them bid farewell to the other with a smile.
transliteration: Wafaqqa Fouad shakirًا, wa wa'ada bi-ziyaratih fi mahallih qariban, thumma wadda'a kullun minhuma al-akhar bi-ibtisamah.

arabic: انا مع طفل صغير
english: I am with a small child
transliteration: Ana ma'a tifl saghir

arabic: الطفل يسال اسئلة كثيرة
english: The child asks many questions
transliteration: At-tifl yasal as'ilah kathirah

arabic: هو يسال ماذا هذا
english: He asks: What is this?
transliteration: Huwa yasal madha hadha

arabic: هو يسال اين السيارة
english: He asks: Where is the car?
transliteration: Huwa yasal ayna as-sayyarah

arabic: انا متعب لكن سعيد للاجابة
english: I am tired but happy to answer
transliteration: Ana mut'ab lakin sa'eed lil-ijabah

arabic: لينا كانت سعيدة جدا وهي تذهب إلى السوق لشراء ملابس جديدة
english: Lina was very happy as she went to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Lina kanat sa'eedatan jiddan wa hiya tadhhabu ila as-souqi li-shira'i malabisa jadeedah.

arabic: دخلت المتجر وقالت للبائعة مساء الخير
english: She entered the store and said to the saleswoman, "Good evening".
transliteration: Dakhalat al-matjara wa qalat lil-ba'i'ati masa' al-khayr.

arabic: البائعة ابتسمت وقالت مساء النور كيف حالك يا لينا
english: The saleswoman smiled and said, "Good evening, how are you, Lina?"
transliteration: Al-ba'i'atu ibtasamat wa qalat masa' an-noor kayfa haluki ya Lina.

arabic: اجابت لينا انا بخير شكرا لك وبدأت تبحث عن فستان جميل
english: Lina replied, "I am fine, thank you," and started looking for a beautiful dress.
transliteration: Ajabat Lina ana bi-khayr shukran laki wa bada'at tabhathu 'an fustanun jameel.

arabic: وجدت فستانا احمر رائعا وشعرت بفرح كبير عندما ارتدته
english: She found a wonderful red dress and felt great joy when she wore it.
transliteration: Wajadat fustanan ahmaran ra'i'an wa sha'arat bi-farahin kabeerin 'indama artadat-hu.

arabic: السلام عليكم صباح الخير استيقظ احمد مبكرا اليوم
english: Hello good morning Ahmad woke up early today
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr istayqadha Ahmad mubakkiran al-yawm

arabic: كان يريد قهوة لكن آلة القهوة لا تعمل
english: He wanted coffee but the coffee machine does not work
transliteration: Kana yuriddu qahwatan lakin alat al-qahwah la ta'mal

arabic: قال احمد لزوجته سارة كيف حالك
english: Ahmad said to his wife Sarah How are you
transliteration: Qala Ahmad li-zawjatihi Sarah kayfa haluki

arabic: اجابت سارة انا بخير شكرا لك لكن آلة القهوة معطلة
english: Sarah answered I am fine thank you but the coffee machine is broken
transliteration: Ajabat Sarah ana bi-khayr shukran lak lakin alat al-qahwah mu'attalah

arabic: يجب ان يجد احمد حلا سريعا لمشكلة القهوة كل صباح
english: Ahmad must find a quick solution for the coffee problem every morning
transliteration: Yajibu an yajida Ahmad hallan sari'an li-mushkilat al-qahwah kulli sabah

arabic: هذه عائلتي تجلس معا في البيت
english: This is my family sitting together in the house
transliteration: Hadhihi 'a'ilati tajlisu ma'an fi al-bayt

arabic: على الطاولة طعام لذيذ وكبير
english: On the table is delicious and big food
transliteration: 'Ala al-tawilah ta'am ladhidh wa kabir

arabic: ابي وامي ياكلان خبزا ولحما
english: My father and mother are eating bread and meat
transliteration: Abi wa ummi ya'kulan khubzan wa lahman

arabic: اخي واختي يشربان عصيرا وماء
english: My brother and sister are drinking juice and water
transliteration: Akhi wa ukhti yashraban 'asiran wa ma'

arabic: العائلة كلها سعيدة جدا اليوم
english: The whole family is very happy today
transliteration: Al-'a'ilah kulluha sa'idah jiddan al-yawm

arabic: امس اتصلت بصديقي احمد
english: Yesterday, I called my friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Amsi ittaṣaltu bi-ṣadīqī Aḥmada

arabic: سمعت صوته الواضح في الهاتف
english: I heard his clear voice on the phone.
transliteration: Sami'tu ṣawtahu al-wāḍiḥa fī al-hātifi

arabic: تكلمنا عن المدرسة والحديقة
english: We talked about school and the park.
transliteration: Takallamnā 'an al-madrasati wa al-ḥadīqati

arabic: كان يوما جميلا مع صديقي
english: It was a beautiful day with my friend.
transliteration: Kāna yawman jamīlan ma'a ṣadīqī

arabic: احب اصدقائي كثيرا
english: I love my friends very much.
transliteration: Uḥibbu aṣdiqāʾī kathīran

arabic: يوجد طفل صغير يسأل اسئلة كثيرة
english: There is a small child who asks many questions.
transliteration: Yujad tifl saghir yasal asila kathirah

arabic: يرى سيارة حمراء ويسأل ما هذا اللون
english: He sees a red car and asks "What is this color?"
transliteration: Yara sayyarah hamra' wa yasal ma hadha al lawn

arabic: يسمع صوت عصفور ويسأل كيف يغني
english: He hears a bird's sound and asks "How does it sing?"
transliteration: Yasma' sawt 'usfur wa yasal kayfa yughanni

arabic: اسئلته لا تنتهي مثل مطر خفيف
english: His questions are endless, like a soft rain.
transliteration: As'ilatuhu la tantahi mithl matar khafif

arabic: عيناه واسعتان متعجبتان دائما تبحثان عن اجابات
english: His eyes are wide with wonder, always looking for answers.
transliteration: 'Aynahu wasi'atan muta'ajjibatan da'iman tabhathan 'an ijabat

arabic: اجتمعت الاسرة حول المائدة الكبيرة في المساء
english: The family gathered around the large table in the evening.
transliteration: Ijtama'at al-usra hawla al-ma'ida al-kabira fi al-masa'

arabic: قال الاب مساء الخير ورد الجميع مساء النور
english: The father said 'Good evening' and everyone replied 'Good evening'.
transliteration: Qala al-ab masa' al-khayr wa radda al-jami' masa' an-nur

arabic: ضحك الاطفال وسالوا كيف حالك يا ابي
english: The children laughed and asked 'How are you, father?'.
transliteration: Dahika al-atfal wa sa'alu kayfa haluka ya abi

arabic: اجاب انا بخير شكرا بابتسامة سعيدة
english: He replied 'I am fine, thank you' with a happy smile.
transliteration: Ajaba ana bi-khayr shukran bi-ibtisama sa'ida

arabic: استمتع الجميع بالطعام اللذيذ والجو العائلي الدافئ
english: They all enjoyed the delicious food and warm family atmosphere.
transliteration: Istamta'a al-jami' bi al-ta'am al-ladhidh wa al-jaww al-'a'ili al-dafi'

arabic: استيقظ مبكرا كل صباح
english: I wake up early every morning.
transliteration: Astayqith mubakkiran kull sabah.

arabic: اقول لاهلي صباح الخير
english: I say "Good morning" to my family.
transliteration: Aqulu li ahli Sabah al-khayr.

arabic: يردون صباح النور
english: They respond, "Good morning (of light)."
transliteration: Yarudduna Sabah an-nur.

arabic: اذهب الى المدرسة والقي السلام على اصدقائي
english: I go to school and greet my friends (say "peace be upon you").
transliteration: Adhhab ila al-madrasah wa ulqi as-salam ala asdiqa'i.

arabic: يقولون وعليكم السلام ونبدا الدرس
english: They say "And peace be upon you too" and we begin the lesson.
transliteration: Yaquluna Wa alaykum as-salam wa nabda'u ad-dars.

arabic: ذهبت الى السوق لاشتري ملابس جديدة
english: I went to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-suq li-ashtariya malabis jadidah

arabic: رايت فستانا جميلا في احد المحلات الكبيرة
english: I saw a beautiful dress in one of the big shops.
transliteration: Ra'aytu fustan jamilan fi ahad al-mahallat al-kabirah

arabic: قررت ان اشتريه لانه اعجبني كثيرا
english: I decided to buy it because I liked it a lot.
transliteration: Qarrartu an ashtariyah li'annahu a'jabani kathiran

arabic: جربت الفستان وكان المقاس مناسبا جدا
english: I tried on the dress and the size was very suitable.
transliteration: Jarrabtu al-fustan wa kana al-miqas munasiban jiddan

arabic: دفعت الثمن وخرجت من المتجر سعيدة
english: I paid the price and left the store happy.
transliteration: Dafa'tu ath-thaman wa kharajtu min al-matjar sa'idah

arabic: اليوم كانت هناك مباراة كرة قدم في الملعب الكبير
english: Today there was a football match in the big stadium.
transliteration: Al-yawm kaanat hunaaka mubaaraatu kurat qadamin fil-mal'ab il-kabeer.

arabic: كان فريق الاسود يلعب ضد فريق النمور
english: The Lions team was playing against the Tigers team.
transliteration: Kaana fareequ l-usoodi yal'abu didda fareeqi n-numoor.

arabic: ركض لاعب صغير بسرعة كبيرة نحو المرمى
english: A small player ran very fast towards the goal.
transliteration: Rakada laa'ibun sagheerun bi-sur'atin kabeeratin nahwa l-marma.

arabic: لكنه لم يضرب الكرة بل سقط على الارض وضحك الجميع
english: But he did not hit the ball, instead he fell on the ground and everyone laughed.
transliteration: La-kinnahu lam yadrib il-kurata bal saqata 'ala l-ardi wa dahik al-jamee'.

arabic: لم يكن هناك هدف لكن الجميع كانوا سعداء جدا بضحكة اللاعب
english: There was no goal but everyone was very happy with the player's laugh.
transliteration: Lam yakun hunaaka hadafun la-kinna l-jamee'a kaanoo su'adaa'a jiddan bi-dahkat il-laa'ib.

arabic: ليلى سلمت على البائع في شارع الأزهر.
english: Layla greeted the seller on Al-Azhar Street.
transliteration: Layla sallamat 'ala al-ba'i' fi shari' al-Azhar.

arabic: قال البائع: أهلاً بك يا ليلى، كيف حالك؟
english: The seller said: "Welcome, Layla, how are you?"
transliteration: Qala al-ba'i': "Ahlan biki ya Layla, kayfa haluki?"

arabic: أجابت ليلى: بخير، شكراً. أبحث عن كتاب نادر.
english: Layla replied: "Fine, thank you. I am looking for a rare book."
transliteration: Ajabat Layla: "Bikhayr, shukran. Abhatthu 'an kitab nadir."

arabic: ابتسم البائع وقال: تفضلي، سأساعدك فوراً.
english: The seller smiled and said: "Please, I will help you immediately."
transliteration: Ibtasama al-ba'i' wa qala: "Tafaddali, sa'usa'iduki fawran."

arabic: شكرته ليلى وقالت: مع السلامة، أراك قريباً.
english: Layla thanked him and said: "Goodbye, see you soon."
transliteration: Shakarat'hu Layla wa qalat: "Ma'a al-salamah, araki qariban."

arabic: صباح الخير استيقظت مبكرا للذهاب الى العمل
english: Good morning I woke up early to go to work.
transliteration: Sabah al-khayr istayqaztu mubakkiran lil-thahabi ila al-amal.

arabic: في الطريق قابلت صديقي احمد وسالته كيف حالك
english: On the way I met my friend Ahmed and asked him How are you.
transliteration: Fi al-tariq qabaltu sadiqi Ahmad wa sa'altuhu kayfa haluka.

arabic: اجاب احمد انا بخير لكنني نسيت محفظتي في البيت
english: Ahmed replied I am fine but I forgot my wallet at home.
transliteration: Ajaba Ahmad ana bi-khayr lakinnani nasitu mihfazati fi al-bayt.

arabic: ضحكت وقلت له لا تقلق سادفع انا اليوم
english: I laughed and told him Do not worry I will pay today.
transliteration: Dahiktu wa qultu lahu la taqlaq sa'adfa'u ana al-yawm.

arabic: في المساء بعد يوم طويل عدنا وقلنا مساء الخير للمدير ثم ذهبنا الى المنزل
english: In the evening after a long day we returned and said good evening to the manager then went home.
transliteration: Fi al-masa' ba'da yawm tawil 'udna wa qulna masa' al-khayr lil-mudir thumma dhahabna ila al-manzil.

arabic: جلست في المقهى انتظر صديقي.
english: I sat in the cafe waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Jalastu fi al-maqha antaziru ṣadīqī.

arabic: مر بعض الوقت ولم تصل اي رسالة على هاتفي.
english: Some time passed and no message arrived on my phone.
transliteration: Marra baʿḍu al-waqti wa lam taṣil ayyu risālatin ʿalā hātifī.

arabic: نظرت من النافذة الى الشارع بينما كان صديقي متأخرا كالعادة.
english: I looked out the window at the street while my friend was late as usual.
transliteration: Naẓartu min al-nāfidhati ilā al-shāriʿi baynamā kāna ṣadīqī mutaʾakhkhiran kal-ʿādati.

arabic: قررت ان اطلب فنجان قهوة لاشربها خلال هذا الانتظار الطويل.
english: I decided to order a cup of coffee to drink during this long wait.
transliteration: Qarrartu an aṭluba finjāna qahwatin li-ashrabahā khilāla hādhā al-intizāri al-ṭawīli.

arabic: بعد قليل رأيت ابتسامة صديقي تظهر من بعيد.
english: After a while, I saw my friend's smile appearing from afar.
transliteration: Baʿda qalīlin raʾaytu ibtisāmata ṣadīqī taẓharu min baʿīd.

arabic: مشيت في الشارع ورأيت صديقي القديم
english: I walked in the street and saw my old friend.
transliteration: Mashaytu fī ash-shāriʿi wa ra'aytu ṣadīqī al-qadīm.

arabic: اسمه احمد وكان طالبا ذكيا
english: His name is Ahmed and he was a smart student.
transliteration: Ismuhu Aḥmadu wa kāna ṭāliban dhakiyyan.

arabic: سالته ماذا تفعل الان يا احمد
english: I asked him "What do you do now, Ahmed?"
transliteration: Sa'altuhu mādhā tafʿalu al-āna yā Aḥmadu.

arabic: قال انا الان شرطي في المدينة
english: He said, "I am now a policeman in the city."
transliteration: Qāla anā al-āna shurṭiyyun fī al-madīnati.

arabic: لكنني اتذكر انه قال اريد ان اكون طبيبا
english: But I remember he said, "I want to be a doctor."
transliteration: Lākinnanī atadhakkaru annahu qāla urīdu an akūna ṭabīban.

arabic: بدأ المطر يهطل بغزارة بعد الظهر فجأة بينما كنت احاول قراءة كتاب
english: The rain started pouring heavily suddenly in the afternoon while I was trying to read a book
transliteration: Bada' al-matar yahtil bi-ghazarah ba'da az-zohr faj'atan baynama kuntu uhawil qira'at kitab

arabic: كان الجو منعشا داخل المنزل لكن النافذة نسيت مفتوحة قليلا
english: The weather was refreshing inside the house, but the window was left slightly open
transliteration: Kana al-jaww mun'ishan dakhil al-manzil lakin an-nafitha nusiyat maftuhatan qalilan

arabic: وحين نهضت لاغلاقها انزلقت قدمي على بقعة ماء صغيرة وضحكت على نفسي بصوت عال
english: And when I got up to close it, my foot slipped on a small puddle, and I laughed out loud at myself
transliteration: Wa heena nahadhtu li-ighlaqiha inzalaqat qadami 'ala buq'at ma'in saghirah wa dahiktu 'ala nafsi bi-sawti 'alin

arabic: ثم سمعت رنين الباب وكان جاري يقول مساء الخير وهو يحمل مظلة كبيرة
english: Then I heard the doorbell, and it was my neighbor saying 'Good evening' while carrying a large umbrella
transliteration: Thumma sami'tu raneen al-bab wa kana jari yaqool Masa' al-khayr wa huwa yahmil mizallatan kabeerah

arabic: ابتسمت وقلت وعليكم السلام تفضل بالدخول قبل ان تبتل اكثر
english: I smiled and said 'And peace be upon you too, please come in before you get wetter'
transliteration: Ibtasamtu wa qultu Wa alaykum as-salam tafaddal bid-dukhul qabla an tabtall akthar

arabic: مساء الخير في بيت سارة الباب لا يغلق جيدا
english: Good evening at Sarah's house. The door does not close well.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr fi bayt Sarah. Al-bab la yughlaq jayyidan.

arabic: هذا ليس جيدا لاستقبال الضيوف في البيت
english: This is not good for receiving guests at home.
transliteration: Hadha laysa jayyidan li-istiqbal ad-dhuyuf fi al-bayt.

arabic: سارة تحتاج مساعدة للباب
english: Sarah needs help with the door.
transliteration: Sarah tahtaj musa'adah lil-bab.

arabic: هي تسأل جارها احمد كيف حالكَ يا احمد
english: She asks her neighbor Ahmed: How are you, Ahmed?
transliteration: Hiya tas'al jaraha Ahmed: Kayfa haluka ya Ahmed?

arabic: احمد يقول انا بخير وسوف يساعدها
english: Ahmed says: I am fine, and he will help her.
transliteration: Ahmed yaqul: Ana bi-khayr wa sawfa yusa'iduha.

arabic: دخلت المقهى وجلست على كرسي
english: I entered the cafe and sat on a chair
transliteration: Dakhaltu al-maqha wa jalastu ʿala kursiyyin

arabic: كنت انتظر صديقتي بفارغ الصبر
english: I was waiting for my friend impatiently
transliteration: Kuntu antaẓiru ṣadīqatī bifārighi al-ṣabri

arabic: رأيت احد عشر قلما على الطاولة الكبيرة
english: I saw eleven pens on the large table
transliteration: Raʾaytu aḥada ʿashara qalaman ʿala al-ṭāwila al-kabīra

arabic: شعرت ببعض الملل ثم ابتسمت
english: I felt some boredom then I smiled
transliteration: Shaʿartu bibaʿḍi al-malali thumma ibtasamtu

arabic: اخيرا وصلت صديقتي وكنا سعداء جدا
english: Finally my friend arrived and we were very happy
transliteration: Akhīran waṣalat ṣadīqatī wa kunnā suʿadāʾa jiddan

arabic: شعرت الدكتورة ليلى، المعروفة بدقتها، بومضة قلق وهي تلقي التحية على طالبها السابق، عمر، قرب معروضات المتحف الفرعونية.
english: Dr. Layla, known for her punctuality, felt a surge of anxiety as she greeted her former student, Omar, near the museum's pharaonic exhibits.
transliteration: Sha'arat ad-duktūrah Layla, al-ma'rūfah bi-diqqatihā, bi-wamḍat qalaqin wa hiya tulqī at-taḥīyah 'alā ṭālibihā as-sābiq, 'Umar, qurba ma'rūḍāt al-matḥaf al-fir'awnīyah.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: "السلام عليكم يا عمر، كيف حالك اليوم؟" تساءلت محاولة الإيجاز في نبرتها.
english: "Peace be upon you, Omar, how are you today?" she inquired, trying to keep her tone brief.
transliteration: "As-salāmu 'alaykum yā 'Umar, kayfa ḥāluka al-yawm?" tasa'alat muḥāwilatan al-ījāza fī nabratihā.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: رد عمر، الأثري الشاب، بإطالة: "وعليكم السلام يا دكتورة، أنا بخير والحمد لله، وأنتِ؟" مبتدئاً تبادلاً أطول.
english: Omar, the young archaeologist, responded with a lengthy: "And upon you be peace, Doctor, I am well, praise be to God, and you?" initiating a longer exchange.
transliteration: Radda 'Umar, al-atharī ash-shāb, bi-iṭālah: "Wa 'alaykum as-salām yā duktūrah, anā bi-khayrin wal-ḥamdu lillāh, wa anti?" mubtadi'an tabādulān aṭwala.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: ثم اقترب الأستاذ حسن، زميلها، ماداً يده بحرارة: "صباح الخير يا ليلى، هل أنتِ ذاهبة إلى اجتماع الوفد الياباني؟"
english: Then Professor Hassan, her colleague, approached, extending his hand warmly: "Good morning, Layla, are you going to the Japanese delegation meeting?"
transliteration: Thumma iqtaraba al-ustādh Ḥasan, zamīluhā, māddan yadahu bi-ḥarārah: "Ṣabāḥ al-khayr yā Layla, hal anti dhāhibatun ilā ijtima' al-wafdi al-yābānī?"
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: ردت الدكتورة ليلى تحيته: "صباح النور يا أستاذ حسن، نعم، أنا في طريقي إليه الآن،" رامقة ساعتها اليدوية، تلميحاً خفياً.
english: Dr. Layla returned his greeting: "Good morning (of light), Professor Hassan, yes, I am on my way to it now," glancing at her wristwatch, a subtle hint.
transliteration: Raddat ad-duktūrah Layla taḥīyatahu: "Ṣabāḥ an-nūr yā ustādh Ḥasan, na'am, anā fī ṭarīqī ilayhi al-ān," rāmiqatun sā'atahā al-yadawīyah, talmīḥan khafīyan.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: بعد إلقاء التحايا، لم يدعها الأستاذ حسن تمر، بل بدأ: "يا ليلى، كيف حالك بعد اجتماع الأمس؟" ثم أصر على مناقشة الاكتشافات الأثرية الأخيرة.
english: After exchanging greetings, Professor Hassan did not let her pass, but began: "Layla, how are you after yesterday's meeting?" then he insisted on discussing the recent archaeological discoveries.
transliteration: Ba'da ilqā'i at-taḥāyā, lam yada'hā al-ustādhu Ḥasanun tamurra, bal bada'a: "Yā Layla, kayfa ḥāluki ba'da ijtima'i al-amsi?" thumma aṣarra 'alā munāqashat al-iktishāfāt al-atharīyah al-akhīrah.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: تنهدت ليلى داخلياً، مفكرة بالوفد القادم، لكنها تمكنت من قول "مع السلامة يا أستاذ، يجب أن أنصرف الآن" بتهذيب، متخذة قرارها.
english: Layla internally sighed, thinking of the approaching delegation, but she managed to say "Goodbye, Professor, I must leave now" politely, making her decision.
transliteration: Tanahhadat Layla dākhilīyan, mufakkiratan bil-wafdi al-qādim, lakinnahā tamakkanat min qawli "Ma'a as-salāmah yā ustādh, yajibu an anṣarifa al-ān" bi-tahdhīb, muttakhidhatan qarārahā.
storyTitle: The Urgent Greeting: Layla at the National Museum

arabic: أضاف عمر بسرعة: "إلى اللقاء قريباً يا دكتورة، أتمنى لكِ يوماً موفقاً!" محترماً استعجالها.
english: Omar quickly added: "See you soon, Doctor, I wish you a successful day!" respecting her urgency.
