arabic: في الطريق قابلت جارتها وقالت لها صباح الخير فردت الجارة بخير شكرا
english: On the way, she met her neighbor and said "Good morning." The neighbor replied "Fine, thank you."
transliteration: Fi al-tariq qabalat jarrataha wa qalat laha sabah al-khayr fa-raddat al-jarrah bi-khayr shukran

arabic: مساء الخير يا سيدي الجديد كيف حالك اليوم
english: Good evening, my new sir, how are you today
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr ya sayyidi al-jadid kayfa haluka al-yawm
storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

arabic: ساله الجار القديم ما اسمك من فضلك انا لا اتذكر
english: The old neighbor asked him 'What's your name please I don't remember'
transliteration: Sa'alahu al-jaru al-qadim ma ismuka min fadlik ana la atadhakkar
storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

arabic: اجاب الجار الجديد اسمي احمد وانا بخير والحمد لله
english: The new neighbor replied 'My name is Ahmed and I am fine praise be to God'
transliteration: Ajaba al-jaru al-jadid ismi Ahmad wa ana bi-khayr wal-hamdu lillah
storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

arabic: قال الجار القديم تشرفنا يا احمد شكرا جزيلا لمساعدتك
english: The old neighbor said 'Nice to meet you Ahmed thank you very much for your help'
transliteration: Qala al-jaru al-qadim tasharrafna ya Ahmad shukran jazeelan li-musa'adatika
storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

arabic: بعد دقائق ساله الجار القديم عفوا ما اسمك مرة اخرى
english: After a few minutes the old neighbor asked him 'Excuse me what's your name again'
transliteration: Ba'da daqa'iq sa'alahu al-jaru al-qadim 'afwan ma ismuka marratan ukhra
storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

arabic: زرت خالتي امس
english: I visited my maternal aunt yesterday
transliteration: Zurtu khalati ams

arabic: كانت سعيدة جدا برؤيتي
english: She was very happy to see me
transliteration: Kanat sa'idatan jiddan biru'yati

arabic: كان خالي هناك ايضا وهو يدرس اللغة العربية كل يوم
english: My maternal uncle was also there, and he studies the Arabic language every day
transliteration: Kana khali hunaka aydaan wa huwa yadrusu al-lughata al-Arabiyyata kulla yawm

arabic: تحدثنا عن اشياء كثيرة وضحكنا كثيرا
english: We talked about many things and laughed a lot
transliteration: Tahaddathna an ashyaa'a kathiratin wa dahikna kathiran

arabic: شعرت بالفرح وسازورهم الاسبوع القادم
english: I felt joy and will visit them again next week
transliteration: Sha'artu bil-farahi wa sa'azuruhum al-usbua al-qadim

arabic: رن هاتف سارة
english: Sara's phone rang
transliteration: Ranna hatif Sara
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: قالت سارة مساء الخير
english: Sara said good evening
transliteration: Qalat Sara masa al-khayr
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: كيف حالك يا صديقتي
english: How are you my friend
transliteration: Kayfa haluki ya sadiqati
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: ردت الصديقة انا بخير شكرا
english: The friend replied I am fine thank you
transliteration: Raddat as-sadiqah ana bi-khayr shukran
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: شعرت سارة بسعادة كبيرة
english: Sara felt great happiness
transliteration: Shaarat Sara bi-sa'adah kabirah
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: ضج السوق النابض بالحياة بالنشاط حين بدات بحثي عن ملابس جديدة
english: The vibrant market buzzed with activity as I began my search for new clothes.
transliteration: Dhajja as-sūq an-nābid bi-l-ḥayāh bi-n-nashāṭ ḥīna bada'tu baḥthī an malābis jadīdah.
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: جذبني الملمس الناعم للقطن الفاخر والاقمشة الحريرية اللامعة لاستكشف المزيد
english: The soft touch of fine cotton and the shimmering silk fabrics enticed me to explore further.
transliteration: Jadhabanī al-malmas an-nā'im li-l-quṭn al-fākhir wa-l-aqmishah al-ḥarīrīyah al-lāmi'ah li-astakshifa al-mazīd.
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: اختلطت الروائح العطرية للمصنوعات الجلدية بعبق خفيف من المنسوجات المغسولة حديثا خالقة اجواء فريدة
english: Aromatic scents of leather goods mingled with the faint fragrance of newly washed textiles, creating a unique ambiance.
transliteration: Ikhtalaṭat ar-rawā'iḥ al-'iṭrīyah li-l-maṣnū'āt al-jildīyah bi-'abaq khafīf min al-mansūjāt al-maghsūlah ḥadīthan khāliqatn ajwā'an farīdah.
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: قضيت وقتا طويلا في التفكير بين بدلة زرقاء داكنة وثوب تقليدي مطرز باناقة
english: I spent a long time deliberating between a dark blue suit and an elegantly embroidered traditional dress.
transliteration: Qaḍaytu waqtan ṭawīlan fī at-tafkīr bayna badlah zarqā' dākinah wa thawb taqlīdī muṭarraz bi-anāqah.
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: في النهاية اخترت البدلة وشعرت بالرضا عن شرائي متطلعا لارتدائها قريبا
english: Ultimately, I chose the suit, feeling a sense of satisfaction with my purchase, anticipating wearing it soon.
transliteration: Fī an-nihāyah ikhtartu al-badlah wa sha'artu bi-r-riḍā an shirā'ī mutaṭalli'an li-irtidā'ihā qarīban.
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: السلام عليكم صباح الخير يا احمد
english: Hello good morning Ahmed
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum sabah al-khayr ya Ahmad

arabic: وعليكم السلام صباح النور كيف حالكَ يا صديقي
english: And peace be upon you too good morning How are you my friend
transliteration: Wa alaykum as-salam sabah an-nur kayfa haluka ya sadeeqi

arabic: انا بخير شكرا لك
english: I am fine thank you
transliteration: Ana bi-khayr shukran laka

arabic: حصتنا الاولى اليوم هي اللغة العربية
english: Our first class today is Arabic language
transliteration: Hissatuna al-ula al-yawm hiya al-lughat al-Arabiyyah

arabic: هيا بنا نذهب الى الفصل الان
english: Let's go to the classroom now
transliteration: Hayya bina nadhhab ila al-fasl al-an

arabic: استيقظت مبكرا قلت صباح الخير
english: I woke up early. I said, "Good morning."
transliteration: Istayqadhtu mubakkiran qultu sabah al-khayr

arabic: قال صديقي صباح النور ذهبنا الى الملعب
english: My friend said, "Good morning." We went to the stadium.
transliteration: Qala sadiqi sabah an-nur dhahabna ila al-mal'ab

arabic: شاهدنا مباراة كرة القدم
english: We watched a football game.
transliteration: Shahadna mubarat kurat al-qadam

arabic: المباراة كانت ممتعة جدا
english: The game was very fun.
transliteration: Al-mubaraat kanat mumti'atan jiddan

arabic: قلنا السلام عليكم للناس كنا سعداء
english: We said "Hello" to people. We were happy.
transliteration: Qulna as-salamu alaykum lil-nas kunna su'ada'

arabic: قررت اسرتي وانا التخطيط لرحلة نهاية الاسبوع هذا الاسبوع.
english: My family and I decided to plan a weekend trip this week.
transliteration: Qarrarat usrati wa ana at-takhteet li rihlat nihayat al-usbu' hadha al-usbu'.

arabic: سنذهب لزيارة مدينة قديمة معروفة باسواقها التقليدية ومعالمها الجميلة.
english: We will go to visit an old city known for its traditional markets and beautiful landmarks.
transliteration: Sanadhhab li ziyarat madinah qadeemah ma'roofah bi aswaqiha at-taqleediyyah wa ma'alimiha al-jameelah.

arabic: في يوم الجمعة سنتناول وجبة تقليدية لذيذة مع الناس المحليين.
english: On Friday, we will have a delicious traditional meal with the local people.
transliteration: Fi yawm al-jum'ah sanatanawal wajbah taqleediyyah ladheedhah ma'a an-naas al-mahalliyyeen.

arabic: نحب التحدث مع الناس هناك ونتعلم عن عاداتهم.
english: We love talking with people there and learning about their customs.
transliteration: Nuhibb at-tahadduth ma'a an-naas hunaak wa nata'allam 'an 'adatihima.

arabic: في المساء سنستمتع بشرب القهوة العربية ومشاهدة غروب الشمس.
english: In the evening, we will enjoy drinking Arabic coffee and watching the sunset.
transliteration: Fi al-masaa' sanastamti' bi shurb al-qahwah al-'arabiyyah wa mushahadat ghuroob ash-shams.

arabic: اليوم قررت ان اطبخ طبقا جديدا
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish.
transliteration: Al-yawm qarrartu an atbukha tabaqan jadidan.
storyTitle: My New Dish for My Cat

arabic: ذهبت الى السوق واشتريت كل شيء
english: I went to the market and bought everything.
transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-souq wa ishtaraytu kulla shay'.
storyTitle: My New Dish for My Cat

arabic: بدات اطبخ في المطبخ والرائحة كانت طيبة
english: I started cooking in the kitchen, and the smell was good.
transliteration: Bada'tu atbukhu fi al-matbakh wa ar-ra'ihatu kanat tayyibah.
storyTitle: My New Dish for My Cat

arabic: مساء الخير يا امي كيف حالك انا بخير شكرا
english: Good evening my mother, how are you? I am fine, thank you.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr ya ummi kayfa haluki ana bi-khayr shukran.
storyTitle: My New Dish for My Cat

arabic: قالت امي الطبق ليس لنا هو لقطتنا الصغيرة
english: My mother said: "The dish is not for us, it is for our little cat!"
transliteration: Qalat ummi at-tabaqu laysa lana huwa li-qittatina as-saghirah!
storyTitle: My New Dish for My Cat

arabic: في مساء جميل ذهبت الى حفل عيد ميلاد صديقتي سارة
english: On a beautiful evening, I went to my friend Sarah's birthday party
transliteration: Fi masa'in jameelin thahabtu ila hafli 'eidi miladi sadiqati Sarah

arabic: عندما وصلت قلت السلام عليكم لكل الاصدقاء
english: When I arrived, I said 'As-salamu alaykum' to all the friends
transliteration: Indama wasaltu qultu As-salamu alaykum likulli al-asdiqa'

arabic: هم ردوا علي وعليكم السلام ومساء النور
english: They responded to me, 'Wa alaykum as-salam' and 'Masa' an-nur'
transliteration: Hum raddu alayya Wa alaykum as-salamu wa Masa' an-nur

arabic: كان الحفل ممتعا جدا وتناولنا كعكة لذيذة
english: The party was very enjoyable, and we ate a delicious cake
transliteration: Kana al-haflu mumti'an jiddan wa tanawalna ka'katan ladhidhah

arabic: قضيت وقتا سعيدا جدا مع سارة واصدقائنا
english: I spent a very happy time with Sarah and our friends
transliteration: Qadaytu waqtan sa'idan jiddan ma'a Sarah wa asdiqa'ina

arabic: أخي طفل صغير
english: My brother is a small child.
transliteration: Akhi tifl saghir.

arabic: هو يسأل أسئلة كثيرة كل يوم
english: He asks many questions every day.
transliteration: Huwa yas'al as'ilah kathirah kull yawm.

arabic: يقول ماذا هذا
english: He says, "What is this?"
transliteration: Yaqul madha hadha.

arabic: يسأل عن البيت والسيارة الكبيرة
english: He asks about the house and the big car.
transliteration: Yas'al an al-bayt wa al-sayyarah al-kabirah.

arabic: إنه يوم طويل مع أسئلته
english: It is a long day with his questions.
transliteration: Innahu yawm tawil ma'a as'ilatih.

arabic: دخل احمد البيت مساء الخير
english: Ahmad entered the house good evening
transliteration: Dakhala Ahmad al-bayt masa' al-khayr

arabic: سمع احمد صوتا غريبا في المطبخ
english: Ahmad heard a strange sound in the kitchen
transliteration: Sami'a Ahmad sawtan ghariban fi al-matbakh

arabic: ذهب ليرى ما المشكلة وقال كيف حالكَ للصوت
english: He went to see what the problem was and said How are you to the sound
transliteration: Dhahaba liyara ma al-mushkilah wa qala kayfa haluka li as-sawt

arabic: كان هناك قط صغير يلعب بالماء
english: There was a small cat playing with the water
transliteration: Kana hunaka qitt saghir yal'abu bil-ma'

arabic: ابتسم احمد وقال انا بخير الان
english: Ahmad smiled and said I am fine now
transliteration: Ibtasama Ahmad wa qala ana bi-khayrin al-an

arabic: كان احمد يسير في المدينة ولكنه ضل طريقه الى السوق
english: Ahmad was walking in the city but he lost his way to the market.
transliteration: Kana Ahmad yasiru fil madinati walakinnahu dalla tariqahu ila as-suqi.

arabic: راى امرأة تقف قريبا فقرر ان يطلب منها المساعدة
english: He saw a woman standing nearby so he decided to ask her for help.
transliteration: Ra'a imra'atan taqifu qariban faqarrara an yatlub minhal musa'adah.

arabic: قال لها مساء الخير يا اختي ما جنسيتك وهل تعرفين اين السوق المركزي
english: He said to her "Good evening, my sister, what is your nationality, and do you know where the central market is?"
transliteration: Qala laha masa'a al-khayri ya ukhti ma jinsiyyatuki wa hal ta'rifina ayna as-suqu al-markaziy.

arabic: اجابت المرأة جنسيتي اردنية والسوق المركزي قريب من هنا سيري فقط للامام ثم انعطفي يمينا
english: The woman replied, "My nationality is Jordanian, and the central market is close by. Just walk straight ahead, then turn right."
transliteration: Ajabatil mar'atu jinsiyyati Urduniyyah was-suqu al-markaziy qaribun min huna siri faqat lil-amami thumma in'atifi yaminan.

arabic: شكرها احمد كثيرا ومضى في طريقه الى السوق
english: Ahmad thanked her very much and continued on his way to the market.
transliteration: Shakraha Ahmad kathiran wa mada fi tariqihi ila as-suqi.

arabic: اتصلت بصديقي احمد
english: I called my friend Ahmed
transliteration: Ittasaltu bisadiqi Ahmad

arabic: سالني ماذا تفعل
english: He asked me 'What are you doing?'
transliteration: Sa'alani madha taf'al

arabic: قلت له انا في البيت
english: I said to him 'I am in the house'
transliteration: Qultu lahu ana fi al-bayt

arabic: قال لي هل المدينة كبيرة
english: He said to me 'Is the city big?'
transliteration: Qala li hal al-madinatu kabirah

arabic: هل يوجد طفل صغير في البيت
english: Is there a small child in the house?
transliteration: Hal yujadu tiflun saghirun fi al-bayt

arabic: ذهبت لزيارة عمتي في بيتها الجديد
english: I went to visit my aunt in her new house.
transliteration: Zahabtu liziyarati ammati fi baytiha al-jadidi.

arabic: كان بيتها كبيرا وجميلا جدا
english: Her house was very big and beautiful.
transliteration: Kana baytuha kabiran wajamilan jiddan.

arabic: قدمت عمتي لي الشاي والقهوة
english: My aunt offered me tea and coffee.
transliteration: Qaddamat ammati li ash-shaya wal-qahwah.

arabic: تحدثنا عن اخبار العائلة والعمل
english: We talked about family news and work.
transliteration: Tahaddathna an akhbari al-ailati wal-amal.

arabic: فجأة قالت قطتها اهلا بك
english: Suddenly her cat said 'Welcome!'
transliteration: Faj'atan qalat qittatuha ahlan bik.

arabic: اليوم كانت هناك مباراة كرة قدم كبيرة بين فريقين مضحكين
english: Today there was a big football match between two funny teams
transliteration: Al-yawma kaanat hunaaka mubaraatu kurati qadamin kabeeratin bayna fareeqayni mudhikayni

arabic: لاعب واحد كان بطيئا جدا والكرة كانت سريعة جدا
english: One player was very slow and the ball was very fast
transliteration: Laa'ibun waahidun kaana bateei'an jiddan wal-kuratu kaanat saree'atan jiddan

arabic: حاول اللاعب ان يسجل هدفا لكنه سقط على الارض
english: The player tried to score a goal but he fell on the ground
transliteration: Haawala al-laa'ibu an yusajjila hadafan lakinahu saqata 'ala al-ard

arabic: الجمهور في الملعب ضحك كثيرا عندما رأوا هذا الموقف
english: The audience in the stadium laughed a lot when they saw this situation
transliteration: Al-jumhooru fi al-mal'abi dhahika katheeran 'indamaa ra'aw haadhaa al-mawgifa

arabic: لم يفز احد في المباراة لكن الجميع قضوا وقتا ممتعا ومضحكا
english: No one won the match but everyone had a fun and funny time
transliteration: Lam yafuz ahadun fi al-mubaaraati lakinna al-jamee'a qadhaw waqtan mumti'an wa mudhikan

arabic: مساء الخير ذهبت سارة الى المتجر لتعيد قميصا اشترته امس
english: Good evening, Sarah went to the shop to return a shirt she bought yesterday.
transliteration: Masa' al-khayr thahabat Sarah ila al-matjar litu'eed qamisan ishtarathu ams.

arabic: قالت سارة للبائع السلام عليكم هذا القميص كبير جدا
english: Sarah said to the seller, "Hello, this shirt is too big."
transliteration: Qalat Sarah lil-ba'i' As-salamu alaykum hatha al-qamis kabir jiddan.

arabic: اجاب البائع وعليكم السلام تفضلي هل لديك الفاتورة
english: The seller replied, "And peace be upon you too, please, do you have the receipt?"
transliteration: Ajaba al-ba'i' Wa alaykum as-salam tafaddali hal ladayki al-fatourah.

arabic: اخرجت سارة الفاتورة من حقيبتها وابتسمت
english: Sarah took the receipt from her bag and smiled.
transliteration: Akhrajat Sarah al-fatourah min haqibatiha wabtasamat.

arabic: ثم اختارت قميصا اخر بحجم اصغر وودعت البائع بمساء النور
english: Then she chose another shirt in a smaller size and bid the seller farewell with "Good evening."
transliteration: Thumma ikhtarat qamisan akhar bihajm asghar wawadda'at al-ba'i' bimasa' an-nur.

arabic: في صباح يوم جميل رايت صديقا قديما في السوق مع عائلته
english: On a beautiful morning, I saw an old friend at the market with his family.
transliteration: Fi sabahi yawmin jamilin ra'aytu sadiqa qadiman fi as-suqi ma'a 'ailatihi.

arabic: قلت له السلام عليكم فاجاب بحرارة وعليكم السلام
english: I said to him "Peace be upon you" and he responded warmly "And peace be upon you too".
transliteration: Qultu lahu as-salamu alaykum fa'ajaba bihararah wa alaykum as-salam.

arabic: سالته كيف حالك وكيف حال عائلتك الجميلة
english: I asked him "How are you?" and "How is your beautiful family?".
transliteration: Sa'altuhu kayfa haluka wa kayfa halu 'ailatika al-jamilah.

arabic: ابتسم وقدم لي زوجته واولاده
english: He smiled and introduced me to his wife and children.
transliteration: Ibtasama wa qaddama li zawjatahu wa awladahu.

arabic: تحدثنا طويلا عن ذكرياتنا ووعدنا باللقاء قريبا
english: We talked for a long time about our memories and promised to meet again soon.
transliteration: Tahaddathna tawilan 'an dhikrayatina wa wa'adna bil-liqai qariban.

arabic: اليوم قررت ان اطبخ طبقا جديدا لاول مرة في المطبخ
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish for the first time in the kitchen.
transliteration: Al-yawm qarartu an atbukha tabaqan jadidan li-awwal marrah fi al-matbakh.

arabic: كانت المكونات جاهزة والوصفة تبدو سهلة جدا
english: The ingredients were ready and the recipe seemed very easy.
transliteration: Kanat al-mukawwinat jahizah wal-wasfah tabdu sahlah jiddan.

arabic: بدات بتحضير الطعام وامتلا المطبخ برائحة جميلة
english: I started preparing the food and the kitchen filled with a beautiful aroma.
transliteration: Bada'tu bi-tahdir at-ta'am wa-imtala al-matbakh bi-ra'ihah jamilah.

arabic: بعد وقت قصير اصبح الطبق جاهزا ليبدو لذيذا جدا
english: After a short time, the dish became ready and looked very delicious.
transliteration: Ba'da waqt qasir asbaha at-tabaq jahizan li-yabdu ladhidhan jiddan.

arabic: تذوقت الطعام وشعرت بسعادة كبيرة لانه كان رائعا
english: I tasted the food and felt great happiness because it was wonderful.
transliteration: Tadhawoqtu at-ta'am wa-sha'artu bi-sa'adah kabirah li-annahu kana ra'i'an.

arabic: وصلت سارة الى بيت خالتها مساء الخير وقالت مساء الخير يا خالتي
english: Sara arrived at her aunt's house in the evening and said "Good evening, my aunt."
transliteration: Wasalat Sara ila bayt khalatiha masa' al-khayr wa qalat masa' al-khayr ya khalati.

arabic: ردت الخالة بسعادة وقالت مساء النور كيف حالك يا سارة
english: The aunt replied happily and said "Good evening (response), how are you, Sara?"
transliteration: Raddat al-khalah bi-sa'adah wa qalat masa' an-nur kayfa haluki ya Sara.

arabic: اجابت سارة انا بخير شكرا لك يا خالتي وشعرت بالراحة
english: Sara replied, "I am fine, thank you, my aunt," and she felt comfortable.
transliteration: Ajabat Sara ana bi-khayr shukran laki ya khalati wa sha'arat bi-ar-rahah.

arabic: ثم رات سارة طفلة صغيرة تلعب فابتسمت وسالت الطفلة ما اسمك
english: Then Sara saw a small girl playing, so she smiled and asked the girl, "What's your name?"
transliteration: Thumma ra'at Sara tiflah saghirah tal'ab fa-ibtassamat wa sa'alat at-tiflata ma ismuki.

arabic: ضحكت الطفلة بخجل وشعرت سارة بالفرح بزيارة عائلتها
english: The girl laughed shyly and Sara felt joy from visiting her family.
transliteration: Dahikat at-tiflata bi-khajal wa sha'arat Sara bi-al-farah bi-ziyarat 'ailatiha.

arabic: كنت امشي في الحديقة اليوم وشعرت بالراحة بعد اسبوع عمل صعب
english: I was walking in the park today and felt relaxed after a difficult work week
transliteration: kuntu amshi fi alhadiqati alyawma wa shaartu bilrahati bada usbuu amalin saab

arabic: فجأة رايت صديقي القديم احمد الذي لم اره منذ سنوات طويلة
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed whom I had not seen for many years
transliteration: fajaatan raaytu sadeeqi alqadeem Ahmed alladhi lam arahu mundhu sanawat tawila

arabic: كان مظهره مختلفا قليلا ولكن ابتسامته بقيت كما هي
english: His appearance was slightly different but his smile remained the same
transliteration: kana madharuhu mukhtalifan qaleelan walakin ibtisamatuhu baqiyat kama hiya

arabic: تحدثنا طويلا عن كيف تتطور الحياة وتصبح احيانا صعبة
english: We talked a lot about how life develops and sometimes becomes difficult
transliteration: tahaddathna taweelan an kayfa tatatawwaru alhayatu wa tusbihu ahyaanan saabatan

arabic: في النهاية قال لي احمد ان اسمي يبدو مألوفا لكنه لا يتذكرني ابدا
english: In the end Ahmed told me that my name seemed familiar but he never remembered me
transliteration: fi alnihayati qala li Ahmed in ismi yabdu malufan lakinahu la yatadhakkaruni abadan

arabic: كان الجو حارا جدا والشمس ساطعة عندما ادركت انني ضللت طريقي في المدينة
english: The weather was very hot and the sun was shining brightly when I realized I had lost my way in the city.
transliteration: Kana al-jawwu harran jiddan wa ash-shamsu sati'atan indama adraktu annani dalaltu tariqi fi al-madinah.

arabic: نظرت حولي فلم ار اي علامة اعرفها وشعرت بقليل من القلق
english: I looked around but did not see any familiar signs and felt a little worried.
transliteration: Nazartu hawli falam ara ayya alamatin a'rifuha wa sha'artu bi-qaleelin min al-qalaq.

arabic: بعد لحظات رايت رجلا يقف قريبا فقررت ان اساله عن الاتجاهات
english: After a few moments, I saw a man standing nearby, so I decided to ask him for directions.
transliteration: Ba'da lahazatin ra'aytu rajulan yaqifu qariban fa-qarrartu an as'alahu an al-ittijahat.

arabic: قلت له السلام عليكم كيف حالك يا اخي انا بخير لكنني ضللت الطريق
english: I said to him: "Hello, how are you, my brother? I am fine, but I have lost my way."
transliteration: Qultu lahu: As-salamu alaykum, kayfa haluka ya akhi? Ana bi-khayr, lakinnani dalaltu at-tariq.

arabic: هل يمكنك ان تدلني على طريق السوق الكبير من فضلك
english: Can you please show me the way to the big market?
transliteration: Hal yumkinuka an tadullani ala tariq as-souq al-kabeer min fadlika?

arabic: احمد كان متحمس جدا لمشاهدة مباراة كرة القدم لفريقه المفضل
english: Ahmed was very excited to watch his favorite team's football match.
transliteration: Ahmad kana mutahammisan jiddan li-mushaahadati mubaaraati kurat al-qadam li-fareeqihi al-mufaddal.

arabic: في الملعب الكبير انتظر الجمهور الهدف الاول بفارغ الصبر
english: In the big stadium, the crowd eagerly awaited the first goal.
transliteration: Fi al-mal'ab al-kabeer intazara al-jumhoor al-hadaf al-awwal bi-faarighi as-sabr.

arabic: عندما سجل الفريق المنافس هدفا شعر احمد بالحزن
english: When the opposing team scored a goal, Ahmed felt sad.
transliteration: 'Indama sajjala al-fareeq al-munaafis hadafan sha'ara Ahmad bi-al-huzn.

arabic: لكن في الدقائق الاخيرة احرز فريقه هدفا آخر وفاز بالمباراة
english: But in the last minutes, his team scored another goal and won the match.
transliteration: Lakin fi ad-daqa'iq al-akheerah ahraza fareequhu hadafan aakhar wa faaz bi-al-mubaaraah.

arabic: ابتسم احمد بسعادة كبيرة وشعر بالفخر بفريقه الرائع
english: Ahmed smiled with great happiness and felt proud of his wonderful team.
transliteration: Ibtasama Ahmad bi-sa'aadatin kabeerah wa sha'ara bi-al-fakhr bi-fareeqihi ar-raa'i'.

arabic: اتصل خالد بصديقه احمد مساء الخير
english: Khalid called his friend Ahmed. Good evening.
transliteration: Ittasala Khalid bi-sadiqihi Ahmad masa' al-khayr
storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend

arabic: سأل خالد كيف حالك يا احمد
english: Khalid asked, "How are you, Ahmed?"
transliteration: Sa'ala Khalid kayfa haluka ya Ahmad
storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend

arabic: اجاب احمد انا بخير شكرا لك وماذا عن يومك
english: Ahmed replied, "I am fine, thank you. And what about your day?"
transliteration: Ajaba Ahmad ana bi-khayr shukran lak wa madha an yawmik
storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend

arabic: قال خالد كان يومي طويلا وقد عدت للتو من العمل
english: Khalid said, "My day was long, and I just returned from work."
transliteration: Qala Khalid kana yawmi tawilan wa qad udtu lil-tawwi min al-amal
storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend

arabic: ثم اتفقا على لقاء في نهاية الاسبوع لتبادل الاخبار
english: Then they agreed to meet at the end of the week to exchange news.
transliteration: Thumma ittafaqa ala liqa' fi nihayat al-usbu' li-tabadul al-akhbar
storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend

arabic: رائحة القهوة الطازجة ملأت المكتب.
english: The smell of fresh coffee filled the office.
transliteration: Ra'ihatul-qahwatit-tazijah mala'atil-maktaba.

arabic: ليلى، معلمة حريصة، رأت الأستاذ فارس.
english: Layla, a diligent teacher, saw Ustadh Faris.
transliteration: Layla, mu'allimatun harisah, ra'atil-ustadha Faris.

arabic: قالت له:
english: She said to him:
transliteration: Qalat lahu:

arabic: ابتسم الأستاذ فارس وقال:
english: Ustadh Faris smiled and said:
transliteration: Ibtasama al-ustadh Faris wa qala:

arabic: أجابت ليلى:
english: Layla replied:
transliteration: Ajabat Layla:

arabic: أدركت ليلى، المهندسة المعمارية الدقيقة، فجأة أنها تركت المخططات الأساسية للمعرض في المنزل، وهو خطأ فادح قبل اجتماعها مع الدكتور كمال.
english: Layla, the meticulous architect, suddenly realized that she had left the crucial exhibit blueprints at home, a grave error before her meeting with Dr. Kamal.
transliteration: Adrakat Layla, al-muhandisah al-mi'mariyyah ad-daqiqah, faj'atan annaha tarakat al-mukhattatat al-asasiyyah lil-ma'rid fi al-manzil, wa huwa khata'un fadih qabla ijtima'iha ma'a ad-duktur Kamal.

arabic: كانت عقارب الساعة تشير إلى الثامنة صباحاً بالضبط في الردهة الكبرى للمتحف الوطني للآثار بوسط القاهرة، بينما كانت تستعد لاستقباله.
english: The clock hands pointed to exactly eight o'clock in the grand atrium of the National Museum of Antiquities in downtown Cairo, while she was preparing to receive him.
transliteration: Kanat 'aqarib as-sa'ah tushiru ila ath-thaminah sabahan bid-dabt fi ar-radhah al-kubra lil-matḥaf al-watani lil-athar bi-wasat al-Qahirah, baynama kanat tasta'iddu li-istiqbalihi.

arabic: وما كادت تتمالك نفسها حتى لمحته يدخل، فتقدمت نحوه بابتسامة متوترة قائلة: "صباح الخير، يا دكتور كمال."
english: She barely composed herself when she spotted him entering, so she approached him with a nervous smile, saying: "Good morning, Dr. Kamal."
transliteration: Wa ma kadat tatamalak nafsaha hatta lamahat-hu yadkhul, fa-taqaddamat nahwahu bi-ibtisamatin mutawat-tiratin qa'ilah: "Sabah al-khayr, ya duktur Kamal."

arabic: رد الدكتور كمال بهدوء المعتاد، وهو يضبط نظارته: "صباح النور، يا ليلى، كيف حالك اليوم؟"
english: Dr. Kamal replied with his usual calmness, adjusting his glasses: "Good morning, Layla, how are you today?"
transliteration: Radda ad-duktur Kamal bi-hudu'ihi al-mu'tad, wa huwa yadbutu nazzaratahu: "Sabah an-nur, ya Layla, kayfa haluki al-yawm?"

arabic: أجابت ليلى بصوت خافت، محاولة إخفاء قلقها: "أنا بخير، ولكنني واجهت تحدياً صباحياً غير متوقع."
english: Layla replied in a low voice, trying to hide her anxiety: "I am fine, but I faced an unexpected morning challenge."
transliteration: Ajabat Layla bi-sawtin khafit, muhawilatan ikhfa'a qalqiha: "Ana bi-khayrin, wa lakinnani wajjahtu tahaddiyan sabahi-yan ghayra mutawaqqa'."

arabic: استفسر الدكتور كمال بفضول مهذب: "هل كل شيء على ما يرام؟ أتمنى ألا يكون هناك ما يعيق تقديمك."
english: Dr. Kamal inquired with polite curiosity: "Is everything alright? I hope there is nothing hindering your presentation."
transliteration: Istafsara ad-duktur Kamal bi-fudulin muhadh-dhab: "Hal kullu shay'in 'ala ma yuram? Atamanna alla yakuna hunaka ma yu'iqu taqdimaki."

arabic: اعترفت ليلى بتنهيدة عميقة: "للأسف، نسيت المخططات النهائية في المنزل، غير أنني سأشرح التفاصيل شفهياً الآن."
english: Layla confessed with a deep sigh: "Unfortunately, I forgot the final blueprints at home; however, I will explain the details verbally now."
transliteration: I'tarafat Layla bi-tanheedatin 'ameeqah: "Lil-asafi, naseetu al-mukhattatat an-niha'iyyah fi al-manzil, ghayra annani sa-ashrahu at-tafaseel shafahi-yan al-an."

arabic: أومأ الدكتور كمال برأسه، قائلاً: "حسناً، فلنبدأ إذن. لا تقلقي، يمكننا مناقشة الأساسيات أولاً."
english: Dr. Kamal nodded his head, saying: "Alright, let us begin then. Don't worry, we can discuss the basics first."
transliteration: Awma'a ad-duktur Kamal bi-ra'sihi, qa'ilan: "Hasanan, fal-nabda' idhan. La taqlaqi, yumkinuna munaqashat al-asasiyat awwalan."

arabic: في تلك اللحظة، ظهرت السيدة فاطمة، أمينة المتحف المساعدة، وهي تلوح لهما قائلة: "أهلاً وسهلاً بكما!"
english: At that moment, Mrs. Fatima, the assistant curator, appeared, waving to them and saying: "Welcome to you both!"
transliteration: Fi tilka al-lahzah, zaharat as-sayyidah Fatimah, ameenat al-matḥaf al-musa'idah, wa hiya tulawwiḥ lahuma qa'ilah: "Ahlan wa sahlan bikuma!"

arabic: رد الدكتور كمال وليلى بتحية موحدة: "أهلاً بكِ يا سيدة فاطمة، كيف حالكِ اليوم؟"
english: Dr. Kamal and Layla replied with a unified greeting: "Welcome, Mrs. Fatima, how are you today?"
transliteration: Radda ad-duktur Kamal wa Layla bi-tahiyyatin muwahhadah: "Ahlan biki ya sayyidah Fatimah, kayfa haluki al-yawm?"

arabic: أجابت فاطمة بابتهاج: "أنا بخير والحمد لله، وصلتني للتو رسالة من مدير المشروع يحييكم فيها."
english: Fatima replied cheerfully: "I am fine, praise be to God, I just received a message from the project manager greeting you both."
transliteration: Ajabat Fatimah bi-ibtihajin: "Ana bi-khayrin wal-hamdu lillah, wasalatni lil-taw-wi risalatun min mudir al-mashru'i yuhayyiikum fiha."

arabic: شعرت ليلى ببعض الارتياح، إذ تذكرت أن تقديم القهوة العربية قبل الاجتماعات الرسمية يبعث على الهدوء.
english: Layla felt some relief, as she remembered that serving Arabic coffee before official meetings instills calmness.
transliteration: Sha'arat Layla bi-ba'd al-irtiyah, idh tadakkarat anna taqdim al-qahwah al-'arabiyyah qabla al-ijtima'at ar-rasmiyyah yab'athu 'ala al-hudu'.

arabic: بعد مرور ساعة من النقاش، قالت ليلى: "شكراً جزيلاً لكما على تفهمكما، وإلى اللقاء في الاجتماع القادم."
english: After an hour of discussion, Layla said: "Thank you both very much for your understanding, and goodbye until the next meeting."
transliteration: Ba'da mururi sa'atin min an-niqash, qalat Layla: "Shukran jazilan lakuma 'ala tafahhumikuma, wa ila al-liqa'i fi al-ijtima' al-qadim."

arabic: أجاب الدكتور كمال بابتسامة نادرة: "على الرحب والسعة يا ليلى، وداعا، ونتطلع لرؤية المخططات قريباً."
english: Dr. Kamal replied with a rare smile: "You are most welcome, Layla, goodbye, and we look forward to seeing the blueprints soon."
transliteration: Ajaba ad-duktur Kamal bi-ibtisamatin nadirah: "'Ala ar-raḥbi was-sa'ah ya Layla, wada'an, wa natatalla'u li-ru'yat al-mukhattatat qariban."

arabic: ثم أضافت السيدة فاطمة وهي تودعهم: "مع السلامة، أتمنى لكما يوماً موفقاً في عملكما."
english: Then Mrs. Fatima added as she bid them farewell: "Goodbye, I wish you both a successful day in your work."
transliteration: Thumma adafat as-sayyidah Fatimah wa hiya tuwaddi'uhum: "Ma'a as-salamah, atamanna lakuma yawman muwaffaqan fi 'amalikuma."

arabic: تلك المواقف تبرز أهمية المرونة في التواصل، حتى في أكثر البيئات الرسمية والمشحونة بالتوتر.
english: Such situations highlight the importance of flexibility in communication, even in the most formal and tension-filled environments.
transliteration: Tilka al-mawaqif tubrizu ahammiyyat al-murunah fi at-tawasul, hatta fi akthar al-bi'at ar-rasmiyyah wal-mashhunah bit-tawatur.

arabic: فبالرغم من التحديات، استطاعت ليلى الحفاظ على رباطة جأشها وتقديم عرضها بكفاءة.
english: Despite the challenges, Layla managed to maintain her composure and deliver her presentation efficiently.
transliteration: Fa-bir-raghmi min at-tahaddiyat, istata'at Layla al-hifaz 'ala rabatat ja'shiha wa taqdim 'ardiha bi-kafa'ah.

arabic: كما أن الدكتور كمال، بأسلوبه الهادئ، قدم مثالاً للتعاون المهني الرفيع.
english: Furthermore, Dr. Kamal, with his calm demeanor, provided an example of high-level professional cooperation.
transliteration: Kama anna ad-duktur Kamal, bi-uslubihi al-hadi', qaddama mithalan lit-ta'awuni al-mihani ar-rafi'.

arabic: إن هذه الواقعة تؤكد أهمية التحية والتواصل الفعال في بناء جسور التفاهم والتقدير المتبادل.
english: Indeed, this incident emphasizes the importance of greeting and effective communication in building bridges of mutual understanding and appreciation.
transliteration: Inna hadhihi al-waqi'ah tu'akkidu ahammiyyat at-tahiyyah wat-tawasul al-fa''al fi bina'i jusur at-tafahum wat-taqdir al-mutabadal.

arabic: فهل ندرك دائماً كيف يمكن لعبارات بسيطة مثل "كيف حالك" أن تفتح آفاقاً جديدة؟
english: Do we always realize how simple phrases like "How are you?" can open new horizons?
transliteration: Fa-hal nudriku da'iman kayfa yumkinu li-'ibaratin baseetah mithla "kayfa haluki" an taftaḥa afaqan jadeedah?

arabic: إنها لمسة إنسانية تلطف الأجواء وتذيب جليد الرسميات، مما يمهد الطريق لتعاملات مثمرة.
english: It is a human touch that softens the atmosphere and melts the ice of formalities, paving the way for fruitful interactions.
transliteration: Innaha lamsatun insaniyyah tulattifu al-ajwa'a wa tudhibu jaleed ar-rasmiyyat, mimma yumahhid at-tareeq li-ta'amulat muthmirah.

arabic: هكذا، في قلب القاهرة الصاخبة، تحولت لحظة قلق إلى فرصة لإظهار الاحترافية واللباقة في التعامل.
english: Thus, in the heart of bustling Cairo, a moment of anxiety transformed into an opportunity to demonstrate professionalism and tact in interaction.
transliteration: Hakadha, fi qalb al-Qahirah as-sakhbah, tahawwalat lahzat qalaqin ila fursatin li-izhari al-ihtirafiyyah wal-labaqah fi at-ta'amul.

arabic: لذا، يتوجب علينا أن نتذكر دائماً قوة الكلمات البسيطة في تشكيل يومنا وتجاربنا.
english: Therefore, we must always remember the power of simple words in shaping our day and our experiences.
transliteration: Lidha, yatawajjabu 'alayna an natadhakkara da'iman quwwat al-kalimat al-baseetah fi tashkeeli yawmina wa tajaribina.

arabic: وصلت الدكتورة ليلى متأخرة إلى جامعة القاهرة.
english: Dr. Layla arrived late at Cairo University.
transliteration: Wasalat al-Dukturah Layla muta'akhkhirah ila jamiah al-Qahirah.

arabic: قالت لزميلها عمر: صباح الخير يا أستاذ!
english: She said to her colleague Omar: "Good morning, Professor!"
transliteration: Qalat li-zamiliha Umar: Sabah al-Khayr ya Ustad!

arabic: رد قائلا: أهلاً بك يا دكتورة ليلى، كيف حالك اليوم؟
english: He replied saying: "Welcome, Dr. Layla, how are you today?"
transliteration: Radda qa'ilan: Ahlan bik ya Dukturah Layla, kayf haluk al-yawm?

arabic: ابتسمت وقالت: أنا بخير، شكراً؛ إلى اللقاء، لدي محاضرة.
english: She smiled and said: "I am well, thank you; goodbye, I have a lecture."
transliteration: Ibtasamat wa qalat: Ana bi-khayr, shukran; ila al-Liqa', ladayya muhadarah.

arabic: ثم دخلت القاعة، مرحبة بطلابها المنتظرين.
english: Then she entered the hall, welcoming her waiting students.
transliteration: Thumma dakhalat al-Qaa'ah, murahhibah bi-tullabiha al-muntazirin.
